paragraphs: "Oh? Do you know about my race’s dream abilities?" Fei Lian nodded to Feltia [2]. "Since we’ll be parting ways after this, I purposely used them on you. This way, I can come to you anytime and anywhere, and we can spend more time together there."

Feltia [2] then gave Fei Lian a qi recovery pill because her Qi was drained quite a lot by her previous two orgasms, and she also gave her a storage ring containing his pills and Yang Qi. "Are you also an alchemist?"

"I have the dragon flame, and I won’t let it go to waste, so I learned about alchemy from someone." Feltia [2] helped Fei Lian up before looking toward the garden. "My clones and wives are finished, so we will leave now, and I will wait for news from you about the three demon items."
"I’ll let you know once I get them." Before leaving with the others, Feltia [2] kissed Fei Lian again, which made her sigh to herself while rubbing her lips.

Fei Lian checked the pills in the storage ring before freezing in shock. "Am I lucky or unlucky to meet him? Since he can concoct so many superior-grade pills, that means he is an expert alchemist. He didn’t enslave me, but I’m no different from a slave because he can order me around as he wishes because of our soul bond."
Fei Lian sighed again before leaving the place, catching up with some of her subordinates.

Once they were far enough away, Feltia [2] sent the three women back to the training space to continue their seclusion with his main body, and then he went to the last place in the dungeon he or the other clones hadn’t visited yet.
Meanwhile, the other two clones went to pick up their close acquaintances and brought them to the labyrinth, as there was nothing else of interest elsewhere.
Up in the sky, Feng Yao smiled to herself after witnessing Feltia [2] and Fei Lan earlier. "That female beast will be useful to him."
"His demon abilities are too terrifying, Yao’er." Feng Jiu tilted her head to the side. "Is there a woman who can resist his abilities?"

Feng Yao nodded at her. "His lust demon abilities were already terrifying to begin with, and they became even more terrifying after he evolved into a transcendent lust demon, further enhanced by his current soul level. Most women would be affected by his abilities if he combined them with his domain like just now, but the two of us can withstand it. Some of the winged race, like Jiang Yinghua and Tian Huangjin, can also resist them."
"Why doesn’t he use his abilities on Yao Qilin? She’s stronger than Fei Lian, right?"

"Hehe." Feng Yao softly chuckled. "Yao Qilin is indeed stronger than Fei Lian, but you should remember Zhang Fei’s character, Mother. He will never do anything to anyone who doesn’t have a problem with him, and that female qilin is smart enough not to attack him first."

Feng Jiu nodded in agreement. "I think it would be better if he used his abilities on Yao Qilin, and she would be a valuable ally for him in facing the four perils. By the way, you have all three demon items, right?"

"I do have them." Feng Yao nodded with a smile. "I won’t give them to him, and I want him to work hard to get them himself. Instead, I will give those demon items to one of his women, but I haven’t chosen which one yet."
"As I recall, some of the female demons on his side weren’t demon cultivators, right? Can you help them become one?" Feng Jiu asked again.

"Hmm?" Feng Yao immediately thought of several women. "Currently, only Ursula and the Amaris twins have not yet become demon cultivators. I can help them become ones, but the process is a bit complicated and requires some sacrifices."

Feng Jiu naturally understood her daughter’s intentions, but it wasn’t a simple matter that could be accomplished quickly, as not everyone’s cultivation veins would be compatible with the three female demon cultivators’ bodies.
Feng Yao looked in another direction. "Those evil beasts have gathered those hostages in the colosseum."
"Are you going to free them, Yao’er?" Feng Tian, who had been silent for a while, asked.

Feng Yao was not surprised by her father’s question because he was too kind-hearted. "Father, this Paradise Realm is different from the Three Mortal Realms, and the cultivators here are more experienced than those there. They have faced this kind of situation for thousands of years, so they should already understand that it will happen, and they should have prepared themselves to prevent it. However, many of them were too arrogant and underestimated the situation, so they had to bear the consequences themselves."

Feng Tian could only sigh inwardly, as Feng Yao was too indifferent to the fate of others. However, he lacked the power to save those people because the ten evil mythical beasts were too strong for him.

Feng Jiu noticed her husband’s expression and held his hand. ’Husband, I want to save those people, but we are only ordinary cultivators in this realm, and we won’t be able to defeat those evil beasts.’
’I know.’ Feng Tian once again sighed in his heart.
"Let’s go to the labyrinth; we will join Zhang Fei and the others." Feng Yao immediately brought her parents there after she ordered her three subordinates to take care of something.
Zhang Fei [4] was hiding in the Endless Night Colosseum, where he saw evil beasts holding many people from various races hostage, except for the demon race.
[Are you considering saving these people, Master?]

’Mei, I don’t know them, and I’m not a saint either, so I won’t waste my time saving them.’ Zhang Fei [4] kept observing them thoughtfully. ’However, I will save those three women from the Hidden Moon Sect, and I will use them to establish good relationships with their sect.’

[Why don’t you directly approach Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang? Both are pretty and sexy enough for your taste, right? If you successfully seduce and subdue them, their sect will become yours, and your demon fox group will become stronger with their addition.]

’Hey! You’re becoming such a pervert now, Mei.’ The female Ai snorted inside Zhang Fei [4]’s mind. ’Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang are pretty, but I’m not interested in them; instead, I’m more interested in getting Beiming Youhuang and You Qilin.’
*Tap*
Zhang Fei [4] was startled by the touch on his shoulder and turned back immediately, finding Feng Yao’s three subordinates behind him, with Huo Yu’er grinning at him. "Why are you three here?"
"Them." Huo Yu’er pointed to the people held hostage by the evil beasts. "Our empress asked us to save these people because her parents pity them."
"If it weren’t for our empress’s order, we wouldn’t be able to care for them." Huo Lanyin lazily spoke.

"Haha." Huo Hao’er softly laughed. "These people were quite strong, but they were too stupid to read the situation. As a result, the evil beasts managed to capture them, but they were lucky because they could only leave this dungeon when the time was up."

Zhang Fei [4] was not surprised that Feng Tian and Feng Jiu pitied these people and wanted to save them. "Can you three fight the ten beast generals? How about I help you guys? I want to save the three women from the Hidden Moon Sect."
They narrowed their eyes at Zhang Fei [4], making Mei laugh in her mind. [These three women think you are a pervert, Master.]
Huo Lanyin grabbed his shoulder. "You have already obtained our Empress’s heart, so you should be satisfied and stop looking for other women."
"Our empress may not mind your perverted nature, but we do mind if you continue to increase the number of your women and leave her far behind them." Huo Hao’er spoke with a stern look.
Huo Yu’er joined in to threaten him. "If you want to increase your number of women, you must get our empress completely first. Otherwise, we will be your enemies, and we will beat you up."

"You guys." Zhang Fei [4] sighed softly. "Do you think I don’t want to get Feng Yao? You guys have known her since she was still alive as Huo Yanling, and I fully understood your feelings for her, but you never understood her. Have you ever heard of her identities as Guang Zhiyi and Shen Yuanzhi?"
"Hmm?" The three women raised their eyebrows.

"See? You three don’t know anything about her other two identities, right?" They shook their heads at Zhang Fei [4]. "Shen Yuanzhi was a woman who lived during the primordial era, and Guang Zhiyi lived during the ancient era. Do you think it will be easy for me to conquer her with her experience that far exceeds anyone else’s? If you don’t believe me, you can ask her directly."
"We heard the name Guang Zhiyi when our empress took us to meet Yin Yue at the palace, but she didn’t explain it to us in detail." Huo Hao’er and Huo Yu’er nodded in support of Huo Lanyin’s words.
Zhang Fei [4] was a bit surprised to hear that. "In the past, Guang Zhiyi was the guardian of the ancient races. She imprisoned Yin Yue’s soul in the palace and Tian Taiyang’s soul under the abyss."
"Who is Tian Taiyang?"
"The second in command of the Golden Sun Clan."

chapters.title: Chapter 1204: Call For Help
paragraphs: "Hey, look over there!" Huo Yu’er pointed at the Nine-Headed Evil Bird, Jiu Niao, carrying four women on its two talons. "Aren’t they?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] nodded at her. "They are female cultivators from the Empyrean Main Domain, and two of them are Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang."
"What about your people?" Huo Hao’er asked.

"Most of them are already in the labyrinth, and my other two clones are picking up the rest. Moreover, I guided them through telepathy from the start, so they didn’t encounter those evil beasts." Zhang Fei [4] then looked in another direction. "Long Gui and Xie Zhi brought many other women, including Qiu Meixuan and Guang Yue. Why do they only target female cultivators?"

"There are many mixed breeds within the evil beast races, but their status is the lowest among them." Zhang Fei [4] turned to Huo Lanyin. "Pure beasts take a long time to produce offspring, and mixed breeds can grow faster than them. Although mixed breeds are generally weaker than pure beasts, they are still superior to other cultivators. Therefore, they kidnap many women from all races to give them offspring, and the four perils will use them as cannon fodder. Despite this, they also kidnap male cultivators, particularly those with outstanding talents."
"What happened to those women?"

"Dead." Zhang Fei [4] frowned at Hu Lanyin’s answer. "Women from other races have impressive physiques, but female humans are too fragile. Those beasts aren’t concerned about their fate, and they will use their bodies to produce as many mixed offspring as possible, which ultimately leads to their death."
"I see." Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding. "Even though Long Wuzhao and the others are strong, they won’t be able to save them all from the evil beasts."

"That’s right." Huo Lanyin then continued. "Unifying all the races is difficult, especially with their arrogance and pride. In the past, Long Wuzhao tried to unite all the races several times, but his efforts always reached a dead end. As long as all races only think about themselves, we will never be able to get rid of these evil beasts. Furthermore, numerous living entities exhibit cowardice and fear of death, so they choose to sacrifice them."

Zhang Fei [4] exhaled softly. "Currently, only Feng Yao and Huo Ling can get rid of these evil beasts, but I know for sure that they would never bother to do it. If we want to unite all races, we must use coercion against them; otherwise, they will never unite."
"Unfortunately, Long Wuzhao is too soft and unwilling to use such methods." Huo Hao’er spoke.
Huo Yu’er patted his shoulder. "According to our empress, you are destined to be the bringer of peace to this universe, so we will pin our hopes on you."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed bitterly, as the three women were much stronger than him. "The other evil mythical beasts started moving towards this place, and they also kidnapped many people. I think the four of us won’t be enough to face them, so I’ll call for some backup."

After he saved the location, Zhang Fei [4] then created a warp portal. A while later, several people walked out of it, such as Su Shentian, Jian Kuang, Beiming Youhuang, Tianshi Shengjie, Long Youjia, Li Tianyu, Lan Yueru, Jia Lingzhu, and Jia Shengyun.
Zhang Fei [4] inwardly sighed because Luo Yunxiao insisted on joining them, but he already knew more or less about her special physique’s abilities, so he allowed her to join them.
"Your clones and your ability to create a portal are truly convenient, kid." Jia Shengyun spoke.
Jia Lingzhu and the others agreed with him. "If it weren’t for them, we wouldn’t be gathered here now."

"However, our numbers are still insufficient to face these beasts, and we will lose because we are outnumbered, so we need some other help to deal with them." Beiming Youhuang then asked Zhang Fei [4]. "Can you bring people from outside here?"

Zhang Fei [4] nodded at her. "I can do that, but I don’t have many acquaintances in the Paradise Realm. Moreover, the soul-devouring and eternal night demon gods will not be able to join us, or they will face serious problems because the Calamity Demon Race is in a relationship with these evil beast races."
Tianshi Shengjie immediately spoke. "Take me out, and I will contact my father and the others. If they come here, they can handle these evil beasts faster."
"Alright." Soon, Zhang Xiaolong [3] arrived at the location, and he immediately brought Tianshi Shengjie out of the Endless Night Dungeon.
"Hey, Kid! Doesn’t this mean you can enter and exit this dungeon whenever you want?" Jian Kuang asked.
Su Shentian nodded in agreement. "This way, this dungeon can be considered your personal property, as you’re the only one who can do that in this realm."

"You two aren’t wrong about that, but there’s nothing interesting inside this dungeon anymore, so it’s not that useful." Zhang Fei [4] then turned to the man who had just arrived. However, his expression changed to shock as soon as Mei displayed his status. ’Zhuxian Sheng? He possesses both the Ancestral Battle Saint Physique and the time element.’
"What are you doing here, Sheng?" Su Shentian asked him.
"Him." Zhuxian Sheng pointed to Zhang Fei [4]. "A crimson-haired woman previously came to me, and she asked me to be his sparring partner."

Su Shentian and Jian Kuang turned to Zhang Fei [4], who raised an eyebrow. He naturally knew Zhuxian Sheng was referring to Feng Yao, but he was confused by her reason for asking him to be his sparring partner.

Zhuxian Sheng immediately explained to him. "She said you have outstanding talent, but you’re too weak to help her. Thus, she asked me to be your sparring partner to train you, and she asked me not to hold back whenever we spar."

"I see." Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding. "Even though I don’t know you, I know her quite well. Moreover, I need lots of sparring partners to further hone myself, so I’m pleased with your decision to accept her offer. However, we can’t do that now, and we have to save those people first."
Zhuxian Sheng observed the situation inside the colosseum before nodding. "I know some of them, so I’ll join you guys to save them. Are we going to move now?"

"They outnumber us, so we’re calling for reinforcements, and we’ll move in once they arrive." Zhuxian Sheng was a little surprised when Jiang Kuang and the other senior cultivators agreed with Zhang Fei [4], proving that he was their leader. "Also, not all the evil mythical beasts are here yet, so we’ll wait for them all to arrive, and we’ll clear them out at once."
Zhuxian Sheng agreed with that. "Let’s wait, then."

Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Tianshi Shengjie were in the central area of the Twin Flames Domain, and the female dragon immediately contacted Tianshi Bailong and the others. "They are currently meeting with other beast races, but they will be finished soon, so we have to wait for a while."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] pulled her into an embrace. "How about you stay with me?"

Tianshi Shengjie smiled in amusement and pressed her index finger against his chest. "Why do you want to get me so badly? It’s true that we’ve known each other for a long time, but our relationship is nothing more than acquaintances, right?"
"You’re a beautiful dragon; that’s enough for me to want to have you, right?" Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s answer made her laugh.

"Hahaha." Tianshi Shengjie laughed heartily at that. "Your reasons don’t make sense, you know? Since you said that, it means you only want my body, and you don’t truly love me. Therefore, I don’t want to be your woman, and you can find other female dragons to be yours."

"You’re wrong about that." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head in response. "I admit that I was attracted to you because of your physical appearance, but you seem to forget that there are many beautiful women around me, so your physical appearance doesn’t matter anymore. Moreover, there are still many beautiful women out there, but I don’t have any interest in them because they are not worthy of being my woman. On the other hand, you are worthy of being one, so I want you to stay by my side, and I will prove to you that I like you more than your physical appearance."

"Is that so?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] gave Tianshi Shengjie a determined nod. "Alright, I will stay by your side, but I forbid you from touching me before you can convince me that your feelings for me are based on sincerity and not because of my physical appearance. If I find out you used your lust demon abilities on me, I will leave immediately, and we will never meet again forever."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "Don’t worry, I will convince you that my feelings for you are sincere."
Suddenly, a void hole opened in front of them, and Long Xukong led Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong out of it.
"Hahaha." Long Wuzhao immediately laughed as he patted Tianshi Bailong’s shoulder. "It seems that your daughter has already decided on her future husband, Brother."
Tianshi Bailong did not comment on that. "Let’s go in, and we will handle those evil beasts directly. If the four perils want to go to war with us afterwards, we will face them head-on."
"Let’s go."

"Aren’t they?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] nodded at her.
"They are female cultivators from the Empyrean Main Domain, and two of them are Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang."
"What about your people?" Huo Hao’er asked.
"Most of them are already in the labyrinth, and my other two clones are picking up the rest.
Moreover, I guided them through telepathy from the start, so they didn’t encounter those evil beasts." Zhang Fei [4] then looked in another direction.
"Long Gui and Xie Zhi brought many other women, including Qiu Meixuan and Guang Yue.
Why do they only target female cultivators?"
"There are many mixed breeds within the evil beast races, but their status is the lowest among them." Zhang Fei [4] turned to Huo Lanyin.
"Pure beasts take a long time to produce offspring, and mixed breeds can grow faster than them.
Although mixed breeds are generally weaker than pure beasts, they are still superior to other cultivators.
Therefore, they kidnap many women from all races to give them offspring, and the four perils will use them as cannon fodder.
Despite this, they also kidnap male cultivators, particularly those with outstanding talents."
"What happened to those women?"
"Dead." Zhang Fei [4] frowned at Hu Lanyin’s answer.
"Women from other races have impressive physiques, but female humans are too fragile.
Those beasts aren’t concerned about their fate, and they will use their bodies to produce as many mixed offspring as possible, which ultimately leads to their death."
"I see." Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding.
"Even though Long Wuzhao and the others are strong, they won’t be able to save them all from the evil beasts."
"That’s right." Huo Lanyin then continued.
"Unifying all the races is difficult, especially with their arrogance and pride.
In the past, Long Wuzhao tried to unite all the races several times, but his efforts always reached a dead end.
As long as all races only think about themselves, we will never be able to get rid of these evil beasts.
Furthermore, numerous living entities exhibit cowardice and fear of death, so they choose to sacrifice them."
Zhang Fei [4] exhaled softly.
"Currently, only Feng Yao and Huo Ling can get rid of these evil beasts, but I know for sure that they would never bother to do it.
If we want to unite all races, we must use coercion against them; otherwise, they will never unite."
"Unfortunately, Long Wuzhao is too soft and unwilling to use such methods." Huo Hao’er spoke.
Huo Yu’er patted his shoulder.
"According to our empress, you are destined to be the bringer of peace to this universe, so we will pin our hopes on you."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed bitterly, as the three women were much stronger than him.
"The other evil mythical beasts started moving towards this place, and they also kidnapped many people.
I think the four of us won’t be enough to face them, so I’ll call for some backup."
After he saved the location, Zhang Fei [4] then created a warp portal.
A while later, several people walked out of it, such as Su Shentian, Jian Kuang, Beiming Youhuang, Tianshi Shengjie, Long Youjia, Li Tianyu, Lan Yueru, Jia Lingzhu, and Jia Shengyun.
Zhang Fei [4] inwardly sighed because Luo Yunxiao insisted on joining them, but he already knew more or less about her special physique’s abilities, so he allowed her to join them.
"Your clones and your ability to create a portal are truly convenient, kid." Jia Shengyun spoke.
Jia Lingzhu and the others agreed with him.
"If it weren’t for them, we wouldn’t be gathered here now."

"However, our numbers are still insufficient to face these beasts, and we will lose because we are outnumbered, so we need some other help to deal with them." Beiming Youhuang then asked Zhang Fei [4].
"Can you bring people from outside here?"
Zhang Fei [4] nodded at her.
"I can do that, but I don’t have many acquaintances in the Paradise Realm.

Moreover, the soul-devouring and eternal night demon gods will not be able to join us, or they will face serious problems because the Calamity Demon Race is in a relationship with these evil beast races."
Tianshi Shengjie immediately spoke.
"Take me out, and I will contact my father and the others.
If they come here, they can handle these evil beasts faster."
"Alright." Soon, Zhang Xiaolong [3] arrived at the location, and he immediately brought Tianshi Shengjie out of the Endless Night Dungeon.
"Hey, Kid!
Doesn’t this mean you can enter and exit this dungeon whenever you want?" Jian Kuang asked.
Su Shentian nodded in agreement.
"This way, this dungeon can be considered your personal property, as you’re the only one who can do that in this realm."
"You two aren’t wrong about that, but there’s nothing interesting inside this dungeon anymore, so it’s not that useful." Zhang Fei [4] then turned to the man who had just arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 1205: Make A Move
paragraphs: In the colosseum, nine of the ten evil mythical beasts had gathered, except for Fei Lian, who had been asked by Zhang Fei [4] not to approach their location.
"Where have you been? Why haven’t you kidnapped any women or those talented brats?"

Xie Heilong shook his head at Long Gui. "We did need those women, but I sensed a potential danger, so I tried to search the source. Unfortunately, I don’t know the person’s identity, so my subordinates and I searched for that person in various random places, but we were unable to find that person."
"Why do you attach importance to that mysterious person?" The Corrupted Dragon-Tiger, Suanni, who had turned into a man, asked.

"I’m sure that person is not a member of the winged race, but that person’s light element is as pure as theirs. In fact, that person’s light element is stronger, and I felt threatened even though I only detected its residue. If that person were in front of me, I would probably run away immediately." Xie Zhi and the other seven evil mythical beasts frowned at Xie Heilong’s revelation. "Where is Fei Lian? Why isn’t she here yet?"

"She’s still chasing members of the fairy race and some humans." Yao Qilin then told them something else. "By the way, I met a male evil dragon in the abyss, but I don’t know what kind of dragon he was, and we also encountered the soul of an ancient being trapped down there."
"Who is the male evil dragon you’re referring to?" Xie Heilong and Long Gui asked at the same time.

"His name is Long Fei, and his cultivation is still at the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm." Both Xie Heilong and Long Gui tried to search for the name in their memories, but Yao Qilin immediately spoke again. "He’s not native to this realm, and he ascended from the Three Mortal Realms about five years ago. I wanted to recruit him, but he refused my offer, and he preferred to stay with the soul-devouring demon race because they helped him adapt to this realm."
"Why don’t you force him to go with you?" A man who was the transformation of the War Devil Beast, Chi You, asked her. "With his cultivation that low, it’s easy for you to take him by force."

Yao Qilin shook her head. "You haven’t met him, so you underestimate him, Chi You. Even though his cultivation is too low, he is not afraid of me at all. Moreover, that man’s soul tried to suppress us, but he didn’t cower in the slightest, and he maintained a relaxed attitude in front of the two of us, which made me afraid of him instead."
"That’s weird." Chi You spoke as he frowned.

"That’s not weird, right?" The Three-Eyed Demon Ape, Zhuyan, spoke. "Have you forgotten about Long Wuzhao? The first time he ascended to this realm, he had no connections or power, but he fearlessly faced all his opponents, including our four leaders. In the end, he succeeded in establishing himself in the Divine Origin Main Domain, and he also conquered all the beast races there, including those dragons, making the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain the strongest now."

Chi You nodded in agreement. "I once fought Long Xukong in the past, and I almost died at his hands. However, I heard that Long Wuzhao managed to render him powerless, even though he was the ruler of the void."

"Therefore, we cannot underestimate Long Fei, or we will be too late if he already becomes the second Long Wuzhao." Xie Heilong then asked Yao Qilin. "Have you met people from the soul-devouring demon race to ask about him?"

Yao Qilin nodded slightly in response. "I’ve met Ye Futian, and he told me some unimportant things about Long Fei. However, Princess Wangzi liked him, and he also enjoyed being with her. I’ve offered them huge compensation, but they didn’t want to let him go."

"I see." Xie Heilong nodded in understanding. "We have two issues that must be properly addressed, or we will be the ones facing trouble. First is that mysterious person with the light element, and second is Fei Long. Once we return, I will meet Lord Taotie and the others to report these matters, and we will wait for their decision before we move. So, how much time do we have left before we can get out of this dungeon?"
None of them could answer Xie Heilong because the darkness inside the dungeon caused them to lose track of time, making him sigh.
"I think there’s still a few hours left before morning, so we should move again to capture more people." The Blood-Horned Xiezhi, Xie Zhi, spoke.
They agreed with Xie Zhi, and most of them scattered in various directions, unaware that Long Wuzhao and the others were hiding nearby, primarily due to Long Xukong’s void protection.
Long Xukong, Long Wuzhao, Tianshi Bailong, Feng Yao’s three subordinates, and several senior cultivators immediately followed them.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [4], Luo Yunxiao, Zhuxian Sheng, and Tianshi Shengjie remained there, protected by Long Youjia’s void shield. They observed Yao Qilin, who did not leave the colosseum and ordered his subordinates to hunt down those people.
They saw Yao Qilin approach several women who caught her attention, and one of them was Guang Yue, the female sect master of the Sun Moon Sect.
"What do you think Yao Qilin will do to Guang Yue, Husband?" Luo Yunxiao asked.
Zhang Fei [4] shook his head before raising an eyebrow, as he saw Yao Qilin kiss Guang Yue and absorb her Qi. "Hmm? What kind of technique did she learn? Why did she absorb her Qi?"

"I’ve heard of a technique, but I don’t know if that female beast learned it." Zhang Fei [4] and the others looked at Zhuxian Sheng. "If I remember correctly, the name of that technique is the Living Furnace Method. The users do not need to engage in dual cultivation with their victims; they only need to make physical contact, such as mouth-to-mouth. They forcefully absorb their Qi, life essence, and cultivation foundation."
"Such an evil technique!" Tianshi Shengjie spoke with a frown. ’I recall you have two similar techniques, right?’
Zhang Fei [4] nodded at her. ’My Demon Absorbing technique and Devouring technique are similar to her technique, but her technique seems different from mine.’ "I will go there to meet Yao Qilin."
"Are you crazy?" Zhuxian Sheng asked with a serious tone. "Yao Qilin is much stronger than you, and she will kill you if you go to see her now."

"Actually, I’ve met Yao Qilin before, and we spent some time together in the abyss. In fact, she wanted to recruit me to join them, but I rejected her." Zhuxian Sheng looked confused by this, but he didn’t know anything about Zhang Fei [4]. "Let’s do it now! I’ll go find her to distract her, so you guys can save those people."
"Hey—"
"Leave it to my husband, Senior Zhuxian." Zhuxian Sheng turned to Luo Yunxiao, but Tianshi Shengjie and Long Youjia also agreed with her, further confusing him. "You can move now, Husband."

Zhang Fei [4] wanted to move, but several enormous explosions suddenly sounded from various directions, and they could see golden light in the distance, the source of which came from Long Wuzhao. "They’ve started fighting."
"Zhang Fei! Yao Qilin wants to leave, so you should move now." Tianshi Shengjie urged him.
Zhang Fei [4] disappeared from their sight, transformed into his half-dragon form, and appeared before Yao Qilin.

"What are you doing here?" Yao Qilin asked Zhang Fei [4] in surprise, glancing towards the location where the golden light appeared. ’Shit! There is only one person who can use such a bright golden light, and that person is Long Wuzhao. How could he suddenly appear in this dungeon? Could Long Xukong be here too?’

"Hey! I’m right in front of you, but you’re looking the other way." Zhang Fei [4] stole a glance at those people. "I was just passing through this area, and I saw you here, so I decided to come down to meet you. By the way, who are these people? Are they your targets?"

"They are indeed our targets, and we will take them to our domain once the exit opens," Yao Qilin replied without looking at him, and he was more focused on the battles in those areas. "I don’t have time for you now, and I have to go help my comrades. If you want to talk, you can wait for me here, and we’ll talk after I come back."
Zhang Fei [4] grabbed her hand when she wanted to fly away, and he used his dream lordship ability on her directly. "Why are you in such a hurry to leave?"
"Our enemies have just appeared, and I must help them." Yao Qilin pushed Zhang Fei [4]’s hand away and wanted to fly away, but extreme drowsiness overcame her. "What—"

Within seconds, Yao Qilin fell into a deep sleep, but Zhang Fei [4] swiftly supported her. "Hehe! No matter how strong you are, you won’t be able to withstand my dream lordship ability. You should sleep now, and they will be dead when you wake up."

Seeing that, Tianshi Shengjie and the others came out of their hiding place. They moved quickly to enter the colosseum to free those people, but Zhuxian Sheng stopped beside Zhang Fei [4]. "Who exactly are you? How can I smell the demon and beast auras from your body?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1206: Free The Hostages
paragraphs: "Didn’t Feng Yao say anything about me?"
Zhuxian Sheng raised an eyebrow slightly. "The crimson-haired woman only asked me to train you."

"I see." Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding. "Everyone on my side knows that I have three identities, and this evil dragon form is my beast identity. At first, I was not a dragon; instead, I found a dead real dragon in a realm. I inherited many things from it, and I became an evil dragon ever since."
"That’s—"

"My husband didn’t lie to you." Luo Yunxiao approached them. "We were born on the same planet, and we grew up together for ten years. He was born as a mortal in a world without Qi, but fate had other plans for him. If you don’t believe us, I will share our childhood memories with you."

"Please." Luo Yunxiao then shared their childhood memories with Zhuxian Sheng, convincing him that Zhang Fei [4] was indeed born a mortal. "Then, what is your third identity? How did you become like this? It should be impossible for a living being to have three identities, but I can’t sense your demon and beast auras when you’re in your human form."

"Someone higher than an ancient being accidentally killed me and resurrected me." Zhuxian Sheng wore a look of disbelief after hearing that, but Zhang Fei [4] instantly transformed into his demon form, making his beast aura disappear. "As you can see, my other identity is a lust demon, a transcendent one to be precise. I don’t know what that person did to me because I died at the time, and I’ve had my three identities ever since."

Zhuxian Sheng found it difficult to believe, but he was sure that Zhang Fei [4]’s three identities were real. "I’ve heard of the ancient races, and my late master was one of them, but he never told me about a living being higher than them."
"Huh?" Luo Yunxiao and Zhang Fei [4] were shocked by this. "How could you have an ancient being as your master?"

Since Zhang Fei [4] had already shared some of his secrets, Zhuxian Sheng decided to reveal a few of his own. "This Paradise Realm is much wider and more mysterious than you two can imagine, and there are many dungeons like this one out there. I met my master in one of them thousands of years ago, but he was already in a dying state when we met. He chose me as his disciple because we both have the time element, and he also passed on his special physique to me."
"The Ancestral Battle Saint Physique."

Zhuxian Sheng nodded at them. "Many people think I was born with it, but I inherited it from my late master. His Shizu Clan was once one of the ten strongest clans in the Ancient Realm, but a mysterious man destroyed it. He also destroyed several other ancient clans, one of which was the Ancient Nether Clan.
"Husband."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded to Luo Yunxiao. "Yuan Xiajie is a member of the Ancient Nether Clan, but I didn’t expect her clan to be destroyed."
"Oh?" Zhuxian Sheng was surprised to hear that. "Do you really know someone from the Ancient Nether Clan?"

"No." Zhang Fei [4] then told Zhuxian Sheng about his meeting with Yuan Xiajie. "She kidnapped one of my women, but I have no clue as to her whereabouts. Feng Yao should know her hideout, but she’s unwilling to tell me the truth."

"The ancient races have the same cultivation levels as us, but they have advantages that cultivators in this realm don’t have, which makes them several times stronger than us. Given your current strength, you are unable to face the cultivators here, so it is unwise to consider seeking Yuan Xiajie; otherwise, you will die at her hands." Zhuxian Sheng then took out the black spear that Feng Yao gave him. "Who exactly is that crimson-haired woman? This spear is the Sky Breaking Spear, one of the best weapons in the ancient realm, but my late master said that it has been lost since the era of his great-grandfather. It turned out this spear was in her hand, and she gave it to me in exchange for training you."

Zhang Fei [4] released a soft sigh. "Feng Yao’s identity is more complicated than you imagine, but we shouldn’t talk about this now. Once we return to my sect, you can ask her directly. However, I’m sure she won’t tell you the truth, as she is still hiding her true identity from me."
"Hey guys, come here now! We have to send these people out right now!" Tianshi Shengjie shouted from a distance.
"Let’s go there." Zhuxian Sheng stored the spear in his storage ring and walked toward those people.
Zhang Fei [4] shouldered the unconscious Yao Qilin and led Luo Yunxiao over to them; he gave them Qi recovery and healing pills, especially cultivators like Nong Qinwei, Yin Chang, and Guang Yue.
"Thank you for saving us, Zhang Fei." Nong Qinwei weakly spoke.
"No need." Zhang Fei [4] asked Luo Yunxiao and the others to distribute the pills to the others. "I will send you guys out, but please refrain from talking about my abilities in public."
"Our lips are sealed." Guang Yue and then others nodded.
Yin Chang then asked him. "Why don’t you kill this female evil beast?"

"Why should I kill her?" Zhang Fei [4] responded with a headshake. "She didn’t do anything to me, and I’m not a cold-blooded killer either. Furthermore, I’m a dual cultivator, and my sect is still far behind most of the supreme sects in this realm. It would be a shame if I killed her when I can use her for many things, one of which is being a protector of my sect."

’Tch! He already has two powerful beasts by his side, and if he also appoints this female evil beast to be his sect’s protector, then we will lose our chance to seize the floating plateau.’ Guang Yue could only grumble in her heart.
"But—"
"Stop it, Chang’er." Nong Qinwei interrupted Yin Chang. "Once again, thank you for saving us, and we will not interfere with your decision regarding this female evil beast."
Zhang Fei [4] suddenly had an idea. "How about you wait for me at my sect? I have some ideas related to our ’profession’, and I have an offer for the two of you."
Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang understood Zhang Fei [4]’s meaning, and the two exchanged glances for a moment before nodding. "Alright, we’ll wait for you at your sect, and we’ll talk after you return."
"That’s good."

After Tianshi Shengjie and the others helped those people swallow the pills, Zhang Fei [4] immediately opened the gate to the Twin Flames domain and sent all of them out of the dungeon. He asked those powerful cultivators to take the people who were still unconscious to a safe place, as he would rather not waste his time taking care of them.
Since Yao Qilin wouldn’t wake up before he freed her subconscious, Zhang Fei [4] sent her into the training space, and one of his wives immediately took her to the pavilion.
"Shall we join them to fight those beasts?" Tianshi Shengjie asked.

"No need." Zhang Fei [4] took out the memory extractor and displayed the battles in various areas. The first one they saw was the battle between Su Shentian and Jian Kuang against the Nine-Headed Evil Bird, Jiu Niao.
They could see that Jiu Niao was overwhelmed by Su Shentian and Jian Kuang, and his entire body was covered in blood from their fierce attacks.
"He’s just waiting to die." They agreed with Zhuxian Sheng.
In another area, they saw Long Xukong mercilessly beating the War Devil Beast, Chi You, leaving him badly battered beyond recognition. "Your father seems to really hate that beast, Youjia."

"Haha." Long Youjia laughed at Tianshi Shengjie’s words. "You should still remember the old history between them, so you shouldn’t be surprised if my father behaves like that towards Chi You. However, I think he won’t kill that evil beast, and he might do something else to him."
"Yes." Tianshi Shengjie nodded in agreement.

They then looked at several other areas, where Huo Lanyin, Huo Yu’er, and Huo Hao’er were fighting three other evil mythical beasts and their subordinates. The Corrupted Dragon-Tiger, the Man-Eating Beast, and the Three-Eyed Demon Ape were completely helpless before the three women.
"Who are those three women? How could they easily beat those evil beasts?" Zhuxian Sheng asked in disbelief.

"The three of them are Empress Huo Yanling’s aides." Zhuxian Sheng looked at Zhang Fei [4] in shock. "In fact, Feng Yao is her reincarnation, so you shouldn’t be surprised if they can be that strong."
"I see." Zhuxian Sheng then watched another fight, where Li Tianyu, Lan Yueru, Jia Lingzhu, and Jia Shengyun gang up on the Blood-Horned Xiezhi, Xie Zhi, and his subordinates.

Tianshi Bailong, assisted by Beiming Youhuang, fought against The Two-Headed Ghost Dragon, Long Gui. Meanwhile, Long Wuzhao alone faced the strongest among the evil beasts, the Evil Black Dragon, Xie Heilong.

Zhang Fei [4] exhaled softly. "Long Wuzhao and the others are too strong for those evil beasts, so we don’t need to go there to help them. Instead, we’ll go to the last place, the Endless Night Labyrinth, and head to the palace."
"Let’s go, Husband. The others are waiting for us there, and I want to leave this dungeon soon."

chapters.title: Chapter 1207: Eight Area: Crucible
paragraphs: While Long Wuzhao and the others were facing those evil beasts, Feltia [2] had already arrived at the eighth place, the Endless Night Crucible.

The Endless Night Crucible was once the trial ground of the Silver Moon Clan, where disciples tempered their strength under harsh conditions. It was a vast chamber of black stone, its walls engraved with many sigils that channel both qi and crushing pressure, and a black stone stele stood tall at the back end.

In the past, clan heirs were brought here to endure ordeals of body and soul. The crucible would unleash the intense suppression of moonlight and illusory trials to push cultivators beyond their limits. Those who survived gained stronger control over their qi and awakened their bloodline.

After the clan’s fall, the crucible remained active but corrupted by time. The trials no longer followed any orders and struck with unpredictable intensity. Silver flames seeped from cracks in the floor, forming spectral beasts, while the pressure has increased so much that even experienced cultivators risk being crushed by it. Despite its dangers, many cultivators frequently sought the Crucible because it could strengthen both their bodies and souls.
Feltia [2] saw many cultivators there, including some people from the Divine Samsara Sect, who were in a different group from Jin Nanqing’s.

Feltia [2] also discovered another group from the Jiao Clan, led by Jiao Huanfeng and an old woman named Jiao Danying. He saw three familiar faces in their group, who were none other than Jiao Yunbai, Jiao Meili, and Jiao Moli.
[Master.]

Feltia [2] nodded slightly. ’Back in the Divine Samsara Sect, Jiao Huanfeng ordered Jiao Yunbai to keep an eye on Yunxiao, and he lusted over her, but he couldn’t do anything because Huo Ling fenced the temple area with her fire element. Since I have encountered him here again, I must take action against him for daring to have such thoughts about my wife."
[Hahaha! What a possessive husband!]

’If you were my wife, I would do the same, Mei.’ The female AI fell silent after Feltia [2] made that statement. ’Hmm? The system can’t detect the strength of those spectral beasts, but I know they’re powerful. Furthermore, they seem to be able to see through my invisibility, so I have to move carefully.’
[Master.]
’What is it, Mei?’
[Nothing.]
’Hmm?’ Feltia [2] raised an eyebrow. ’What are you trying to say?’

[I said nothing, and you should focus on them.] Feltia [2] released a soft sigh, as he often couldn’t understand Mei, even though she had lived with him and helped him for more than two decades. [Master, look at the silver flame at the top of the black stone stele. It is one of the ten heavenly flames, the Moon Flame.]
Feltia [2] immediately looked in that direction. ’I didn’t expect to find the moon flame in this dungeon, and these people seemed to be targeting it too.’

[Master, if you manage to obtain the Moon Flame, you only need to find the remaining two flames to complete your Yin-Yang Fire Art. I don’t have any information about the Chaotic Flame, but the Sun Flame is probably in the domain of the Golden Sun Clan, the Zenith Solar Sanctum.]

Feltia [2] nodded in agreement. ’The Silver Moon Clan is associated with the moon and Yin, and the Golden Sun Clan is associated with the sun and Yang. Since the Moon Flame is in this dungeon, the Sun Flame is probably in there. However, that dungeon won’t open until another thousand years, so I have no way to enter before then.’
[You should meet Tian Taiyang in the abyss again, Master. He is a former member of the Golden Sun Clan, and he surely knows the entrance to the Zenith Solar Sanctum.]
’Yeah.’ Feltia [2] thought of a way to do something to Jiao Yunbai and how to approach the Moon Flame without those spectral beasts noticing.

[Master, I’m sure they won’t be able to take the Moon Flame, so you don’t need to worry about it. Look at them; they’re already overwhelmed by those spectral beasts, and many of them are seriously injured. Therefore, I think you should wait for them to leave this dungeon first, and you can come back here again later. If your real body and five clones team up, I’m sure you can deal with these spectral beasts more easily, and you can get the flame later.]
Feltia [2] agreed with that. ’How many hours until the portal opens, Mei?’
[An hour.]

’An hour, huh?’ Feltia [2] then checked the battles in other areas. He found Huo Lanyin, Huo Yu’er, and Huo Hao’er had succeeded in defeating the Corrupted Dragon-Tiger, the Man-Eating Beast, and the Three-Eyed Demon Ape. They did not kill the three beasts, as their death would alert the four perils, and Feng Yao also ordered them to capture them alive.
Feltia [2] saw Long Xukong had defeated the War Devil Beast, Chi You. The void dragon didn’t kill the beast; instead, he confined him using a void prison and sent him to the void.
Seeing that, the other clone immediately asked Bing Xingying to use her real body to retrieve Chi You from the void, as he needed him for another purpose.

In another area, Feltia [2] found Li Tianyu, Lan Yueru, Jia Lingzhu, and Jia Shengyun had defeated the Blood-Horned Xiezhi, Xie Zhi. Since he had asked them not to kill the beast, they did not kill him and sealed his cultivation before taking him away toward the labyrinth.

Tianshi Bailong and Beiming Youhuang also managed to defeat the Two-Headed Ghost Dragon, Long Gui. The beast attempted to explode his cultivation core, but the female fairy thwarted his intentions, and she sealed his cultivation as per Feltia [2]’s request.

Feltia [2] could only sigh when she saw the sword maniac kill the Nine-Headed Evil Bird, Jiu Niao. He could do nothing to stop Jian Kuang because the beast slaughtered the people of his hometown, forcing him to accept it.
To Feltia [2]’s surprise, Long Wuzhao failed to defeat the Evil Black Dragon, Xie Heilong, as the evil beast used something to escape from him. ’What kind of technique is that, Mei?’

[Master, Xie Heilong sacrificed his beast essence to escape from Long Wuzhao, but his action only caused him to suffer heavy injuries. Moreover, he couldn’t possibly escape from this dungeon, and he should be hiding in other areas, so I’ll track his whereabouts now.]

’Alright, inform me once you find him, and I’ll go meet him directly.’ As May had expected, Feltia [2] saw the people inside the crucible starting to flee in a state full of injuries. He couldn’t care less about the other cultivators because he never had problems with them, but he was eager to attack Jiao Huanfeng and Jiao Yunbai.

Feltia [2] didn’t immediately move from his hiding spot and followed the movements of the Jiao Clan’s people through his map, and he also searched for the whereabouts of the fairy race members under Jia Fenglie, who had previously fled from Fei Lian.

After he discovered their location, Feltia [2] contacted Fei Lian and informed her of the Fairy Race’s location, but he forbade her from killing Jia Fenglie because he needed an insider to monitor the movements of the Fairy King, Jia Zizhen.

Feltia [2] then searched for the whereabouts of Feng Bingying, Feng Shizhu, and the other ice phoenixes. He found them gathered in one place at the end of the dungeon, and Mei told him that their location was the coldest compared to the other areas.
Long Wuzhao suddenly appeared beside Feltia [2] and sighed heavily. "Damn it! I didn’t expect that Xie Heilong would sacrifice his beast essence to escape from me, and I’ve lost track of him now."

"Haha." Feltia [2] laughed at that. "Xie Heilong may have managed to escape from you, but he won’t be able to escape from this dungeon. My other clones are trying to track his whereabouts now, and they will probably find him soon."
"What’s your plan for him?" Feltia [2] immediately told Long Wuzhao about his plan regarding Xie Heilong and the other evil mythical beasts, shocking him. "Do you really want to do that?"

Feltia [2] nodded at him. "Finding many defenseless mythical beasts at once is very difficult, so I won’t waste this opportunity. Most of my wives are ordinary humans, so I’ll turn some of them into those mythical beasts, like I got the Calamity Demon Dragon."
"That’s true." Long Wuzhao put on a serious expression and asked him again. "What about your Cursed Demon Heart? Is it affecting you more and more?"
Feltia [2] smiled when he heard that, and he shared his memories of the time he almost fell under the control of the Cursed Demon Heart with Long Wuzhao.

Long Wuzhao watched them for a while before sighing in relief and patting his shoulder. "To tell you the truth, I planned to kill you if the Cursed Demon Heart managed to control you, as you would be a great threat to this universe. However, the result was beyond my expectations, and you managed to take control of it."

"Haha." Feltia [2] laughed in response. "If someone else said he wanted to kill me, I would kill that person straight away. However, I understand your reasons for wanting to kill me, and you are too strong for me, so I will consider it a passing thing."
Long Wuzhao just smiled. "What are your next plans?"

’Yeah.’ Feltia [2] thought of a way to do something to Jiao Yunbai and how to approach the Moon Flame without those spectral beasts noticing.
[Master, I’m sure they won’t be able to take the Moon Flame, so you don’t need to worry about it.
Look at them; they’re already overwhelmed by those spectral beasts, and many of them are seriously injured.
Therefore, I think you should wait for them to leave this dungeon first, and you can come back here again later.
If your real body and five clones team up, I’m sure you can deal with these spectral beasts more easily, and you can get the flame later.]
Feltia [2] agreed with that. ’How many hours until the portal opens, Mei?’
[An hour.]
’An hour, huh?’ Feltia [2] then checked the battles in other areas.
He found Huo Lanyin, Huo Yu’er, and Huo Hao’er had succeeded in defeating the Corrupted Dragon-Tiger, the Man-Eating Beast, and the Three-Eyed Demon Ape.
They did not kill the three beasts, as their death would alert the four perils, and Feng Yao also ordered them to capture them alive.
Feltia [2] saw Long Xukong had defeated the War Devil Beast, Chi You.
The void dragon didn’t kill the beast; instead, he confined him using a void prison and sent him to the void.
Seeing that, the other clone immediately asked Bing Xingying to use her real body to retrieve Chi You from the void, as he needed him for another purpose.
In another area, Feltia [2] found Li Tianyu, Lan Yueru, Jia Lingzhu, and Jia Shengyun had defeated the Blood-Horned Xiezhi, Xie Zhi.
Since he had asked them not to kill the beast, they did not kill him and sealed his cultivation before taking him away toward the labyrinth.
Tianshi Bailong and Beiming Youhuang also managed to defeat the Two-Headed Ghost Dragon, Long Gui.
The beast attempted to explode his cultivation core, but the female fairy thwarted his intentions, and she sealed his cultivation as per Feltia [2]’s request.
Feltia [2] could only sigh when she saw the sword maniac kill the Nine-Headed Evil Bird, Jiu Niao.
He could do nothing to stop Jian Kuang because the beast slaughtered the people of his hometown, forcing him to accept it.
To Feltia [2]’s surprise, Long Wuzhao failed to defeat the Evil Black Dragon, Xie Heilong, as the evil beast used something to escape from him. ’What kind of technique is that, Mei?’
[Master, Xie Heilong sacrificed his beast essence to escape from Long Wuzhao, but his action only caused him to suffer heavy injuries.
Moreover, he couldn’t possibly escape from this dungeon, and he should be hiding in other areas, so I’ll track his whereabouts now.]
’Alright, inform me once you find him, and I’ll go meet him directly.’ As May had expected, Feltia [2] saw the people inside the crucible starting to flee in a state full of injuries.
He couldn’t care less about the other cultivators because he never had problems with them, but he was eager to attack Jiao Huanfeng and Jiao Yunbai.

Feltia [2] didn’t immediately move from his hiding spot and followed the movements of the Jiao Clan’s people through his map, and he also searched for the whereabouts of the fairy race members under Jia Fenglie, who had previously fled from Fei Lian.

After he discovered their location, Feltia [2] contacted Fei Lian and informed her of the Fairy Race’s location, but he forbade her from killing Jia Fenglie because he needed an insider to monitor the movements of the Fairy King, Jia Zizhen.
Feltia [2] then searched for the whereabouts of Feng Bingying, Feng Shizhu, and the other ice phoenixes.
He found them gathered in one place at the end of the dungeon, and Mei told him that their location was the coldest compared to the other areas.
Long Wuzhao suddenly appeared beside Feltia [2] and sighed heavily.
"Damn it!
I didn’t expect that Xie Heilong would sacrifice his beast essence to escape from me, and I’ve lost track of him now."
"Haha." Feltia [2] laughed at that.
"Xie Heilong may have managed to escape from you, but he won’t be able to escape from this dungeon.
My other clones are trying to track his whereabouts now, and they will probably find him soon."
"What’s your plan for him?" Feltia [2] immediately told Long Wuzhao about his plan regarding Xie Heilong and the other evil mythical beasts, shocking him.
"Do you really want to do that?"
Feltia [2] nodded at him.
"Finding many defenseless mythical beasts at once is very difficult, so I won’t waste this opportunity.
Most of my wives are ordinary humans, so I’ll turn some of them into those mythical beasts, like I got the Calamity Demon Dragon."
"That’s true." Long Wuzhao put on a serious expression and asked him again.
"What about your Cursed Demon Heart?
Is it affecting you more and more?"
Feltia [2] smiled when he heard that, and he shared his memories of the time he almost fell under the control of the Cursed Demon Heart with Long Wuzhao.
Long Wuzhao watched them for a while before sighing in relief and patting his shoulder.
"To tell you the truth, I planned to kill you if the Cursed Demon Heart managed to control you, as you would be a great threat to this universe.
However, the result was beyond my expectations, and you managed to take control of it."
"Haha." Feltia [2] laughed in response.
"If someone else said he wanted to kill me, I would kill that person straight away.
However, I understand your reasons for wanting to kill me, and you are too strong for me, so I will consider it a passing thing."
Long Wuzhao just smiled.
"What are your next plans?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1208: Clear The Labyrinth
paragraphs: "I don’t have any special plans for now. My real body focused on helping my main wives, who have not yet reached the Five Celestial Realms. After this, most of my clones will also focus on their wives, and my fifth clone will take care of the sect. When they reach that stage, I’ll take them to many domains to find dungeons like this one." Long Wuzhao nodded to Feltia [2], who immediately stood up. "I’ll do something to my two targets first, and I’ll go to the labyrinth after."
"I’ll wait for you there."
After Long Wuzhao disappeared, Feltia [2] hurriedly went to the location where the Jiao Clan members were resting.

"Damn it! Those spectral beasts are stronger than I previously imagined! Even with my cultivation at the 1-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, I almost died at their hands." Jiao Huanfeng grumbled to himself as he applied ointment to his wounds. "How are your injuries, Danying?"

Jiao Danying shook her head slightly. "My injuries aren’t as severe as yours, but my Qi is greatly depleted due to my previous technique. I actually didn’t want to use it, but I had no other choice; otherwise, we would have died at the hands of those spectral beasts."

"Yeah." Jiao Huanfeng sighed heavily. "According to the story, this dungeon once belonged to an ancient clan, but a massive disaster wiped them out. Those spectral beasts were probably formed from the souls of the clan members who died at that time, which is why they are so powerful. By the way, you can rest now, and I will stand guard for now."
"Alright." Jiao Danying leaned against the tree behind her and closed her eyes to rest her body and mind. In a few moments, she had fallen into a deep sleep, followed by the other clan members.
"Why did I suddenly become sleepy?" Jiao Huanfeng tried to maintain his consciousness and circulate his Qi, but he eventually fell into a deep sleep.
Feltia [2] immediately appeared in their midst, squatted by Jiao Huanfeng’s side, and touched the old man’s head.

As soon as Feltia [2] used the Mind-Seizing Illusion Art that he learned from Shang Ziyuan, many memories of Jiao Huanfeng flowed into his mind. He frowned upon discovering that the old man had contacted someone back in the Divine Samsara Sect. "Nine Nether Demon Race, huh? What exactly is their goal? They invaded those clans from the Nirvana Sky Main Domain and got Old Ma killed in the past, but now they also invaded other clans from other domains."

Initially, Feltia [2] wanted to kill Jiao Huanfeng, but his discovery forced him to abandon his intention. Instead, he used soul manipulation on the old man to replicate his soul, and he merged it with his own soul.
Feltia [2] considered altering Jiao Huanfeng’s memories, but he changed his mind and brought the old man to Jiao Yunbai, who had fallen asleep a short distance away.
[Hahaha!] Mei burst out laughing after she realized her master’s intention. [You are indeed the embodiment of evil, Master!]

"Since he dared to lust after Yunxiao, I will teach him a lesson that he will remember for the rest of his life." Feltia [2] used the body modification ability on Jiao Yunbai and turned him into a woman.
[They might commit suicide after this, Master.]

"I hope this old man does not commit suicide out of shame, as I will lose a spy to monitor the Nine Nether Demon Race." Feltia [2] stripped both of them naked before placing Jiao Yunfeng on top of Jiao Yunbai, who had already become a woman. He then used his sexual abilities on them, arousing both of them instantly. "Enjoy your night."

Feltia [2] released all of them from the effects of his dream abilities before leaving the scene, and the fully aroused Jiao Yuanfeng started to have sex with Jiao Yunbai, causing him to grimace in pain.

Feltia [2] didn’t go to the labyrinth directly, but instead, he went to the location of the Fairy Race under Jia Fenglie’s leadership. He found the male fairy in a helpless condition with his body covered in wounds and blood after being severely beaten by Fei Lian, and his race members also died at the hands of her subordinates. "Did you kill those humans?"
"You asked me not to kill them." Fei Lian then questioned him. "What will you do to this old fairy?"

"The Fairy King is targeting me, so I need someone to watch him closely." Feltia [2] squatted beside Jia Fengli and used his soul manipulation ability on him, and he altered some of the male fairy’s memories to make him completely loyal.
"Why is the Fairy King targeting you?" Fei Lian curiously asked.

Feltia [2] shook his head in response. "For now, I won’t say anything to you just in case, as your four leaders are also targeting me. Eventually, you will know the problems between us, so you don’t need to be this curious."

"Alright then." Fei Lian sighed. "I didn’t expect you to have connections with Long Wuzhao, nor did I anticipate that you would bring them here to stop us. The sword maniac claimed Jiu Niao’s life, while your friends captured the remaining beasts. After sacrificing his beast essence to flee from the dragon emperor, Xie Heilong must have suffered serious injuries. If I and my subordinates return safely, our four leaders will definitely be suspicious of me."

Naturally, Feltia [2] had thought about that, and he touched Fei Lian’s body before using the body modification ability on her, making her appearance look like someone who had just been beaten. "This way, your four leaders will not suspect you, and you can help me monitor them closely."
"Tch! You lust demons are cheaters!" Fei Lian pointed to her subordinates. "You have to do it to them too, or my leaders will kill them."

Feltia [2] nodded slightly and immediately moved to Fei Lian’s subordinates, turning their bodies like seriously injured people. He also implanted his soul mark into their souls, so they wouldn’t be able to say anything about him. "Done."
"Are you going to kill Chi Yao and the others?"
"I haven’t thought about that, and I will decide their fate after we get out of this dungeon." Feltia [2]’s answer made Fei Lian sigh. "Do you want to join me in the labyrinth?"
"No." Fei Lian directly refused. "I would rather not meet Long Wuzhao and the others, so I’ll wait here until the exit opens."
"Take care then." After he gave Jia Fengli a healing pill, Feltia [2] immediately left the place and headed towards the labyrinth.
Fei Lian released a soft sigh before speaking to her subordinates. "Rest first! We’ll postpone our return until we leave this dungeon."
"Yes!"
When Feltia [2] arrived at the entrance of the labyrinth, Long Wuzhao and the others were already waiting for him there.
Some of them handed over the beasts they had previously captured to Feltia [2], who then sent them into the Yin-Yang Space after imprisoning their subconscious.
"Are you three going back now?" Feltia [2] asked the three dragons.
Long Wuzhao nodded at him. "We still have a lot of business to do in our domain, so we should head back now."
"I see." Feltia [2] immediately opened the gate to the Twin Flames Domain. "You three can go back now."

Long Wuzhao and Long Xukong immediately entered the gate, but Tianshi Bailong stopped at Feltia [2]’s side. "My daughter has told me everything, including her decision to stay by your side. Honestly, I dislike her decision because she is my princess, and I wish for her to marry someone who loves her unconditionally, just as I love my wife. However, I am aware that she has been interested in you since you still lived in the Sky Jade Realm, so I accept her decision."

"Senior, not all single men are good, and not all dual cultivators are bad. If you witness the relationship between all my wives, you will definitely never doubt me, and I will make Shengjie happy." Tianshi Bailong just nodded to Feltia [2] before entering the portal. "Let’s enter the labyrinth, and we have to reach the palace before the exit opens."

Feltia [2] immediately led them into the labyrinth, and they divided their group into five groups under the leadership of her and the other four clones. He asked Feng Yao to take them to the palace directly, but she refused and asked them to go there manually. "I’ll smack your ass one day."
"Haha." Feng Yao laughed softly. "As long as you haven’t surpassed me, you’ll never be able to do that."

Feltia [2] could only sigh inwardly, and he returned his focus to leading the people toward the Endless Night Palace. Fortunately, the labyrinth didn’t obstruct the system map, so he and the other four clones were able to lead them to avoid the traps within it.
[Quest: Clearing the Endless Night Labyrinth.]
[Quest rank: Medium]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Medium gift pack x 1 sent to the inventory.]

A notification appeared in their minds when they exited the labyrinth, but Feltia [2] and three other clones right away returned to the training space. All his wives who were at that place also returned there, leaving only Zhang Fei [5] to lead them.
"I won’t join you." Feng Yao then handed a key to Feltia [2]. "Use it to unlock the seal on the door, but you shouldn’t take them there."

chapters.title: Chapter 1209: Meeting Yin Yue
paragraphs: [Quest: Explore ten dungeon areas.]
[Quest rank: Easy]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Easy gift pack x 1 sent to the inventory.]

Zhang Fei [5], accompanied by Tian Huangjin and Tian Shengjie, casually walked towards the throne room. Meanwhile, the other cultivators spread out to several other areas of the Endless Night Palace, checking those areas.
"I’ve been here several times, but this palace still feels creepy to me." Tian Huangjin spoke as she walked beside Zhang Fei [5].
Zhang Fei [5] turned to her in amusement. "You fearlessly pursued Xereth to the Three Mortal Realms by yourself, but this place gives you such a feeling."
"Hey! This palace used to belong to an ancient race, okay?" Tian Huangjin immediately refuted him. "Xereth may be strong, but he’s not as strong as an ancient."
"Hehe." Tianshi Shengjie chuckled. "Actually, Huangjin has nyctophobia despite being a member of a winged race and possessing a pure light element. She—"
"Stop! Don’t say anything, Shengjie!" Tian Huangjin shouted.

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] softly laughed. "Honestly, it doesn’t matter if we have fear of something. Even if we are strong cultivators, we are still living creatures with feelings. However, we cannot allow our fear to overcome us; instead, we must overcome it to develop further."
"Do you have a fear of something?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "My biggest fear is making them sad, and they almost experienced it when the Cursed Demon Heart fully awakened. Luckily, my grandmother came to me and saved me, and I managed to take control of the heart from its previous owner."
"I see."

Tianshi Shengjie then spoke. "Although you already have control over your heart, you must still seek the Supreme Bodhi Heart. This way, you can prevent the worst possibility, such as the heart escaping from your control."
"Yeah."
Before long, they had arrived in front of the throne room, and Zhang Fei [5] took out the key that Feng Yao had previously given him to open the seal.

Unlike Zhang Fei [5], both Tianshi Shengjie and Tian Huangjin became tense and nervous, sensing the aura emanating from within. ’This woman has been dead for millions of years, but her aura is still terrifying.’
"Wait here; I’ll go inside myself." Both women nodded to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately walked into the throne room.

"Welcome to my place, the heir of Hu Tianlang." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow slightly before shooting several small flames into the torches at the side of the room, illuminating the place and allowing him to see Yin Yue, who was chained on her throne. "Guang Zhiyi has already told me about you, so I’ve been waiting for your arrival."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately approached Yin Yue and stood in front of her. "Feng Yao has already told me that she sealed your soul here, but she hasn’t told me the reason behind her decision. So, what exactly happened? Why did she seal you here?"

"Can we not talk about that? That incident happened a million years ago, and it’s one of the regrets of my life; thus, I don’t want to remember it anymore." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding before activating her soul domain and releasing her soul, surprising Yin Yue. "A young soul cultivator with a half-perfection stage of the divine soul level."
Zhang Fei [5] looked at the chains binding Yin Yue’s soul, but he didn’t immediately free her, as he didn’t know much about her yet.
"What do you want to do?" Yin Yue asked with a frown as his soul touched hers.

Zhang Fei [5] let out a soft sigh. "I don’t like to meddle in others’ business, but some things require me to help you. Previously, I went to the mausoleum, and I met the souls of your four ancestors."
"Oh? Those old geezers left their souls there, huh?" Yin Yue was a bit surprised.

"They’re gone." Yin Yue nodded in understanding to Zhang Fei [5]. "They begged me to save your soul and help you revive your Silver Moon Clan. Apart from that, I still have another reason, but I can’t tell you anything."

Yin Yue narrowed her eyes at him. "How are you going to help me? My soul has weakened a lot, and I won’t be able to reshape my body with my current soul power. Moreover, I’m too tired after millions of years have passed, and I want to rest forever. If you can free my soul from these chains, I will immediately enter the circle of reincarnation."

"What kind of leader are you? You caused the destruction of your clan by asking Yin Shizi to create the Heaven-Demon Silver Annihilation technique for Yin Yuemo, which was the starting point of that disaster." Yin Yue frowned at Zhang Fei [5], not expecting that he managed to find that technique. "I’ve destroyed that book, so no one will be able to learn that technique again."

Yin Yue felt relieved after hearing that. "You’re right, the destruction of my Silver Moon Clan was my fault, because I was too ambitious. Back then, my clan was powerful, but the Golden Sun Clan was more powerful than us. The birth of Yin Yuemo with his two identities gave me new hope, but we don’t have a suitable technique for him. Therefore, I ordered Yin Shizi to create a new technique specifically for him, and the Heaven-Demon Silver Annihilation technique was the result."
"Unfortunately, the result was beyond your hope, and Yin Yuemo lost his mind as he transformed into a pure demon." Zhang Fei [5] added.

Yin Yue then continued. "Yin Yuemo knew that we never liked the Golden Sun Clan, and he inherited my ambition to become the strongest clan. He attacked that clan and killed many of their members, and his actions forced Tian Chongwen to lead their members to retaliate against him, which resulted in a devastating war between our two clans."

"From the memories of Tian Taiyang’s soul imprisoned at the bottom of the abyss, I already know what happened next." Yin Yue looked at Zhang Fei [5] with surprise. "The prolonged war resulted in a catastrophic disaster that affected both clans, leading to your and Tian Chongwen’s death. However, your soul didn’t immediately vanish, and you went berserk before killing many people from both clans. You killed his family before his eyes, and Tian Taiyang went berserk because he couldn’t accept it, and the two of you fought for a long period."

Yin Yue released a heavy sigh as she nodded to him. "Our fight was widespread, and it affected others. Guang Zhiyi, who was the guardian of the ancient races at that time, decided to make a move to stop us. Thereafter, she imprisoned my soul in this palace, and she imprisoned Tian Taiyang’s soul at the bottom of the abyss."

"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "So, what do you wish for now? Your soul has become too weak after millions of years have passed, but I have a way to strengthen it, and you can reshape your body in the future. "You fearlessly pursued Xereth to the Three Mortal Realms by yourself, but this place gives you such a feeling."
"Hey!

"Stop!

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] softly laughed.
"Honestly, it doesn’t matter if we have fear of something.

"Do you have a fear of something?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them.

Luckily, my grandmother came to me and saved me, and I managed to take control of the heart from its previous owner."

"Yeah."

"Oh?

"They begged me to save your soul and help you revive your Silver Moon Clan.
Apart from that, I still have another reason, but I can’t tell you anything."
Yin Yue narrowed her eyes at him.
