chapters.title: Chapter 1210: Leave The Dungeon
paragraphs: After Yin Yue agreed, Zhang Fei [5] implanted his soul mark into her soul. Then, he used the key from Feng Yao to free her soul, but she almost fell because her soul was simply too weak.

Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly carried Yin Yue into his arms, but she was shocked because he suddenly kissed her. She wanted to stop him, but she sensed his soul power entering her soul. ’Could this be because of the giant white lotus in his soul? His soul power is truly powerful for a young cultivator like him.’
After he sensed Yin Yue’s soul was strong enough, Zhang Fei [5] stopped kissing her. "For now, I will send you into my soul world, and no one will bother you there."
"Soul...soul world." Yin Yue stuttered. "Have... have you really formed your soul world?"
Zhang Fei [5] took Yin Yue into his soul world, but its size shocked her again. His soul world had already grown larger thanks to Luo Yunxiao’s help with her Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique.
"Unbelievable!" Yin Yue exclaimed in awe. "Although you are still young, you have already managed to create such a vast soul world!"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed and put Yin Yue down. "I have hundreds of women by my side, and almost all of them are soul cultivators. Their soul power helped my soul power develop much faster than other soul cultivators."
Yin Yue did not comment on it. "How did you create your white lotus?"

"I used the Lotus Ascension Art." Zhang Fei [5] then told her a few things about that technique. "Qing Qiu’er helped me fuse hundreds of white lotuses within my soul, making it as big as it is now. The sun will rise soon, and the exit will open. I’ll leave you here, but I’ll come back to help you."
"Thank you." Yin Yue sincerely said, and Zhang Fei [5] instantly disappeared from her sight. However, a figure suddenly appeared in front of her, shocking her. "Hu Tianlang."

"I didn’t expect to see you again, little girl." Hu Tianlang then informed her. "This is only a small part of my soul, to be precise, my benevolent soul. This soul has fused with his soul, and this world is the embodiment of his soul, which is why I can appear here."
Yin Yue released a soft sigh. "If only I had followed your advice back then, none of this would have happened, and my clan would never have perished."

"Regret always comes too late, right?" Yin Yue nodded at Hu Tianlang. "There’s no point in regretting what’s already happened; just move on. Although you’re dead now, you’re lucky to have met my successor, and he can help you come back to life."
"Why did you choose him as your successor?" Yin Yue curiously asked.
Hu Tianlang shook his head. "I didn’t choose him as my successor; instead, something else arranged for him to be my successor."
"Something else?" Yin Yue immediately thought of Feng Yao. "You mean the hidden force?"
"Oh?" Hu Tianlang was momentarily taken aback. "I guess you heard it from Guang Zhiyi, right?"
"She showed me the strange chains that bound her soul when she met me before." Hu Tianlang showed Yin Yue the same chains, which shocked her. "These—"

Hu Tianlang shook his head and hid the chains again. "Don’t ask anything, as I can’t tell you anything. In fact, all living beings have these chains in their souls, including you. Just like Guang Zhiyi, I’ve tried to remove them, but my efforts have always failed. At that time, I saw a glimpse of the future, and it gave me an idea."
"So, you chose to sacrifice yourself because of that vision, which has something to do with Zhang Fei, right?"
"I only saw a man with a combination of three identities, which turned out to be him." Hu Tianlang then pointed in one direction. "Don’t go near that area because my evil soul is imprisoned there."
"Your evil soul?"

Hu Tianlang nodded at her. "Long before I died, I had separated my evil soul from myself, and I imprisoned it in a hidden place. Zhang Fei had absorbed it, but he had not absorbed it completely, and he was still having difficulty controlling it. If you go there, it will absorb your soul, and you will die for sure."
"I understand." Hu Tianlang then led Yin Yue to another area, where they discussed many things.
Zhang Fei [5] had already taken the two women to leave the palace, and everyone else had also returned there, waiting for the exit to open.
"So, she decided to stay alive, right?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Feng Yao. "I spoke to Yin Yue earlier, and she decided to stay alive to rebuild her clan. For now, I’m letting her stay in my soul world, and she won’t be lonely there because the old fox lives there too."

"That’s good." Feng Yao then gave him another key. "You certainly already know its function, right? I hope you can persuade Tian Taiyang like you persuaded Yin Yue, so the Golden Sun Clan will exist once again."
Zhang Fei [5] received the key as he looked at Feng Yao with suspicion. ’Did you know all along that this day would come? You deliberately imprisoned their souls so that I could save them, right?’
’Haha.’ Feng Yao didn’t answer that. "Both the Silver Moon and Golden Sun Clans will be beneficial to you, so you must succeed in convincing Tian Taiyan, understand?"
Zhang Fei [5] sighed softly. "I don’t know if I can persuade him, but I’ll give it a try."
"That’s good." Feng Yao immediately disappeared from their sight, confusing Zhang Fei [5.
Feng Jiu immediately told him, "She will help you with something, and you can find it in the abyss."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] could immediately guess Feng Yao’s intentions.
After waiting for some time, Feng Yao returned to their location. However, the exit suddenly opened, and all of them were sent out of the dungeon.

When they arrived outside, they were greeted by the loud moans of a woman. They all immediately looked towards the owner of the voice, who was none other than Jiao Yunbai, who had been transformed by Zhang Fei [5] into a woman.

"Hahaha! What a horny old man!" Jian Kuang laughed out loud as soon as he recognized Jiao Huanfeng. "He clearly suffered a serious injury, but he couldn’t contain his lust and fucked the young woman wildly."

Jiao Huanfeng’s actions truly embarrassed Jiao Danying, Jiao Suyin, and the Jiao Clan members. However, they couldn’t recognize Jiao Yunbai, particularly because he was no longer a man. ’Who is she? How could he do it with her?’
’Elder Suyin.’ Jiao Moli whispered to Jiao Suyin while stealing glances at Zhang Fei [5].
Jiao Suyin shook her head at him. ’We are seriously injured, and those people are with him. Moreover, Huanfeng’s situation is not favorable, so we should return to our clan now.’

After saying that, Jiao Suyin immediately knocked Jiao Huanfeng unconscious, along with Jiao Yubai under her. She then took out her flying artifact and carried them both onto it, followed by the other clan members. After everyone boarded, she immediately took them to leave the Twin Flames Domain.

The remaining cultivators from other domains also returned to their respective domains, but their conditions were awful. Their numbers had decreased considerably, and many of them had suffered heavy injuries.

"Lanyin and the others still want to talk to you, so I’ll leave them with you, and I’ll take my parents back to the Blazing Nirvana Domain." Feng Yao then spoke to Zhuxian Sheng. "You should train him as best as you can, understand?"
Zhuxian Sheng nodded at her. "Don’t worry, I will keep my promise, and he will be ready to help you in the future."
"That’s good." Feng Yao immediately took her parents away.
Luo Fenghan then spoke to him. "We will return to our sect, and our children will continue their training at your place."

"Alright." After Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate to the Empyrean Main Domain, Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi immediately led the people from that domain to return, except for the two leaders of the Hidden Moon Sect, who were already waiting for him in his sect.

Zhang Fei [5] then ordered Jia Fengli to return to the Floral Mirage Domain, followed by Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu. The two old fairies still missed Jia Yuyan, but they could not remain absent for much longer, as this would raise Jia Zizhen’s suspicions about them.
Ye Futian decided to return to the Eternal Night Domain, bringing Ye Mingran’s two children and their clan members with him.
Since Nalan Wangzi decided to join the Moonlit Passion Sect, Nalan Huanzi led the members of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race to leave the domain.
Fei Lian led her subordinates to leave the domain, but they did not immediately return to the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain. Instead, she took them to another domain to delay their return.
Li Tianyu and his wife brought Hua Mei’er back with them, leaving Helian Xun’er, who decided to stay with Zhang Fei [5].
Tian Huangjin and Tianshi Shengjie asked the people of their two races to return to their respective domains; Only Tian Houtian and Tian Zhiling remained.
After everyone left, Zhang Fei [5] asked Qing Qiu’er to take everyone back to their sect first. "I’m going into the dungeon again to do something."

chapters.title: Chapter 1211: Deal With Tian Taiyang
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] was already standing on the side of the Endless Night Abyss, checking its base area. Since the map still couldn’t show anything, he immediately flew down at full speed, and he hurried to meet Tian Taiyang.
"I initially doubted you, but you actually know Guang Zhiyi." Tian Taiyang then pointed at Xie Heilong, who was unconscious in front of him. "She left this black dragon here for you."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately picked Xie Heilong up and threw him into the Yin-Yang Space, surprising Tian Taiyang. "I came here to give you two choices: First, you can stay in my soul world to recover your soul, and you can reform your body in the future. This way, your Gold Sun Clan will continue to exist, and you can rebuild it in the future. Second, I will purify the regrets in your soul, and you can enter the cycle of reincarnation afterward. For your information, I have already released Yin Yue, and she agreed to stay alive to repay her debt to her clan members. Although I don’t know either of your clans, I hope you both live and rebuild them."

"I’m used to her secretive attitude." Zhang Fei [5] then asked him. "Can you help me enter the Zenith Solar Sanctum?"
"So, people in this era call my Gold Sun Clan’s residence that, huh?" Tian Taiyang mumbled to himself. "What are you looking for there?"

"The Sun Flame." Tian Taiyang frowned at that, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately showed him seven of the ten heavenly flames he had already obtained. "I need the ten heavenly flames to perfect my fire technique, and the Moon Flames are in this place. That’s why I want to go to your clan because I’m sure the Sun Flame is there, and I just need to look for the Chaotic Flame after."

"I didn’t expect you to have obtained the Eternal Flame." Tian Taiyang muttered under his breath, looking at the flame. "The Sun Flame is indeed in my clan because it is our lifeblood and the source of our strength, just like the Moon Flame for the Silver Moon Clan."

Tian Taiyang nodded at him. "I can help you get in there, but I can’t help you with my low soul power. Therefore, I need to increase my soul power first, and I’ll take you there once it’s sufficient."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] then touched his soul. "I’ll help you with that, but I’ll imprint my soul mark into your soul for now. After you reshape your body, I’ll remove it straight away."

"The only person who can help me defeat them is Feng Yao, but I’m sure she won’t be willing to help me. Hmm? I think Bing Xingying’s real body can help me, so I’ll go see her now." Moments later, a void crack opened up beside Zhang Fei [5], and his sister-in-law walked out from within it. "Can you help me retrieve the Moon Flame? If you can, I’ll move it into the pavilion."

"Let me check first." Bing Xingying tried to confine the spectral beasts using her void element, but they were able to penetrate it. "These beasts are not real beasts, and they are much stronger than me, so I can’t help you."
Zhang Fei [5] was a little disappointed by that. "Thank you for coming here, and you can go back now."
"Sorry, I can’t help you." Bing Xingying immediately returned to the void.

Zhang Fei [5] looked toward the Endless Night Garden and considered taking all the herbs there, but he decided against it because Yin Yue needed them to rebuild her clan in the future. Moreover, Lillea and the others had already replicated them and planted them in the Sealed World Pearl, so he no longer needed them.
A while later, Zhang Fei [5] had already returned to the Moonlit Passion Sect, but Jian Kuang and Huo Lanyin immediately intercepted him.
"Let’s spar using swords."
"Let’s compete in alchemy."
Zhang Fei [5] smiled in amusement at their impatience, but he immediately summoned Zhang Xiaolong [3] out of the training space, allowing him to spar and compete with both of them at the same time.

Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] went to the training round with Jian Kuang, where they sparred for quite a long time. Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Huo Lanyin went to the alchemy hall, and they competed in alchemy for a few days there.
*Bam*
Jia Zizhen’s aura exploded after he heard Jia Fengli’s report, and he looked at the two old fairies. "Why didn’t you two save them? Why did you let them die?"

"My king, our location is far from them, and Fengli didn’t report their situation to us either." Jia Zizhen frowned deeply, but Jia Shengyun immediately summoned a qi screen. "As you can see, we joined forces with the others to fight the Blood-Horned Xiezhi, Xie Zhi, and his subordinates. That evil mythical beast was much stronger than we imagined, and it took us quite a long time to defeat him even though our numbers were quite large."
Jia Zizhen was more focused on watching the battle that appeared on the screen. "Where is that evil mythical beast now?"

"The Golden Dragon Emperor brought him and the other evil mythical beasts with him." Jia Lingzhu’s answer shocked him. "Actually, he didn’t come alone, but he brought Long Xukong and Tianshi Bailong with him. If it weren’t for their arrival, we wouldn’t have been able to defeat those beasts."

Jia Zizhen nodded with a grim expression. "Xie Zhi and the others are the four perils’ main generals, and their disappearance will give rise to new problems. Furthermore, I heard that Taotie and the other three have a relationship with a higher-level beast, and its strength surpasses Long Wuzhao’s. Therefore, I believe he will not kill them, or else he will trigger a war between the righteous and evil beast races."
"That’s true." The two old fairies nodded at them.

"Go back and rest." After the three left, Jia Zizhen immediately contacted someone and informed him about the incident. However, that person had also heard everything from his subordinates, but he had doubts about some things. "How could Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, and Tianshi Bailong suddenly appear there? Who brought them there?"
In the Jiao Clan, the patriarch was enraged as soon as Jiao Suyin and the others returned, and he decided to punish Jiao Huanfeng severely because his behavior had embarrassed them.

However, a great shock struck their clan after they learned that the woman with the old man was Jiao Yunbai, but they were confused about how he could turn into a woman, and none of them saw the culprit.
The patriarch of the Jiao Clan did not punish Jiao Yunbai and sent him to a doctor to examine his body, but he decided to commit suicide out of shame.
The patriarch of the Jiao Clan did not punish Jiao Yunbai and sent him to a physician to examine his body, but he decided to commit suicide out of shame by exploding his cultivation core.
In prison, Jiao Huanfeng also decided to commit suicide, but his attempt failed. He kept trying to do so, but something within his soul kept stopping him, rendering his efforts futile.

Just like in the Jiao Clan, major commotion also broke out in several places, especially in the Thousand Beast Grave Domain. After all, they lost their ten generals in a single day, which made Taotie and the other three furious.

Although the four perils lost many subordinates, they were still fortunate to have numerous beasts under their command that were as powerful as Xie Heilong and the others. They immediately chose some beasts to replace their positions, and they also ordered their other generals to check into several domains, especially the Divine Origin Main Domain.

Mo Shentian listened to Mo Taizi’s report about his previous conversation with Xie Zhi and Long Gui. Unfortunately, the Calamity Demon God was disappointed after his son informed him that those evil beasts had fallen into the hands of Long Wuzhao and the others, forcing him to find another way to communicate with the four perils.
"Father, they suggest you meet Dong Xuanyin, as she is the only person who can help us find Wu Mian’s original body."
Mo Shentian’s expression looked strange after his son mentioned the name. ’Dong Xuanyin, huh?’ "You may leave now, and I’ll think about it first."
"Yes, Father."

chapters.title: Chapter 1212: Cooperation Offer
paragraphs: At a time when people in many places were experiencing unrest, Zhang Fei [4] was sitting opposite of two women. "Sect Master Nong, I want to cooperate with you in the assassination business."
"Hmm?" Both women frowned at Zhang Fei [4]’s request. "Do you also have an assassin group?"

Zhang Fei [4] summoned several women, such as Qian Ying, Ju Yingzhi, Xin Yanluo, Meng Qi, and several others. "They are members of my demon fox group, but I am not the founder and one of my wives founded it."

Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang observed the women, but their cultivation was too low to roam around in the Paradise Realm, particularly since they had not yet broken through to the Five Celestial Realms. They were surprised to discover that Qian Ying, Ju Yingzhi, and Xin Yanluo were demons.

"I know they are much weaker than your sect members, but they won’t lose to them in assassination." Both women doubted it, but Zhang Fei [4] didn’t mind their reactions. "Yunxiao told me about your assassin group, and I don’t want our two groups to become enemies. After all, having more friends is better, right? Moreover, both of you are already aware of some of my connections and abilities, so you should not doubt my capability to strengthen them. If you are willing to accept my offer, I will supply them with my pills, and they can become even stronger."

Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang thought of that, as they had both experienced the effects of some of Zhang Fei [4]’s pills that he sold at the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary; Thus, they knew that their effects were greatly beneficial for them and their disciples.

Nong Qinwei then spoke to him. "Your offer is excellent and tempting, but I can’t decide now. Although I am the sect master of the Hidden Moon Sect, there are still several people above me, and I need to discuss this matter with them first."

"I understand." Zhang Fei [4] nodded at her. "I won’t force you two to accept my offer right away, and you can return to your sect to discuss this matter with them first. Whether they agree or not, I hope you can directly inform me of their decision. Even if we can’t cooperate directly, we can still cooperate indirectly, such as dividing our operational areas to prevent clashes in the field."
"Yes." Nong Qinwei brought Yun Chang to her feet. "We will return to our sect now, and we will discuss this matter with them directly. After they have made a decision, I will inform you directly."

"I hope to hear good news from you." After the two women left, Zhang Fei [4] brought Meng Qi and the others back to the training space. He asked them to cultivate more diligently, especially Meng Qi and Meng Guanqiu. He then returned to the pavilion and resumed his activities with his three wives, Ilsath, Orith, and Zilvora.
In one of the bedrooms, Zhang Fei was watching Yao Qilin, who was still unconscious and naked. He decided to merge her original soul with his own before waking her up.

"Mhmm..." Yao Qilin groaned softly and slowly opened her eyes; she immediately jumped in shock upon seeing the light, as there was no light in the Endless Night Dungeon. She then looked at Zhang Fei with a frown. "Where am I? Who are you? I’m familiar with your face, but I can’t sense any demon or beast aura from you."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and explained to her. "Long Fei is the pseudonym I gave you, and my real name is Zhang Fei. As you can see, I am an ordinary human, but my dragon form that you saw in the abyss is also real."

"You—" Yao Qilin stopped talking as soon as Zhang Fei transformed into his humanoid dragon form, and she could recognize the same aura as when they first met in the abyss. "How is this possible? How can you have two identities?"

"Actually, I still have one more identity." Yao Qilin’s jaw dropped when Zhang Fei transformed into his lust demon form. "Apart from being human and dragon, I am also an emperor-rank lust demon. By the way, this place is my private place, and no one can leave or enter without my permission."

Yao Qilin returned to her senses and tried to attack Zhang Fei, only to discover that he had sealed her cultivation. She also realized that her body was naked, forcing her to cover her two sensitive areas with her hands.

Yao Qilin’s face turned cold and questioned him with an unfriendly tone. "What do you want from me? Why are you doing this to me? Were you the one who brought Long Wuzhao and the others into the dungeon?"

"You’re right, I brought the three dragons to the dungeon, and the people who attacked your comrades were my allies." Zhang Fei grabbed her hands and moved them away, making her furious. However, she was powerless without her cultivation. "We have no problems with each other, and you are quite interesting in my opinion. Therefore, I stopped you when you wanted to help them because I didn’t want you to die, and I sent you here. As for your situation, I didn’t take off your clothes, but one of my wives did."

"All men are untrustworthy! I don’t believe you!" Zhang Fei shook his head before asking all the members of his main harem to go inside, making Yao Qilin shocked and frozen in her spot. ’What the hell? Why are they naked like this?’

"Hehehe! Don’t blame our husband because I took off your clothes and left you in this room." Nalan Yushu then moved behind her and hugged her from behind. "For your information, not all women can attract his attention, but you managed to attract his attention, so he stopped you and sent you here."

Yao Qilin turned to Nalan Yushu, and she recognized her identity. "Aren’t you the second princess of the soul-devouring demon race? How can you be with them? Didn’t Tian Qiye imprison your soul in the tower?"

"Him." Nalan Yushu pointed at Zhang Fei. "Several years ago, he and his acquaintances challenged the tower, and I met them there. I’ve lived with him ever since, and he helped me recover my soul. In the end, I managed to reshape my body, and here I am now as one of his wives."
Yao Qilin turned to Zhang Fei again. "No wonder Nalan Wangzi was unwilling to hand you over to me even though I offered her high compensation; it turns out you are her brother-in-law."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled. "Even if my sister-in-law is willing to accept your offer, you still cannot take me with you, and I just have to hide here until my cultivation reaches your level."
Yao Qilin’s lips twitched at that. "So, all these women are your wives? You already have so many wives, but you kidnap me and treat me like this."

"Hey! I didn’t treat you like this, okay?" Zhang Fei denied with a shake of his head. "Yushu already said that she took off your clothes and left you here, but you still accuse me. Moreover, I won’t keep you in this place, and I will send you out if you want to leave."
"Are you really going to free me?" Yao Qilin doubtfully asked.

"I am a man of my word." Zhang Fei took Yao Qilin’s clothes on the table and handed them to her. "Get dressed; I’ll send you out if you want. Taotie and the others should know the situation, and they’ll be suspicious of you if you return now. Perhaps they will consider you a traitor, and they will probably kill you."

"You’re the one who put me in this situation! You shouldn’t have stopped me, and you should have let me die with the others!" Zhang Fei just smiled at that, irritating Yao Qilin. "Are they really dead?"
Zhang Fei shook his head. "Jin Kuang killed Jiu Niao, and the other seven are in my prison now."
"Hmm?" Yao Qilin felt something odd about that. "Did you release one of us?"

"Fei Lian." Yao Qilin snorted upon hearing that name, thinking that Zhang Fei also wanted the Demonic Wind Beast as his woman. "Haha! Your guess is not wrong, but she is different from you, and I have other reasons for letting her go."
"To spy on our four leaders." Zhang Fei admitted with a nod, making Yao Qilin sigh in her heart. "I have many questions for you, but I’m sure you won’t answer them."
Zhang Fei smiled at that. "If you are willing to be my woman, I will tell you many things."
"Humph!" Yao Qilin snorted at her before breaking free from Nalan Yushu’s embrace, and she hurriedly got dressed. "I won’t leave, but I don’t want you to bother me."
"Sure." Zhang Fei led all his wives out of the room.

Yao Qilin let out a soft sigh, lay on the bed, and covered her face with her hands. Many questions kept popping up in her mind, especially regarding the relationship between Zhang Fei and Long Wuzhao.
"Wow! So many mythical beasts!"

Wu Lianzhi’s shout startled Yao Qilin, who hurriedly went to the window to peek at them. She was shocked to see Xie Heilong and the others already in the main garden, and their condition was dire. "What does he want to do to them? Is he going to kill them now?"

Guang Yue spoke to them again. "Pei Yunhao and Zi Yu’an are dual cultivators, and they are some of the best of our disciples. They also have interests in other fields, such as blacksmithing and alchemy. "You don’t need to worry about that because we have many powerful elders now, and we also have several guardian beasts. If the two of them have such an idea, they can easily stop them." Zhang Fei [5] then pointed at Zi Yu’an. "I can smell thousands of herbs from her body, which means she is indeed an alchemist. Qing Qiu’er nodded slightly before questioning Zi Yu’an. "How long have you been an alchemist? Did you have a master’s in alchemy before?"

"Sect Master Qing, I used to be Senior Bu Guo’s disciple." "Unfortunately, he wasn’t willing to acknowledge me as his disciple anymore after I decided to become a dual cultivator, and I’ve been practicing alchemy on my own ever since."

"That old man is really stupid." Zhang Fei [5] commented with a shake of his head, leaving Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue dumbfounded, as Bu Guo was well-respected in alchemy circles. "So what if you become a dual cultivator? That is your personal decision, and he should respect it. Although I have not tested your ability in alchemy in person, I have confidence that you are proficient in alchemy. Your alchemist rank should be at the venerable rank, right?"
"Yes, Elder Zhang." Zi Yu’an took out her alchemist badge and showed it to them.

"See? Bu Guo is too stupid to let go of a talented alchemist like her." Zhang Fei [5] immediately threw a jade to her. "From today on, you will be our core disciple, and we will help you to hone your alchemy skills further. sentences.text: To their surprise, the first to arrive were Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue.
They brought two people with them.
"Why did you two bring them here?" Qing Qiu’er asked them.
Instead of answering Qing Qiu’er’s question, Chi Hongchen cupped his hand to Zhang Fei [5].
"Thank you for saving Yue from the evil beast.
If it weren’t for your help, she would have died by now."
"Thank you for saving me, Elder Zhang." Gong Yue spoke in a sincere and grateful tone.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly.
"Honestly, you don’t need to thank me because I don’t have the strength to fight those evil beasts.
Several other people helped me save you and the others, so the credit should belong to them."
"Even though my condition wasn’t good, I was still conscious at that time.
I noticed that you were the first to appear and subdue the female evil beast, while the others arrived later.
Even though you didn’t want to accept it, I’m still grateful to you." Guang Yue pushed the two disciples forward.
"They are Pei Yunhao and Zi Yu’an, and we brought them to be our representatives in joining this sect."
Qing Qiu’er frowned at that.
"We—"
"Sect Master Qing, I know your thoughts, but we don’t have such an idea." Chi Hongchen then explained.
"For me, Guang Yue is everything, and Elder Zhang has saved her from death.
I have been thinking about this matter since last night, and I have chosen to let go of my desire to seize this floating plateau.
From today onward, this place will always belong to your sect, and we will never bother you again for such matters."
Chi Hongchen’s decision shocked Qing Qiu’er, You Feling, and all the elders present.
The floating plateau used to belong to his sect, and he always harbored the ambition to reclaim it from them, but he suddenly took such a decision.
Guang Yue spoke to them again.
"Pei Yunhao and Zi Yu’an are dual cultivators, and they are some of the best of our disciples.
They also have interests in other fields, such as blacksmithing and alchemy.
Unfortunately, no sect in this domain has both fields, and other sects are unwilling to accept them because of their status as dual cultivators.
Since this sect has become a universal sect and has both fields, we purposely brought both of them here to join you."
"What do you think?" Qing Qiu’er asked Zhang Fei [5].
"Let me see it first." Zhang Fei [5] used his demon eyes to examine the souls of the four people, but he couldn’t find anything negative in their souls.
"Sect Master Chi and Sect Master Guang certainly don’t have such an idea, and they really want to hand over this floating island to us.
Therefore, I don’t think it’s a problem to accept Pei Yunhao and Zi Yu’an."
"Are you sure about that?" Qing Qiu’er doubted that.
"You don’t need to worry about that because we have many powerful elders now, and we also have several guardian beasts.
If the two of them have such an idea, they can easily stop them." Zhang Fei [5] then pointed at Zi Yu’an.
"I can smell thousands of herbs from her body, which means she is indeed an alchemist.
All alchemists’ bodies have a lot of herb scent, but not all of them have that much scent, so I’m sure that she likes alchemy."
Qing Qiu’er nodded slightly before questioning Zi Yu’an.
"How long have you been an alchemist?
Did you have a master’s in alchemy before?"

"Sect Master Qing, I used to be Senior Bu Guo’s disciple." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow as he remembered the old man from Luo Yunxiao’s explanation back then, and the old man was the god-rank alchemist from the Star Cloud Pavilion.
"Unfortunately, he wasn’t willing to acknowledge me as his disciple anymore after I decided to become a dual cultivator, and I’ve been practicing alchemy on my own ever since."
"That old man is really stupid." Zhang Fei [5] commented with a shake of his head, leaving Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue dumbfounded, as Bu Guo was well-respected in alchemy circles.
"So what if you become a dual cultivator?
That is your personal decision, and he should respect it.
Although I have not tested your ability in alchemy in person, I have confidence that you are proficient in alchemy.
Your alchemist rank should be at the venerable rank, right?"
"Yes, Elder Zhang." Zi Yu’an took out her alchemist badge and showed it to them.
"See?
Bu Guo is too stupid to let go of a talented alchemist like her." Zhang Fei [5] immediately threw a jade to her.
"From today on, you will be our core disciple, and we will help you to hone your alchemy skills further.
I believe you will successfully reach the god rank, and your abilities will surpass your former master at that time."

"For now, I want you to go to the alchemy hall to meet Lin Jingxia and Tian Shuixiang, and they will teach you some new things in alchemy." Zi Yu’an immediately left the room after saying a few things to Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue.

"What is your blacksmith rank?
Do you have a master in that field?"

However, my clan is only a small one, and our knowledge in blacksmithing is very limited.
I used to want to join another sect, but they rejected me because I was a dual cultivator, so I joined the Sun Moon Sect." Pei Yunhao then took out his identity as a blacksmith.
"My blacksmith rank is the grandmaster rank."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding and threw him a jade.
"Go to the blacksmith hall to meet Ji Changlan and Gong Ren; they will teach you about blacksmithing and artifact crafting."
"Thank you, Elder Zhang." Pei Yunhao hurriedly left the room and headed for the blacksmith hall.
Chi Hongchen felt relieved and cupped his hands to them.
"Since our business is finished, we will take our leave now."
"Elder Zhang, please help them become experts in their fields." Guang Yue begged him.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
"Don’t worry, they will train under the guidance of experts in their fields, but the results still depend on their perseverance."
"We will leave now." Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue immediately left the sect and returned to their own sect.
Qing Qiu’er then asked Zhang Fei [5].
"Are you sure they won’t bring us trouble?"
"Trust me, okay?
I accepted them because of their talents, and they will be useful to our sect.
If they bring trouble to us, I will definitely know it, and I will kill them straight away." Qing Qiu’er nodded to Zhang Fei [5] before they looked at the four people who had just arrived.

"That’s right." Qiu Meixuan chimed in.
"They are the best disciples in our sect, and we want them to be our representatives to form a better relationship with your sect."

"You two may be able to deceive others with your words, but I understand the character of people like you very well.

"You—" Qiu Meixuan stopped talking as soon as Tian Kui and Serpentera appeared behind them.
Even though the two of them didn’t say anything, their presence was quite frightening to her.
"Let’s go back, Ming."
Ming Tianhe glared fiercely at Zhang Fei [5], but he said nothing and left with the others straight away.
Tian Kui and Serpentera hurried after them, making sure that they wouldn’t cause any trouble.
"Hahaha." Fang Roulan laughed heartily.
"Elder Zhang, you must be careful, as I’m sure that Ming Tianhe will plan something bad against you."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
"Some people are like those two, but I’m not worried about them.
Instead, I’ve already devised a few plans for them, and I’ll execute them soon."

"Let’s talk about my plans later because many people have arrived in front of our sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 1220: Cooperation
paragraphs: Cultivators from various sects and clans from various domains began to enter the Moonlit Passion Temple; the majority of them were those who had previously attended the opening ceremony of the new sect.

Zhang Fei [5] left everything to Qing Qiu’er and the others, and he went to meet the six special guests. He brought the six special guests to the back of the mountain. "Are these two your higher-ups, Sect Master Nong?"

"Yes." Nong Qinwei pointed at the two people. "Dongfang Yuechan is my master and Yin Chang, and Senior Lan Xuening is her senior sister. At first, I was going to come here with our two disciples, but they wanted to meet you personally."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding before asking them. "What do you want to know from me, two seniors?"
"Naturally, we want to know the reasons behind your offer of cooperation, and we also want to know your abilities as an assassin." Lan Xuening was the first to answer.
Dongfang Yuechan returned the question. "What is your real purpose in establishing your assassination group?"

"Senior Yuechan, I never founded my group, and one of my wives was the founder." Zhang Fei [5] told them the reason Liu Hua founded the organization, which surprised them. "Our group has grown far now, and our number reaches thousands, consisting of humans, demons, beast races, and natural races."
"Do your members really come from all races?" Both of them asked in surprise.

"Let me summon some of them." They were shocked when Zhang Fei [5] opened the portal to the training space, and four women walked out from inside. "Hua’er is the founder, and she still holds our leadership. Elmyra is an elf race and one of our best healers. Feng Yichen is a Dark Phoenix. Ju Yingzhi is an Abyssal Rift Demon. There are many more of our members, but I won’t summon them all now. If you two agree to cooperate with us, I will introduce you to them."
Lan Xuening and the others observed the four women seriously, but they felt that their cultivation was too low, and only Feng Yichen had broken through to the Fifth Celestial Realm.

Zhang Fei [5] smiled faintly. "They’re weaker than you, but don’t underestimate their abilities. If you don’t believe me, your two disciples can spar with them right here and now without any cultivation."
"Try them." Yin Chang spoke to Jiang Qingmei and Tan Ziyan.
Liu Hua and Elmyra wanted to step forward, but Zhang Fei [5] stopped them; instead, he asked Feng Yichen and Ju Yingzhi to spar with Jiang Qingmei and Tan Ziyan. "Show your abilities to them."

Feng Yichen said nothing and attacked Jiang Qingei directly, while Ju Yingzhi moved to engage Tan Ziyan. Quickly, the four women engaged in a fierce battle, relying not on cultivation but on their skills.

Dongfang Yuchen and the other three were truly shocked by the speed of Feng Yichen and Ju Yingzhi, as they could keep up with Jiang Qingmei and Tan Ziyan despite their vast difference in cultivation and experience.
What shocked them the most was Ju Yingzhi’s abilities because Tan Ziyan couldn’t touch her at all, and the female demon toyed around with their female disciple using her dimensional abilities.
"Yingzhi, don’t hold back."

After Zhang Fei said that, Ju Yingzhi immediately locked Tan Ziyan up using her dimensional prison. She then moved beside Feng Yichen and imprisoned Jiang Qingmei, and the two disciples could not free themselves from her prison.

Thereafter, Ju Yingzhi moved to Zhang Fei’s side and imprisoned their guests. "Your cultivation is superior to mine, but none of you will ever be able to escape from my prison. If you don’t believe me, you can try."

"Hmm?" Dongfang Yuchen and the other three immediately used their last bit of strength to destroy Ju Yingzhi’s dimensional prison, but their attacks were instantly thrown to another dimension. They decided to use half of their strength, yet they still could not break it.

"As I told you before, Ju Yingzhi is an Abyssal Rift Demon. As long as you don’t have the void element, you will never be able to escape from her." They looked at the female demon in shock, and Zhang Fei [5] spoke to them again. "Feng Yichen’s abilities are not as good as hers, but she is a dark phoenix, and her dark flames can incinerate almost everything, including our souls. If she used her flames, Jiang Qingmei would have been dead from the first second."
Ju Yingzhi then freed the six women from her dimensional prison, and she casually stood behind Zhang Fei [5], leaving them speechless.

"Actually, our group can operate independently based on the number and capabilities of our members; however, Yunxiao informed me about your sect, and I want to avoid any issues among our members. Therefore, I offer you to cooperate with us, and our two groups can move side by side in carrying out the assassination missions." Zhang Fei [5] then summoned Tian Kui and Serpentera to come, and the presence of the two ancient beasts shocked them again. "They are the guardians of this sect, and you must have realized their strength by now."
Dongfang Yuechan nodded to him. "I didn’t expect you to have two powerful protectors with cultivation at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realms."
"Do you still have other guardians?" Lan Xuening asked.

"Yes." Nong Qinwei and Yun Chang gasped in shock as soon as Xie Heilong and the seven evil mythical beasts appeared in front of them on Zhang Fei [5]’s orders. "You definitely recognize them, right, Sect Master Nong and Vice Sect Master Yin?"
Both women nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. "Did you enslave them?"

"No." Zhang Fei [5] denied Nong Qinwei with a headshake. "I didn’t enslave them directly because that would be too risky, and I used other methods to make them obey me. This way, I’m sure no sect or clan has such powerful guardians as our sect."
"What is your aim in doing this to them?" Dongfang Yuechan asked.

"I have some problems with the evil beast races, especially Taotie. They are their main generals, so I will use them to infiltrate there." They were curious about it, but Zhang Fei [5] didn’t want to tell them the truth. "If their abilities aren’t satisfactory to you all, you guys can try mine."

Dongfang Yuechan and Lan Xuening exchanged glances for a moment before nodding at Zhang Fei [5]. However, they were shocked when they wanted to move, realizing that something was limiting their movements. "What did you do to us?"

"See that." Zhang Fei [5] pointed to their shadows. "I have shadow abilities, and I restrict you two through your shadows. My abilities don’t require Qi, so you don’t need to be confused if you can’t detect my actions."

"How—" Lan Xuening stopped talking as soon as Zhang Fei [5] activated his sword domain, and hundreds of Qi swords appeared within it, surrounding them. "So, the rumors that you are a god-rank sword master are true, huh?"
Zhang Fei [5] smiled and activated his soul domain, shocking them again. Creating and using one domain was already difficult, but he was able to use two domains simultaneously.

"I am an expert soul cultivator, and this is my soul domain. If I were your enemy, you would have died from the start." Zhang Fei [5] canceled his two domains. "So, what’s your decision? Are you willing to accept my offer of cooperation? Besides my two abilities just now, you already know that I am a god-rank alchemist, and you have also used my pills. Therefore, you should know that accepting my offer will benefit all of you, right?"

They nodded at him, and Dongfang Yuechan immediately made a decision. "Alright, we’ll accept your offer. Our two groups will start working together today, but we still need to discuss some matters regarding the future."
"That’s true." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Liu Hua. "Hua’er, I’m not interested in this matter, and you are the leader of our demon fox group, so you will be the one to discuss the matters with them."
Liu Hua nodded at him. "Seniors, let’s go inside first so we can discuss more comfortably."

Dongfang Yuechan and Lan Xuening followed Liu Hua, but Ning Qinwei and Yin Chang did not join them. "Zhang Fei, Jiang Qingmei and Tan Ziyan will be our representatives in this sect, and I hope you are willing to send two of your members to our sect, allowing us to communicate and plan more easily."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] looked at the two women while thinking about the right members to send to the Hidden Moon Sect. "Let me think about it first, and I’ll send two people to your sect once I’ve selected the right person."
"Alright." Nong Qinwei nodded in agreement.
"Zhang Fei! Let’s spar again!"
All of them turned to Jian Kuang, who was standing in front of the barrier with Zhuxian Sheng. Yin Chang then asked. "Did that sword maniac join you?"

"He hasn’t decided to join me yet, and he’s staying here just to spar with me." Zhang Fei [5] let out a heavy sigh before asking all the beasts to leave, and he sent Feng Yichen and two other women back to the training space. "You two can join them, and I will go to spar with that sword maniac."
"We’ll go with you!" Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang hurriedly followed him, as did the two female disciples.

chapters.title: Chapter 1221: Qiu Meixuan’s Plans
paragraphs: Just like the previous day, many disciples filled the training ground as soon as they heard that Zhang Fei [5] would be sparring with Jian Kuang again. However, something else surprised them because not only would he face the sword maniac, but he would also have to face Zhuxian Sheng.
Nong Qinwei, Yin Chang, and their two disciples joined them, seriously observing Zhang Fei [5] against Jian Kuang and Zhuxian Sheng.
Huo Lanyin wore an annoyed look because Zhang Fei [5] didn’t bring out another clone, preventing her from competing in alchemy with his clone.

Huo Hao’er and Huo Yu’er, who saw Huo Lanyin’s expression, could only shake their heads and laugh in their hearts. ’If Jian Kuang is the sword maniac, Sister Lanyin is the alchemy maniac! She was upset because she couldn’t beat Zhang Fei here, even though she was much more experienced than him in alchemy.’

They quickly engaged in a fierce battle, with only Jian Kuang able to match Zhang Fei’s speed. Zhuxian Sheng’s speed was also fast compared to the other cultivators, but he was quite overwhelmed to catch up to him, let alone attack him.
Su Shentian, who saw that, immediately helped Zhuxian Sheng to increase his speed, allowing him to catch up with Zhang Fei [5] and Jian Kuang.

Su Shentian’s actions turned the situation around, and Zhang Fei [5] was overwhelmed enough to face Jian Kuang and Zhuxian Sheng’s attacks. However, he has many tricks up his sleeves, including his teleportation and invisibility.

Since Zhang Fei [5]’s teleportation and invisibility didn’t use Qi, as those were his beast abilities, Jian Kuang and Zhuxian Sheng couldn’t protest against him, and both of them thought hard about how to deal with both of his abilities.

Tian Shengjie sat atop a large tree along with Tian Huangjin, Tian Huotian, and Tian Zhiling. She smiled as she watched Zhang Fei [5] play around with Jian Kuang and Zhuxian Sheng. ’He grew more and more as time passed, and he became more mature as a cultivator.’
Tian Huangjin noticed Tian Shengjie’s smile and questioned her directly. ’Do you really like Zhang Fei?’
’Hmm?’ Tian Shengjie tilted her head to the side. ’Why do you ask that?’
’We’ve known each other for a long time, remember?’ Tian Huangjin responded with a shake of her head. ’If you didn’t like him, you wouldn’t have decided to stay by his side.’

Tian Shengjie didn’t answer her and returned the question. ’Aren’t you the same as me? You’re starting to like him too, right? The first time you found out he had ascended to this realm, you looked so excited, and you were impatient to meet him.’

’Not really.’ Tian Huangjin denied it. ’Like I often say, I have never had such useless feelings in my life. "Which moral man would take his grandmother, mother, and two sisters as his wives?"
"Me." Zhang Fei [5] pointed at his own face.
"By the way, why is your mother the demon god and not your father?"
"My father is too weak compared to my mother, and he’s not her husband either." Nalan Wangzi’s answer surprised Zhang Fei [5].
"My mother is a direct descendant of the previous demon god, and she doesn’t want to be tied to anyone.
The saddest relationship I have ever seen is between her and our father, whom she chose not out of love but rather to have children.
Once my sister was born, she never went to see him again, and they have become strangers.
Hey!
I forbid you to woo my mother, okay?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] rubbed his nose.
"I won’t promise you anything."
"You—" Nalan Wangzi swallowed her anger directly.
"Even if I forbid you from approaching my mother, a perverted demon like you won’t listen to me.
Furthermore, my mother is a powerful demon who is both beautiful and alluring, so I’m sure you are tempted to get her."
Zhang Fei [5] just smiled and glanced at You Feiling, who had just come out of the lake naked.
"Wangzi, I will send you to my private quarters, and you can join the others there."
"Alright." Nalan Wangzi entered the training space directly after Zhang Fei [5] opened the portal.
You Feiling nonchalantly started to get dressed, and her naked body tempted Zhang Fei [5].
However, he did not approach her and went to another area instead, surprising her. ’I initially thought he wanted to eat me, but instead, he went away.’

Nalan Wangzi could only shake her head when she arrived at the pavilion, as the moans of five women echoed from five different rooms. ’He and his other clones are dual-cultivating with their women, huh?’
Nalan Wangzi then turned to Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu, who were chatting in the distance.
She immediately approached them and joined them, as there was no one else there besides them.
’She must be his new woman.’ Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu said this in their hearts.
"You are Nalan Yushu’s sister, right?"
"Yeah." Nalan Wangzi nodded at them.
"How can two ice phoenixes like you be with him?
Even though I detected his Yang Qi in your bodies, I also detected that you two are still virgins."
"We cultivate using his Yang Qi, so you must have detected it within our bodies.
Even though we used his Yang Qi and lived with him, we never thought about becoming his wives." Feng Xueying calmly replied.
"Is that so?" Nalan Wangzi didn’t believe her.
"Are there any other women besides the two of you who haven’t become his wives?"
Feng Xueying nodded at her.
"Xian Xian also lives here, but she’s not his wife yet, and she’s currently forging equipment in the smithy.
Lei Ting also lives here, but he only thinks of her as a friend, and he never approaches her romantically."
"Oh." Nalan Wangzi then asked again.
"So, which room is his real body in?"
"Over there." Feng Jinqiu pointed to the main bedroom.
"You can join them if you want, as they won’t be coming out anytime soon."
Nalan Wangzi shook her head slightly.
"I won’t be joining them, and I want to talk with you two."

chapters.title: Chapter 1228: Nalan Sisters
paragraphs: Nalan Wangzi was shocked when the two female phoenixes told her that the time flow in the training space was four times faster than in the outside world, but she finally understood the reason behind Zhang Fei’s absurd cultivation speed.

Nalan Wangzi knew many dual cultivators, but she had never met one who could cultivate as fast as Zhang Fei. Although he had numerous women by his side, she believed it was impossible for him to reach his current level in just a few years, and it turned out that he had been cultivating for over two decades.
"Is there anything interesting in this pavilion?"
"The Celestial Spring Pool is there, and it’s a great place for dual cultivation." Feng Xueying pointed in another direction.

Feng Jinqiu quickly handed Nalan Wangzi a bottle of Zhang Fei’s yang qi. "Even though we’ve never dual cultivated with him, we always cultivated there using his yang qi, and the effects are truly extraordinary, particularly for our bodies."
"Hmm?" Nalan Wangzi received the bottle, opened the lid, and sniffed the contents. "Oh? It doesn’t have any smell."
Then, Feng Xueying touched Nalan Wangzi’s forehead. She shared the Flawless Yin-Yang Arts and the Nine Heavens Illusory Technique with her based on Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao’s request just now.
"Hmm?" The two techniques in her mind startled Nalan Wangzi.

"You can cultivate his Yang Qi normally, but the effects won’t be significant without learning his dual cultivation technique, so he asked me to share it with you." Nalan Wangzi nodded understandingly at Feng Xueying. "The Nine Heavens Illusory Technique belongs to the Luo Clan, and Luo Yunxiao asked me to give it to you just now."
Nalan Wangzi beamed upon hearing that, and she hurriedly stood up from her seat. "I’ll go to the Celestial Spring Pool to learn both techniques and try cultivating my brother-in-law’s Yang Qi there."
"Zhang Fei’s women continue to increase, Ancestor." Feng Jinqiu spoke, looking at the direction Nalan Wangzi left.
Feng Xueying nodded at her. "That kid is the most lustful living being, and he will likely become even more lustful if his demon rank increases, which will probably lead him to another evolution."
"Can he evolve again?" Feng Jinqiu asked in disbelief.

Feng Xueying shook her head slightly with a soft sigh. "I don’t have much information about the lust demon race, but I heard from Luo Yunxiao that Zhang Fei has the possibility of evolving and surpassing the transcendent one. If that is true, the effects of his lust demon abilities will be increasingly terrifying, and he will also become more lustful."
"I think we should leave and stay in the sect with the others, Ancestor." Feng Xueying looked at Feng Jinqiu. "If we continue to stay here, I’m afraid Zhang Fei will eat us one day."

"Do you think we can avoid him?" Feng Xueying sighed again. "We’ve lived with him and the others for over two decades, so you should be familiar with his character. He has long openly said that he wanted us to be his wives, so he would never be willing to let us go. Fortunately, he still has a guilty conscience, and he never forced us to become his wives; otherwise, we would have fallen for him long ago."

Feng Jinqiu smiled bitterly upon hearing that, and she still regretted her decision to accept Zhang Fei’s offer to train in the training space. Even so, she was also grateful to him because her cultivation had broken through to the Five Celestial Realms, which was thanks to him and his Yang Qi.

Sometime later, by the Celestial Spring Pool, Nalan Wangzi had successfully learned the two techniques. She tried using the Nine Heavens Illusory Technique, but she only managed to create seven avatars, which disappointed her because it was not optimal.

Nalan Wangzi took off her dress, entered the pool, and sat leaning against one side. She opened the bottle containing Zhang Fei’s yang qi and downed it in one gulp. Thereafter, she began to absorb the pure Qi in the pool, which blended perfectly with his Yang Qi, flowing throughout her body through her veins to her dantian. ’His Yang Qi is truly powerful, and its effects become even more impactful when combined with the Qi in this pool, so it’s no wonder that he and all his wives can cultivate that fast.’
*Splash*
When Nalan Wangzi was lost in her thoughts, a woman suddenly jumped into the pool, surprising her. She frowned as soon as she saw Nalan Yushu. "Why are you here?"

"Hehe." Nalan Yushu sat beside her big sister, hugged her arm, and rested her head on her shoulder. "I originally thought you’d never be captivated by my husband, but you took the initiative to stay by his side and seduced him, Big Sis. Why didn’t you join us straight away?"

Nalan Wangzi shook her head. "I’m attracted to Zhang Fei, and we’ve kissed and done a little intimately with him, but I haven’t considered giving myself to him yet. First, I still don’t really like him, and I just want to tease him. Second, I’m Mo Taizi’s fiancée, and our situation will get worse if I’m no longer a virgin. Taizi will not force me to marry him, but he will report to Mo Shentian about my change, and our mother will be in big trouble if that happens."

"I see." Nalan Yushu nodded in understanding and hugged her tighter. "I’m sorry, Big Sis. I was too careless in the past, and my carelessness put you in such a situation. If I didn’t die at Tian Qiye’s hands, I would be the one engaged and married to Mo Taizi."

Nalan Wangzi let out a soft sigh and embraced her sister. "You don’t need to apologize to me, you know? My situation is indeed complicated and difficult, but I never blame you because you are my dearest sister. The most important thing for me is that you are back now, and you have also found your happiness with Zhang Fei. I can’t do anything to get out of my current situation, but I believe I will get through this and escape Mo Shentian’s control in the future."

"Big sis." Nalan Yushu hugged her. "You may not blame me, but I still feel guilty toward you. I will work hard to regain my past strength! No! I will surpass the old me, and I will help you break away from Mo Shentian’s control in the future."
"Haha." Nalan Wangzi laughed softly. "I believe in you; you will succeed in surpassing your past self, and you will become truly powerful by then."
"Hehe." Nalan Yushu giggled at that. "Thank you, Big Sis. You always believe in me, even though I often act rashly and childishly."
Nalan Wangzi nodded slightly. "Why don’t you go back to Zhang Fei?"

"Not now." Nalan Yushu shook her head in response. "My husband just started dual cultivating with Shang Yumei, and she is one of the most lustful among us. Since they won’t be finished anytime soon, I prefer to accompany you since we’ve been apart for too long."

"You can accompany me, but you still have to cultivate; otherwise, it will take a long time to surpass your past." Nalan Yushu pursed her lips upon hearing that, but she complied with Nalan Wangzi’s wishes by summoning her seven avatars. "Oh? You also managed to create seven avatars, huh?"

Nalan Yushu released her embrace from her big sister. "Most of them can only create five to eight avatars, Big Sis. Actually, only Luo Yunxiao and Xu Ling’er managed to create ten avatars, and their cultivation has accelerated because of it."
"Oh?" Since she had not met Zhang Fei’s other women, Nalan Wangzi did not know for sure about their strength.

Nalan Yushu then spoke again. "You must already know Luo Yunxiao, right? Even though Xu Ling’er is the youngest among us, her talent is the best among us, and she broke through to the Five Celestial Realms a few days ago. In fact, she is the reincarnation of the first ancestor of the winged race, Tian Huangjin."
"Huh?" Nalan Wangzi was shocked by that. "Are you serious about that?"

Nalan Yuzhu nodded at her. "That’s true, Big Sis. We’ve seen her transform into Tian Huangjin several times. Zhang Fei rarely takes her out of this place because he’s afraid that Tian Qiye might be able to detect her return, and she’ll hunt her down to kill her if that happens."

"I see." Nalan Wangzi nodded in understanding. "Tian Qiye is indeed crazy, but I didn’t expect that she would think of doing such a thing to the reincarnation of her first ancestor. Alright, let’s cultivate for now, and you can return to Zhang Fei when your turn to dual cultivate with him comes."
"Yeah."

While they were busy in the pavilion, it was already night again in the outside world, and Zhang Fei [5] had already returned to the mountaintop. He sat relaxed on a tree while looking at the map in front of him, waiting for the arrival of the celestial dragons, the winged races, and the demons.
"What are you thinking about?" Qing Qiu’er asked as she landed beside him.

"I’m waiting for those demons." Zhang Fei [5] pulled her to sit on his lap and kissed her. "After they clear out the demons, we will gradually take over the Blazing Union Sect. However, I still haven’t decided whether I will merge the two sects or let them run separately."

chapters.title: Chapter 1229: Killing Demons
paragraphs: Qing Qiu’er wrapped her arms around his neck. "I think we shouldn’t merge the two sects because our sect is no longer a dual cultivation sect, and the Blazing Union Sect simply has too many. If we merge the two sects and their disciples move here, then those prospective disciples might be hesitant to join us. I believe we can separate the disciples and elders according to gender if you’re considering looking after that sect as well."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow slightly. "Are you thinking of sending all our male elders and disciples to that sect and moving their female elders and disciples here?"

"Yes." Qing Qiu’er nodded at him. "Our sect is more suitable for female cultivators due to the presence of the Celestial Yin Lake, while the Blazing Union Sect, which has the Celestial Yang Lake, is more suitable for male cultivators. Therefore, dividing them based on their gender is the best solution for us, and we only need to install a teleportation portal to connect the two sects, allowing them to move back and forth with ease."

"I think it can be done, but we have to discuss the matter with them first." Zhang Fei [5] then looked at the distance. "Additionally, we have to talk to Chi Hongchen and Guang Ye because our decision will have a significant impact on this domain, and the other dual cultivation sects might oppose our plans."

"I agree with you." Qing Qiu’er rested her head on his shoulders. "There are hundreds of sects in this domain from ordinary to supreme sects, and our plans will definitely affect them. I think Chi Hongchen and Guang Ye will not object to our plans, and they should be able to help us to persuade the other sects, so we can try talking to them first tomorrow."
"Alright, we will go to the Sun Moon Sect tomorrow morning." Zhang Fei [5] immediately carried her and took her out of the barrier to meet several guests.
Tianshi Shengjie, Tian Huangjin, Tian Huotian, and Tian Zhiling also moved out, as the guests were the entourage of their two races.
"We meet again, kid."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Tian Yizu. "Before, you only used your avatar, so this is our first time meeting in person. Since you’re here, we’ll talk after we clean up those demons."
"Okay."
Tian You’an immediately floated in front of Zhang Fei [5]. "Is she in this sect? Can you take us to meet her?"

"She’s not here, and she’s in isolation right now." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer disappointed Tian You’an, Tian Yizu, and Tian Wei, as they wanted to meet Xu Ling’er to confirm the truth. "I understand your desire to meet her, but I must prioritize her safety. She is one of my wives now, and I’m worried that Tian Qiye has the ability to detect her return, so I’m reluctant to bring her out."
The three grand elders nodded in understanding, then Tian Wei asked him. "Has her cultivation reached the Five Celestial Realms?"

"She reached that stage a few days ago, but it wasn’t enough for her to be able to travel freely in this realm." The three grand elders agreed with Zhang Fei [5]. "By the way, the eight demons are on their way to this domain, and I think they will arrive soon. Therefore, we should go to the Blazing Union Sect now, and we will ambush them there."
"Brother Xukong."

Long Xukong directly opened a void hole and led them to enter it, followed by Tianshi Shengji, Tian Huangjin, and two other winged race members. Zhang Fei [5] joined them, but he left Qing Qiu’er in their sect.

Tianshi Bailong, Long Xukong, Tian Yizu, Tian You’an, and Tian Wei frowned as Jiu Ming and Qiu Meixuan appeared before them. However, they could see that both of them were loyal to Zhang Fei [5], making them certain that he had enslaved them.

Zhang Fei [5] was aware of their thoughts and spoke to them directly. "I was worried that the other eight would notice, so I didn’t enslave them, and I used another method to control them. Additionally, I altered some of their memories, so they became loyal to me now."
"What are your plans for this male demon?"
"Nothing." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at Tian Yizu. "If you want to kill him, feel free to do it."
"Don’t you want to absorb his strength?"

"Naturally, I want to absorb his strength and demon power." Zhang Fei [5] then pressed his heart area. "However, you haven’t forgotten about the thing inside my body, right? I’ve already controlled it, but I’m worried that it will get out of control again if I use my ability too often, so I’ve been purposely holding myself back."
Zhang Fei [5]’s answer satisfied Tianshi Bailong, but Tian You’an suddenly asked him. "What’s in your body?"
"The Cursed Demon Heart."
The three grand elders were shocked by Zhang Fei [5]’s revelation, but Tian You’an swiftly touched his chest before checking his heart.
"Is that really the Cursed Demon Heart?" Tian Wei asked.
"It’s true." Tian You’an then asked him again. "How could the heart be in your body?"

Zhang Fei [5] couldn’t possibly tell them that he got the Cursed Demon Heart from the system’s quests. "I found a mysterious chest in the Star Tower, and I was too curious about its contents. Therefore, I immediately opened it, and the Cursed Demon Heart shot into my body as soon as I opened it. Since then, it has become one with my body, and it got out of control once before I managed to get rid of the soul remnant of its previous owner."

"Oh?" The three grand elders were surprised to hear that because they knew the power of the Cursed Demon Heart’s former owner, and his soul remnant should still be powerful enough for the current Zhang Fei [5], even though he had died a long time ago.

"I had helped to defeat his soul remnant; otherwise, I wouldn’t have been able to do it, and I would have fallen under the control of my heart." Zhang Fei [5] then enveloped them with his aura and brought them into an invisible state, and he brought Qiu Meixuan along as he still needed her. "They have already entered this domain."
Tianshi Bailong and the others immediately prepared to ambush the demons, and Zhang Fei [5] ordered Jiu Ming to divert their attention first.
Soon, eight demons from the Nine Nether Demon Race arrived in the sky above the sect, and Jiu Ming greeted them directly. "Have you prepared everything?"

"Yeah." A man with an undead appearance and a pungent smell from his body answered him. "Why did you choose this sect? Our demon gods do need cannon fodder, but the cultivators in this sect are too weak, and they will die in seconds if we send them to the Calamity Domain."
Jiu Ming nodded at him. "Naturally, I am aware of that, but they are just chess pieces, and I left the others in other domains."
"Does that mean the members of the Soul Temple have become demons?" A female demon with several eyeballs floating around her asked.
"Yes." Jiu Ming then explained to them the details of his meeting with Qiu Meixuan at the Gongsun Clan. "We’ve wasted time, so we should start now, and we’ll go to the other sects after."

They nodded at Jiu Ming before scattering in several directions, and they took out several items needed to turn the people in the sect into demons before activating them. "Nine Nether Transformation Formation!"

A few minutes later, the items released lines that connected to one another, creating a formation resembling a blood pattern with a baleful aura. "Focus! Otherwise, we will fail, and these items will be wasted."
They nodded and poured their demon power into the formation, causing it to glow even redder. Jiu Ming watched the other eight demons closely and waited for Zhang Fei [5]’s order.
Once Zhang Fei [5] gave him the order, Jiu Ming immediately attacked the other eight demons using his blood demon abilities.
"Gah!" All of them were sent flying backwards and the formation instantly disappeared.
Before they could get angry with Jiu Ming, Long Xukong and the others had appeared in front of them, and they attacked the eight demons at the same time.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] did not show himself; instead, he took Qiu Meixuan back to Ming Tianhe’s room and left her there. He did not join Tian Ziyu and the others, and he watched them from the roof of the tallest building in the sect. ’If my cultivation reaches their level, I’m confident I can surpass them.’
The sudden attack of Long Xukong and the others overwhelmed them, as their strength was a major level above those demons.
In a few minutes, Tianshi Bailong and the others had already slaughtered those demons, including Jiu Ming.

Tianshi Shengjie moved to take the storage rings belonging to the demons before her father destroyed their corpse, and she gave them to Zhang Fei [5] because he was the only demon among them. "You can check them later; who knows, you might be lucky enough to find those items to upgrade your demon rank in them."
"Thank you." Zhang Fei [5] stored them in his storage ring. "Let’s go back to my sect."
However, Tianshi Bailong did not want to join them, and Long Xukong immediately took him away.
