"Our sect is more suitable for female cultivators due to the presence of the Celestial Yin Lake, while the Blazing Union Sect, which has the Celestial Yang Lake, is more suitable for male cultivators.

Therefore, dividing them based on their gender is the best solution for us, and we only need to install a teleportation portal to connect the two sects, allowing them to move back and forth with ease."
"I think it can be done, but we have to discuss the matter with them first." Zhang Fei [5] then looked at the distance.
"Additionally, we have to talk to Chi Hongchen and Guang Ye because our decision will have a significant impact on this domain, and the other dual cultivation sects might oppose our plans."
"I agree with you." Qing Qiu’er rested her head on his shoulders.
"There are hundreds of sects in this domain from ordinary to supreme sects, and our plans will definitely affect them.
I think Chi Hongchen and Guang Ye will not object to our plans, and they should be able to help us to persuade the other sects, so we can try talking to them first tomorrow."
"Alright, we will go to the Sun Moon Sect tomorrow morning." Zhang Fei [5] immediately carried her and took her out of the barrier to meet several guests.
Tianshi Shengjie, Tian Huangjin, Tian Huotian, and Tian Zhiling also moved out, as the guests were the entourage of their two races.
"We meet again, kid."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Tian Yizu.
"Before, you only used your avatar, so this is our first time meeting in person.
Since you’re here, we’ll talk after we clean up those demons."
"Okay."
Tian You’an immediately floated in front of Zhang Fei [5].
"Is she in this sect?
Can you take us to meet her?"
"She’s not here, and she’s in isolation right now." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer disappointed Tian You’an, Tian Yizu, and Tian Wei, as they wanted to meet Xu Ling’er to confirm the truth.
"I understand your desire to meet her, but I must prioritize her safety.
She is one of my wives now, and I’m worried that Tian Qiye has the ability to detect her return, so I’m reluctant to bring her out."
The three grand elders nodded in understanding, then Tian Wei asked him.
"Has her cultivation reached the Five Celestial Realms?"
"She reached that stage a few days ago, but it wasn’t enough for her to be able to travel freely in this realm." The three grand elders agreed with Zhang Fei [5].
"By the way, the eight demons are on their way to this domain, and I think they will arrive soon.
Therefore, we should go to the Blazing Union Sect now, and we will ambush them there."
"Brother Xukong."
Long Xukong directly opened a void hole and led them to enter it, followed by Tianshi Shengji, Tian Huangjin, and two other winged race members.
Zhang Fei [5] joined them, but he left Qing Qiu’er in their sect.
Tianshi Bailong, Long Xukong, Tian Yizu, Tian You’an, and Tian Wei frowned as Jiu Ming and Qiu Meixuan appeared before them.
However, they could see that both of them were loyal to Zhang Fei [5], making them certain that he had enslaved them.
Zhang Fei [5] was aware of their thoughts and spoke to them directly.
"I was worried that the other eight would notice, so I didn’t enslave them, and I used another method to control them.
Additionally, I altered some of their memories, so they became loyal to me now."
"What are your plans for this male demon?"
"Nothing." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at Tian Yizu.
"If you want to kill him, feel free to do it."
"Don’t you want to absorb his strength?"
"Naturally, I want to absorb his strength and demon power." Zhang Fei [5] then pressed his heart area.
"However, you haven’t forgotten about the thing inside my body, right?
I’ve already controlled it, but I’m worried that it will get out of control again if I use my ability too often, so I’ve been purposely holding myself back."
Zhang Fei [5]’s answer satisfied Tianshi Bailong, but Tian You’an suddenly asked him.
"What’s in your body?"
"The Cursed Demon Heart."
The three grand elders were shocked by Zhang Fei [5]’s revelation, but Tian You’an swiftly touched his chest before checking his heart.
"Is that really the Cursed Demon Heart?" Tian Wei asked.
"It’s true." Tian You’an then asked him again.
"How could the heart be in your body?"
Zhang Fei [5] couldn’t possibly tell them that he got the Cursed Demon Heart from the system’s quests.
"I found a mysterious chest in the Star Tower, and I was too curious about its contents.
Therefore, I immediately opened it, and the Cursed Demon Heart shot into my body as soon as I opened it.
Since then, it has become one with my body, and it got out of control once before I managed to get rid of the soul remnant of its previous owner."

"Oh?" The three grand elders were surprised to hear that because they knew the power of the Cursed Demon Heart’s former owner, and his soul remnant should still be powerful enough for the current Zhang Fei [5], even though he had died a long time ago.

"I had helped to defeat his soul remnant; otherwise, I wouldn’t have been able to do it, and I would have fallen under the control of my heart." Zhang Fei [5] then enveloped them with his aura and brought them into an invisible state, and he brought Qiu Meixuan along as he still needed her.
"They have already entered this domain."
Tianshi Bailong and the others immediately prepared to ambush the demons, and Zhang Fei [5] ordered Jiu Ming to divert their attention first.
Soon, eight demons from the Nine Nether Demon Race arrived in the sky above the sect, and Jiu Ming greeted them directly.
"Have you prepared everything?"
"Yeah." A man with an undead appearance and a pungent smell from his body answered him.
"Why did you choose this sect?
Our demon gods do need cannon fodder, but the cultivators in this sect are too weak, and they will die in seconds if we send them to the Calamity Domain."
Jiu Ming nodded at him.
"Naturally, I am aware of that, but they are just chess pieces, and I left the others in other domains."
"Does that mean the members of the Soul Temple have become demons?" A female demon with several eyeballs floating around her asked.
"Yes." Jiu Ming then explained to them the details of his meeting with Qiu Meixuan at the Gongsun Clan.
"We’ve wasted time, so we should start now, and we’ll go to the other sects after."
They nodded at Jiu Ming before scattering in several directions, and they took out several items needed to turn the people in the sect into demons before activating them.
"Nine Nether Transformation Formation!"
A few minutes later, the items released lines that connected to one another, creating a formation resembling a blood pattern with a baleful aura.
"Focus!
Otherwise, we will fail, and these items will be wasted."
They nodded and poured their demon power into the formation, causing it to glow even redder.
Jiu Ming watched the other eight demons closely and waited for Zhang Fei [5]’s order.
Once Zhang Fei [5] gave him the order, Jiu Ming immediately attacked the other eight demons using his blood demon abilities.
"Gah!" All of them were sent flying backwards and the formation instantly disappeared.
Before they could get angry with Jiu Ming, Long Xukong and the others had appeared in front of them, and they attacked the eight demons at the same time.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] did not show himself; instead, he took Qiu Meixuan back to Ming Tianhe’s room and left her there.
He did not join Tian Ziyu and the others, and he watched them from the roof of the tallest building in the sect. ’If my cultivation reaches their level, I’m confident I can surpass them.’
The sudden attack of Long Xukong and the others overwhelmed them, as their strength was a major level above those demons.
In a few minutes, Tianshi Bailong and the others had already slaughtered those demons, including Jiu Ming.
Tianshi Shengjie moved to take the storage rings belonging to the demons before her father destroyed their corpse, and she gave them to Zhang Fei [5] because he was the only demon among them.
"You can check them later; who knows, you might be lucky enough to find those items to upgrade your demon rank in them."
"Thank you." Zhang Fei [5] stored them in his storage ring.
"Let’s go back to my sect."
However, Tianshi Bailong did not want to join them, and Long Xukong immediately took him away.

chapters.title: Chapter 1230: Holy Radiance War Armor
paragraphs: As soon as they arrived at the main hall, Tian Huangjin immediately asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Why don’t you bring my father and the others to meet Xu Ling’er in one of your spaces?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow for a moment before nodding in agreement. "Alright, I’ll take you guys there."
Zhang Fei [5] opened the Yin-Yang Space as he didn’t want them to know about his training space, surprising Tian Ziyu and two grand elders.

"Go in." Tian Huangjin led the three to enter it, but Tianshi Shengjie decided to follow them. Zhang Fei [5] did not go in there and returned to the mountaintop, as Qing Qiu’er and the others were already waiting for him.

Tian Ziyu and two grand elders were surprised to see another Zhang Fei there with Xu Ling’er, as his real body and clones were perfectly identical from all aspects. They looked at the rooms there, finding those female prisoners sleeping in excellent health. However, the glass tube in the middle of the room shocked them, as it was filled with Qi.
Zhang Fei [4] embraced Xu Ling’er’s shoulders. "Even though she hasn’t returned to her past form, you should already be able to sense the purity and power of her light element, right?"
"Yes." The three nodded to him.

Tian You’an moved in front of Xu Ling’er and closely observed her. "She’s still under 40, and she hasn’t regained her past memories, but her cultivation has already reached the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm. Not to mention, she has also mastered the Light Elemental Law to the Perfection Stage, so none of us three can compare to her."
"Huangjin."
"Yes." Tian Huangjin took out the holy radiance sword and handed it to Xu Ling’er.

As soon as Xu Ling’er received the sword, her body glowed golden, and she quickly returned to her past form. Tian Ziyu, Tian You’an, and Tian Wei immediately knelt before her. "Welcome back, Ancestor."

"Get up." Xu Ling’er lifted them up with her aura. "I’ve heard from my husband about the problems within our Winged Race, especially regarding Tian Qiye and her group. For now, you don’t need to do anything to them, and I will personally punish them when I go to the Radiance Domain."
"Yes, Ancestor."
"Have you found my other equipment?"
Tian Huangjin just remembered something. "Zhang Fei, we both forgot something important in the Forgotten Realm."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [4] raised his eyebrows. "Oh, right! I was too focused on my cultivation and personal affairs, and I forgot that the Holy Radiance War Armor was in the Forgotten Realm."
"Yes." Tian Huangjin nodded at him. "Since my ancestor has reached the Five Celestial Realms, she should be able to retrieve her war armor from that place by now, but—"
"It’s not a big deal." Zhang Fei [4] opened the gate that connected to the Forgotten Land. "Let’s go there now."
A while later, they had arrived at the Forgotten Land, making the three grand elders sigh in their hearts.
"Over there." Tian Huangjin pointed west. "There is a Crystal Ruin Expanse a little far from the Eternal Spring Oasis, and the Holy Radiance War Armor is hidden there."

"Oh?" Zhang Fei [4] was surprised to hear that. "Back then, Feng Yao and I went to the Eternal Spring Oasis, but we couldn’t detect anything else from that area, except for those rare forging materials."

Xu Ling’er immediately spoke to her. "Big brother, no one can sense the existence of my equipment other than the members of my race, so you don’t need to be confused if you couldn’t detect my armor at that time."
"Then—"
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Xuanyuan Zhuanxu and several ancestors of the Xuanyuan Clan suddenly appeared before them, surprising all of them, except for Zhang Fei [4].
"We meet again, kid." Xuanyuan Zhuanxu immediately spoke while looking at Xu Ling’er. "What brought you here today?"

"I have business in the Crystal Ruin Expanse, Old Man." Zhang Fei [4]’s answer confused Xuanyuan Zhuanxu and the others, as they had never found anything meaningful there. "Sorry, Old Man, but I don’t have much time right now. We’ll head there now, and we’ll leave after we finish our business."
Without waiting for Xuanyuan Zhuanxu’s reply, Zhang Fei [4] enveloped Tian Huangjin and the others with his aura and took them away using the Nine Cloud Steps.
Xuanyuan Zhuanxu and the others were shocked by that, but they immediately flew towards the Crystal Ruin Expanse to catch up with them.
"What exactly are they looking for there? Why are they in such a hurry to get there?" Xuanyuan Qian asked them.

"We’ll know once we get there," Xuanyuan Wuyue answered her. "However, I didn’t expect that kid to have connections with the grand elders of the Winged Race, and they seemed to respect the woman he holds dear."
Xuanyuan Changyi then spoke. "In the past, I heard rumors that the ancestor of the Winged Race would return one day in the future, and that woman might be her reincarnation."
"If the rumors are true, it’s no surprise that he has a relationship with them." The three women nodded to Xuanyuan Shun.
"But what is their purpose for going there?" Xuanyuan Hao asked in confusion.
"There’s no need for many questions, and we just need to chase after them to find out the answers."

They had arrived above the Crystal Ruin Expanse, a wasteland of shattered crystals, their jagged spires gleaming faintly beneath the pale sky. However, Zhang Fei [4] and Tianshi Shengjie still couldn’t see or sense anything there. "Are you sure the armor is here?"
"Haha." Xu Ling’er and the Winged Race members laughed at that.

"Big brother, you’ll see it soon." Xu Ling’er slowly landed in the center of the area, and Zhang Fei [4] immediately followed her. However, Tian Ziyu and the others didn’t follow them, waiting in the air.
*Thud*

As soon as they landed there, a wave of Qi surged out and swept the two of them away. Xu Ling’er released her aura and a white dome appeared in front of them, allowing Zhang Fei [4] to see the Holy Radiance War Armor inside.
The Holy Radiance War Armor is a peerless set of equipment that radiates an aura of sanctity and unyielding majesty. A pure light element radiates from it, giving a calm yet domineering feeling.

The base of the armor is gleaming with a pure snow-white coating, smooth and soft. The edges and seams were intricate gold carvings, faintly gleaming with divine runes. The shoulder guards rose like brilliant white wings, each lined with golden thread, while the breastplate bore a symbol in the center that resembled golden wings.
The light element around the Holy Radiance War Armor began to glow as it sensed Xu Ling’er’s aura, making her smile. "Can you see it now, Big Brother?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] pushed her forward. "Go on and take it; your armor has been waiting for your return for a long time."
Xu Ling’er nodded and walked into the white dome, causing it to glow brightly and dazzle the eyes of everyone present.

The six ancestors of the Xuanyuan Clan, who had just arrived, were shocked when they saw that. After all, they were natives of the Forbidden Land, and they had lived in that domain since the era of their ancestors, but they had never found anything in those ruins before.
"Who exactly is that woman, Tian Yizu?"

"She is the reincarnation of our first ancestor, Tian Huangjin." The six of them looked at Tian Yizu with an expression of shock. "I don’t know how it ended up in this domain, but the thing inside the white dome is her war armor, and no one can see it except for members of our race. My daughter and some of our members tried to take it in the past, but it wasn’t willing to acknowledge them as its master, and it was waiting for its true master to return."
"So, the rumors I heard in the past are true, huh?" Xuanyuan Changyi muttered under her breath, looking at the dazzling white light.
Tian Yizu turned to her. "I don’t know what kind of rumors you heard in the past, but our ancestor’s return is the first mark of a great war that will occur in the future."
"A great war? What do you mean by that?"

Tian Yizu released a soft sigh before telling them about a few things. "One day in the future, the ten-tailed fox will return to this universe once again. He is more than a heavenly fox; he is also a human and a demon. He is the one who will bring peace to humans, demons, beasts, and natural races. At that time, the reincarnations of the ancestors of all races will join him and fight by his side, but only two will stand beside him. One of them is my first ancestor, and the other one is the first demon ancestor."
Hearing that, they turned their gazes to Zhang Fei [4], who was still waiting for Xu Ling’er below them. "Where did you hear about all that?"

"The writings about the return of the ten-tailed fox have become common knowledge within the beast and natural races." Tianshi Shengjie answered Xuanyuan Wuyue. "The two races are looking forward to the ten-tailed fox’s return, but not all of them want him to return. Even the Fairy King, Jia Zizhen, was planning about capturing and killing him he conspired with the demon races."

chapters.title: Chapter 1231: Decision
paragraphs: "So, what you’re saying is that this kid is the next ten-tailed fox?" Xuanyuan Qian asked.
"Otherwise, Empress Huo Yanling and the Eternal Flame won’t be staying by his side, right?"
Xuanyuan Zhuanxu nodded to Tianshi Shengjie before asking Tian Yizu. "Then, what do you mean by the great war?"

"Old Xuanyuan, you’ve never left this domain, so you don’t know the situation out there now, and this universe is no longer the same as in the ancient era." Tian Yizu let out a heavy sigh before continuing. "The order in this universe is too chaotic now, and the character of its inhabitants is deteriorating with each passing era. Not only have the demons changed greatly, but other races, including our winged race, have also undergone significant changes. Our race is now divided into two camps, each with different and contrasting goals. My group has always been loyal to our ancestor’s teaching, but Tian Qiye and her group are different from us. They don’t want our ancestor to return, and they considered getting rid of her."

"We suspect that several other races also conspired with those demons, including the beast and demi-human races. Unfortunately, we have not been able to find concrete evidence of their conspiracy, which prevents both us and Long Wuzhao from taking action against them." Tian Wei said.
Xuanyuan Changyi then asked. "Are Tian Qiye and the others also conspiring with those demons?"

"That possibility exists, but I believe it will never happen," Tian You’an replied confidently. "Tian Qiye and his group do have different views than us regarding the return of our ancestors, but they truly hate those demons. They indiscriminately slaughter any demons they encounter, so I believe the possibility of them conspiring with them is almost nonexistent."

"Sooner or later, a great war between righteousness and evil will break out. Both sides will be divided, one seeking peace, the other seeking power, and Zhang Fei will be the peacemaker." After Tian Yizu made his statement, the six ancestors of the Xuanyuan Clan closely observed Zhang Fei [4].
"Do you think he will truly succeed in becoming the peacemaker for this universe?" Xuanyuan Qian asked doubtfully.

"Haha." Tianshi Shengjie laughed softly. "You don’t know him, so it’s understandable that you have doubts about him, but my emperor also believes that he is destined to be the peacemaker. However, the future is still long, and he still has much to overcome before becoming one. Therefore, we can only wait for the right moment to come, and time will resolve all our current doubts."

"I see." Xuanyuan Qian nodded in understanding. "Since Long Wuzhao believes in him, I will look forward to his results in the future. I hope he truly is the peacemaker, and he will stop those heretics, so this universe will be safe once again."
All of them nodded in agreement with Xuayuan Qian, as they also hoped that the universe would become peaceful once again like in the past, so there would be no casualties.

After waiting for some time, the light dome finally disappeared, revealing Xu Ling’er in the Holy Radiance War Armor. She is no longer in her old form but she has returned to her current self. With the Holy Radiance Crown hovering above her head, the Holy Radiance Golden Sword in her right hand, and golden wings behind her back, she looked like a war angel.

Zhang Fei [4] moved in front of Xu Ling’er. "Your changes are impressive, Ling’er. You are no longer your usual innocent little girl, but you look like a war angel; even your aura is dignified yet calming."

"Big Brother." Xu Ling’er called out softly with a sweet smile on her face. "After my war armor accepted me again, I regained quite a lot of my past memories. Although not all of my old memories have returned, I understand many things better now."
"I see." Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding. "So, what items are left from your equipment set?"
"Cape, shield, and boots." Xu Ling’er looked up at the sky. "Have you guys found them?"

paragraphs: Ye Mingran, who was cultivating in the darkness of the night, suddenly opened her eyes. "What are you doing in my place in the middle of the night, Jiu Mozu? Are you so afraid of death that you brought your subordinates here?"

"Do you think I’m afraid of you?" Jiu Mozu then sat on a small boulder, with the eight demons standing behind him. "You are strong at night, but I manage to become the Demon God of my Nine Nether Demon Race not without a reason. Those two damn demon gods are always targeting me, so I always take them with me wherever I go. I got information that Ye Futian and some members of your race secretly infiltrated the Calamity Domain, so I’m sure you know something about Mo Shentian."
Ye Mingran raised an eyebrow and looked at the female demon with a black eye floating above her head. "If you didn’t have that woman, you would have died long ago."
"Hahaha." Jiu Mozi laughed at that. "You’re right, I’m indeed fortunate to have Jiu Youming by my side. So, what kind of information do you have on Mo Shentian?"

"Mo Shentian tried to establish communication with Taotie and the others, so he sent Mo Taizi and two elders to the dungeon to meet them." Ye Mingran’s answer shocked Jiu Mozi and his subordinates. "He’s targeting Wu Mian now, and those beasts tell him to look for Dong Xuanyin. According to them, she has the ability to see through even the most perfect disguise."

Jiu Mozi put on a bad look. "If she is willing to help him, he will succeed in locating the real body of the Faceless Demon God, making it difficult for us to identify intruders within our demon races."
"That’s right." Ye Mingran nodded at him. "Fu Tian wanted to find out how far Mo Shentian’s preparations were to conquer the other demon races, but he hasn’t found anything until now."

"Mo Shentian has always been cautious and secretive, so there’s no way he would let his secrets be revealed that easily." Ye Mingran nodded in agreement, and Jiu Mozi turned to his subordinates. "Youming, I want you to use your eye abilities to help Ye Futian. If that guy manages to find Wu Mian’s true body, our Nine Nether Demon Race will also be in danger, so you must do your best to uncover his secrets."
"Yes, Demon God." The black eye above Jiu Youming immediately disappeared.
Jiu Mozi then asked Ye Mingran again. "Are there any other demon gods who know about this matter?"
"Nalan Shizhe."
"Oh?" Jiu Mozi was a little surprised. "Do you know her plans? Do you trust her? After all, Nalan Wangzi is Mo Taizi’s fiancée, and she will become Mo Shentian’s in-law soon."
"None of the demon gods are trustworthy, including you."
"Hahaha." Jiu Mozi laughed at that. "You’re right, I am indeed not trustworthy. I could report you to Mo Shentian, and he would come here to attack you. What if we unite our two races? You—"
"Do you think you’re worthy of me?" Ye Mingran coldly asked. "If you have no other business, you can leave now, as your presence is an eyesore."
"Tch!" Jiu Mozi immediately flew away, and the eight demons swiftly followed behind him. "Let’s go back!"

"Haha! That brat never changes, and he still wants you to be his wife, Mingran." Ye Mingran looked at Qi Qingxiu, who had just arrived. "Where did you get the information about Mo Shentian and the evil beast races?"

"Didn’t your members tell you anything about what happened in the dungeon?" Qi Qingxiu shook her head in response, prompting Ye Mingran to explain a few things to her. "Mo Shentian knew that Qiongqi had long yearned for you to be his wife, and he promised them that he would hand you over to him if they managed to help him unite all the demon races. Unfortunately, his plans didn’t go smoothly, and all those evil beasts fell into Long Wuzhao’s hands."
Qi Qingxiu’s forehead creased. "Why did Long Wuzhao enter that dungeon?"

"You’re wrong about that." Ye Mingran denied that. "Long Wuzhao didn’t enter the dungeon at first, but someone picked him and the others up after he found out about Mo Shentian’s plans. He couldn’t defeat those evil beasts by himself, so he asked for their help to fight them."
"Who is the man you mean?"
"We met that man in the Forbidden Land back then."
"Huh?" Qi Qingxiu was shocked to hear that. "Is that man really Zhang Fei?"
"Yes." Ye Mingran nodded slightly. "You saw the Celestial Dragon Princess by his side at that time, so you shouldn’t be surprised that he was able to summon Long Wuzhao and the others, right?"

Qi Qingxiu’s expression turned slightly angry as she remembered the Heavenly Jade Brush. She had desperately wanted it to create a formation, but Luo Yunxiao had snatched it from her and handed it to Zhang Fei. "Do you know where he is now?"

"Qingxiu, I know you’re angry because Zhang Fei snatched the Heavenly Jade Brush from you, but you should forget about that matter. In fact, it’s more beneficial if you establish a good relationship with him, and he can help us to defeat Mo Shentian." Qi Qingxiu frowned in response to Ye Mingran’s statement. "I, Ye Futian, and Nalan Shizhe met him before the dungeon opened. I learned many things in our meeting, including his status as Futian’s great-grand disciple."
"Oh?" Qi Qingxiu was shocked by this, but Ye Mingran’s next words shocked her even more.
"Zhang Fei is Nalan Yushu’s husband, so he is Nalan Shizhe’s son-in-law."
"Are you kidding me? How—"

"He rescued her soul from the Star Tower, and he helped her reshape her body." Qi Qingxiu naturally knew that Nalan Yushu’s soul was sent there by Tian Qiye, but she didn’t expect that she would have such a relationship with Zhang Fei. "There’s one more thing about him, but I can’t tell you, at least for now. We’ve known each other for a long time, so you should already know my character, and I can say with certainty that being on his side is the best choice for us. Currently, there are three camps in our demon races: the first is the Calamity and Asura Demon Races, the second is our three demon races, and the third is the rest of them, except for the Faceless Demon Race."
Qi Qingxiu nodded with that. "Why are you so sure that Zhang Fei will succeed in helping us defeat Mo Shentian?"

"Have you forgotten the identities of the two women who accompanied him in the Forbidden Land?" Qi Qingxiu naturally remembered Feng Yao and Huo Ling’s presence at that time, and Ye Mingran immediately spoke to her again. "Even Long Wuzhao was willing to answer his call, so you shouldn’t have any doubts about him, right? He is weaker than us now, but his talent surpasses any cultivator I’ve ever met, and he has people of their caliber by his side."

Qi Qingxiu released a soft sigh. "Empress Huo Yanling, the Eternal Flame, and Long Wuzhao. Every single one of them is already too terrifying even for Mo Shentian, and their strength will be even more frightening if they join one team."

"That’s right." Ye Mingran then informed her of something else. "Additionally, Zhang Fei also has good relations with Tian Yizu, Jia Lingzhu, Jia Shengyun, Feng Bingying, Feng Shizhu, and many more people."
Qi Qingxiu released a soft sigh. "So, where is Zhang Fei now?"

"The Moonlit Passion Temple." Ye Mingran’s answer took Qi Qingxiu aback. "He’s a dual cultivator, and that sect can be said to be his now, even though Qing Qiu’er is still their sect master. By the way, you don’t need to go there now because he’s already entered seclusion again, and no one knows when he’ll come out."
Qi Qingxiu nodded slightly. "Does he know about Dong Xuanyin’s whereabouts?"

"I don’t have an answer to that myself yet, but I don’t think it really matters, and the most important thing is that we have to find Wu Mian before Mo Shentian." Qi Qingxiu fell into deep thought, but Ye Mingran then informed her of the plan she had devised with Nalah Shizhe a few days ago. "Do you want to join us?"
"I’m in! When are we leaving?"
"As soon as possible, but we have to monitor the situation first, and I also still have to wait for Futian to come back."
Qi Qingxiu nodded in understanding. "In that case, I’ll start preparing, and you can tell me when it’s time for us to move."
"Alright."

sentences.text: As per Zhang Fei’s order, Ming Tianhe and Qiu Meixuan gathered the elders of the Blazing Union Sect and informed them of their decision to merge with the Moonlit Passion Temple, which shocked all the male elders.
All the female elders were also shocked, but they were pleased with their decision because the Moonlit Passion Temple possessed the Celestial Yin Lake, which was more beneficial to them.
All the male elders wanted to protest to Ming Tianhe and Qiu Meixuan, but Xie Heilong and Xie Zhi immediately appeared behind them, which made them scared.
The incident in the dungeon a few days ago left trauma for some of them, as they almost died at the hands of those evil beasts.
"Two Sect Masters, they—"
"They are the protectors of the Moonlit Passion Temple now." Qiu Meixuan’s answer further shocked them.
"Even though Zhang Fei has the status of an elder of the sect, he is no different from their leader because he is the partner of Sect Master Qing, and he tamed them to be their protector.
Therefore, we decided to accept his offer after we learned everything, and they will protect us from enemies.
Additionally, we have agreed to retain the name of this sect to prevent chaos in this domain, and your status as elders remains unchanged."
Ming Tianhe then spoke.
"Our sect will be a male-only sect, and their male elders and disciples will move here.
Meanwhile, our female elders and disciples will move to their sect, but you guys don’t need to worry about that because you can still dual cultivate with your respective partners.
Elder Zhang will install a teleportation device between the two sects, and you guys can travel back and forth easily."
"Isn’t the Moonlit Passion Temple already a universal sect, Sect Master?" A female elder asked.
Qiu Meixuan nodded at her.
"They have become a universal sect, but they maintain their dual cultivation sector.
Their dual cultivators live on the mountain, and their new non-dual cultivators reside below it."
Hearing this, the female elders began to discuss the matter, and they decided to accept the merger offer.
Their first reason was the Celestial Yin Lake, and their second reason was that they could easily return to their sect to meet their partners, so it was a win-win solution for them.
Unlike them, the male elders felt uncomfortable and hesitated to accept the merger offer, but the presence of Xie Heilong and Xie Zhi frightened them, and they eventually agreed to it.

"Go now and inform the disciples about this matter, and we must complete the merger process within a month." The female elders enthusiastically went about carrying out Qiu Meixuan’s orders, unlike the male elders.
"Why are you gloomy, Tianhe?
Ru Xian and I will still be living in the sect with you, so nothing has changed between us."
Meng Tianhe shook his head.
"I’m worried if other people find out that you two have become blood demons."
"Heh." Xie Heilong snorted behind them.
"Do you still need to worry about that with our master behind you two?
He previously defeated those demons, and this sect will be under our protection, so they won’t dare to attack us."
"Alright, I leave the protection of this sect to you guys."
At the Moonlit Passion Sect, Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling announced their decision to merge with the Blazing Union Sect to their dual cultivator elders and disciples.
Unlike the Blazing Union Sect, the male elders and disciples were delighted with the merger and looked forward to cultivating at that sect’s Celestial Yang Lake.
As for the ten special disciples, they will stay in their sect, and they will only go there if they want to cultivate at the lake.

"He took me to the Three Mortal Realms last night." Qi Qingxiu’s words surprised both Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1237: Frozen Heaven Body Technique
paragraphs: "This sect became even more crowded after merging with the Blazing Union Sect," Helian Xun’er spoke to Zhang Fei, who was standing beside her in the air.
Zhang Fei nodded at her. "The number of our disciples has indeed increased, but not many new disciples have joined us, especially the non-dual cultivators."

"That’s as expected, right? This sect’s reputation as a dual cultivation sect still lives on, and it’s never easy to change our reputation." Zhang Fei nodded to Helian Xun’er, who then asked him. "When do you plan to go to the Slaughter Blood Domain?"

"I have to prepare some things first, so I’ll be leaving in a few days." Zhang Fei then looked to the back of the mountain. "Since you are natives of this realm, I hope you can join them on their adventure to other domains."
Helian Xun’er smiled at that. "Although I am not yet your official wife, I am already yours, and they are my sisters. Therefore, you don’t need to ask me, and I’ll be happy to accompany them."

"After I return from the Slaughter Blood Domain, I will immediately eat you, so you should prepare yourself." Helian Xun’er was stunned, but Zhang Fei immediately kissed her lips. "Are you still hesitant about becoming my wife after we’ve been together for a few months?"

"No." Helian Xun’er shook her head slightly. "I’ve never had any hesitation about becoming your wife; it’s just that I’m not ready to dual cultivate with you yet. Alright, I will prepare myself during your absence, and we will dual cultivate after you return."

Zhang Fei nodded in satisfaction, but Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye suddenly appeared before them. "I will accompany you to my domain, and I will leave Zhiye here to protect any of your wives who want to go to other domains."
"Alright." Zhang Fei then asked him. "Have you ever heard of the old fox’s statue in your domain? Is the Blood Sea close to the Asura Demon God’s residence?"

Tian Shuixiang shook his head. "I’ve never heard of the old fox’s statue, but I know some people who might have, so we’ll go meet them once we arrive at my domain. As for the Blood Sea, it’s quite far from my Demon God’s residence, but that area is never safe. We’ll face many demons there, and many of them are powerful, so you must be prepared for many possibilities when we go there."

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding, then summoned Ma Kuangyu to meet them and immediately asked him a question as soon as he appeared. "What kind of special mark did you use to mark the location of the Corpse-Refining Coffin?"

Ma Kuangyu touched Zhang Fei’s forehead and imparted something. "You can use it to track the Corpse-Refining Coffin’s location, but you must not open it there. You must bring it back to me first, and I will unlock the seal on it for you."
"I know." Zhang Fei nodded at him.

Ma Kuangyu then informed him of something else. "A month ago, Ma Youling looked for my clan members, but they didn’t reply to her messages. According to them, she disappeared along with the destruction of my Ma Clan, and she never contacted them before a month ago. They suspected that she was kidnapped by members of the Nine Nether Demon Race back then, and they thought that she had become a demon now, so they chose not to reply to her."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows. "What does Ma Youling want from your clansmen?"
"Ma Youling didn’t mention anything to them, but she urged them to tell her their location. Are you planning to take action against her?"

Zhang Fei thought about it for a while before nodding to him. "Tell one of your clansmen to contact Ma Youling, but please ask that person not to mention this domain, and we’ll meet her in another domain."
"Which domain?"
"The Sun-Moon Domain." Zhang Fei’s answer took Ma Kuangyu back. "I plan to go to that domain to meet Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing, so we will meet Ma Youling there."
"Alright, I will ask one of them to contact Ma Youling now." Ma Kuangyu immediately left the place, as did Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye.
Helian Xun’er then asked him. "Are you still planning to challenge the Star Tower?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei had no other choice but to challenge the Star Tower, as he still had six quests left there, and all the items from those quests were always useful for them. "However, I won’t take them there, and only my clones will go there."
"Why are you so eager to continue?" Helian Xun’er asked in a curious manner, as the Star Tower should no longer be of use to Zhang Fei with his cultivation already reaching the Five Celestial Realms.
"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed at her expression. "I still have some business there, but I can’t tell you now, and I will tell you in the future."
"Secretive as always." Helian Xun’er shook her head helplessly. "I’ll go back to the back of the mountain now."

Mei suddenly spoke to Zhang Fei. [Master, you still have some rewards that you haven’t opened. The reward from helping Zhang Yue pass the ice phoenix trials, three sect rewards, and the three dungeon rewards.]
’Open them then.’
[You obtained 1 Frozen Heaven Body Technique.]
[You obtained 1 Sect’s Summoning Lamp.]
[You obtained 1 Sect Guardian Formation Array.]
[You obtained 1 Peak Grade Qi Vein.]
[You obtained 1 Lantern of Hidden Paths.]
[You obtained 1 Tear of Reincarnation.]
[You obtained 1 Fragment of the Temple of the Forgotten Flames.]
’Hmm?’ Zhang Fei was surprised by the first item. ’Dang! I should have opened it a long time ago!’

[The Frozen Heaven Body Technique is a supreme cultivation method that channels boundless heavenly cold into the body, refining the flesh, bones, and meridians into an unshakable vessel of ice and frost.]
> Frost Veins: Strengthened the cultivator’s veins using threads of icy qi. The body gains resistance to cold and can release chilling mist.
> Crystal Bones: The skeleton becomes crystalline and translucent, unbreakable like divine jade. Every movement release biting cold that can slow or even freeze enemies.
> Frozen Marrow: Bone marrow solidifies with heavenly frost, rapidly regenerating qi and vitality. Wounds begin to seal with a layer of ice before fully healing.
> Icy Flesh: Skin that shimmers faintly with a pale sheen, harder than steel. Even fire has difficulty burning the body, as cold qi counteracts and suppresses heat.

> Heavenly Frozen Body: The cultivator embodies the will of winter. Their presence lowers the temperature for miles around, freezing rivers and shattering mountains with a single move. The body itself becomes a divine vessel of eternal frost, impervious to corruption, fire, and decay.

’Phew.’ Zhang Fei exhaled softly. ’Just leave it to my clones to learn this technique, but I’m sure I need a place with extreme cold to practice it, and the residence of the Ice Phoenix race is the most suitable place for that.’
[I think so, Master. Since you will only be leaving for the Slaughter Blood Domain in a few days, I think you should bring Zhang Yue, Feng Xueying, and Feng Jinqiu to the ice phoenixes’ abode first.]
’Yeah.’ Zhang Fei nodded at her before looking at the other items. ’Hmm? The Sect’s Summoning Lamp, huh?’
[The Sect’s Summoning Lamp: A mystical lamp that uses spiritual fire to perform summoning rituals. When lit, its light forms a summoning array that summons people connected to the sect.]

[The Sect Guardian Formation Array is a grand defensive formation, and it will summon a barrier of heaven and earth once activated, bolstering disciples while weakening intruders. This array will manifest elemental retribution, illusions, and guardian spirits, ensuring that no enemy escapes unscathed.]

[Peak Grade Qi Vein is the highest quality spiritual vein, filled with the purest qi from heaven and earth. Their qi flows endlessly like sacred underground rivers, nourishing all cultivation within its reach. Cultivators who cultivate above them will experience rapid qi circulation, smoother breakthroughs, and greatly reduced bottlenecks.]
[The Lantern of Hidden Paths is an ancient artifact that reveals routes invisible to the naked eye. It illuminates hidden passages, secret realms, and safe passages through deadly formations.]
[Tear of Reincarnation: unknown item.]

’Another unknown item? It should be related to reincarnation, but I don’t know its use.’ Zhang Fei ignored the map fragment, as he already had the previous two, and he still had to find the remaining three to uncover the mystery of the Temple of the Forgotten Flames. ’Who exactly is that young girl? Where did she get all those items? Almost all the items I got from the quest were extraordinary items.’
After that, Zhang Fei returned to the back of the mountain to meet Duanmu Luolan, and he handed the Sect Guardian Formation Array to her, which shocked her.

Duanmu Luolan looked at him suspiciously, but Zhang Fei only smiled, making her sigh helplessly. "Set up the formation as soon as possible, but you don’t need to remove the old barrier. This way, we’ll have triple protection with Bing Xingying’s void barrier, and we’ll be even safer."
"Alright, I’ll do it now, but I need some help, so I’ll go see those elders first." Duanmu Luolan immediately flew away.
Zhang Fei then met Zhang Yue, Feng Xueying, and Feng Jinqiu, sharing the Frozen Heaven Body Technique with them. "Get ready now; we will go to the residence of the Ice Phoenix."

chapters.title: Chapter 1238: Ice Phoenix Domain
paragraphs: Zhang Fei decided to bring Tianshi Shengjie, the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race, with them because she was a native of the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain in the Divine Origin Main Domain.

They stood before the gate connecting them to the Divine Origin Main Domain, but Tianshi Shengjie warned Zhang Fei first. "Once we pass through this gate, there is a possibility that Jia Zizhen will notice your presence. I can’t predict his next move, but I believe you won’t be able to escape his surveillance. Therefore, you must prepare for the worst, and your life in this realm may never be peaceful."

"I know." Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "I’m aware of the risks, but I can’t hide from Jia Zizhen forever. Eventually, we will meet, and a clash between us will be inevitable. He is powerful, but he won’t be able to kill me that easily, especially with Serpentera and the others by my side."

Tianshi Shengjie nodded in agreement. "Sepentera and Tian Kui are ancient beasts, and they are powerful enough to help you deal with Jia Zizhen. Furthermore, you still have Xie Heilong and eight other evil mythical beasts by your side, so you should be able to deal with him with their help. Additionally, you suspect that he is collaborating with the Nine Nether Demon God; however, it is unclear whether he is also allied with the other demon races, so you must remain cautious."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei then asked her. "Do you think I can sneak into the Floral Mirage Domain using my invisibility?"

Tianshi Shengjie shook her head. "Your invisibility is indeed useful against many people from various races, but you won’t be able to use it in my Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain or the Floral Mirage Domain. Therefore, you should forget about your intention to infiltrate there, and Jia Zizhen will find you as soon as you set foot there."
"Alright."
As soon as they arrived at the Divine Origin Main Domain, Zhang Fei used the nine cloud steps and led them to the northernmost part of the domain, where a portal was located.

Zhang Fei didn’t stop and led them into the portal, where they were greeted by a vast expansion of ice and a bone-chilling cold. Tianshi Shengjie trembled with the bone-chilling cold, but he immediately hugged her and channeled his fire element into her body, warming her.
On the contrary, Feng Xueying, Feng Jinqiu, and Zhang Yue thoroughly enjoyed the cold because they were ice phoenixes.
Zhang Fei wanted to take them away, but two ice phoenixes quickly flew towards them. They turned into young women and asked Tianshi Shengjie. "What brought you here, Celestial Dragon Princess?"

"This man is Zhang Fei, and he is the successor of the ten-tailed fox." Both young women were shocked to hear that, but he immediately transformed into his half-fox form with nine fox tails behind him. "These three women are his wives: Feng Jinqiu, Feng Xueying, and Zhang Yue."

Feng Jinqiu and Feng Xueying felt awkward because they were not Zhang Fei’s wives, but Tianshi Shengjie introduced them as such. The two young women believed her because they could sense his Yang Qi in their bodies.
However, the two young women’s attention immediately shifted to Zhang Yue, as their ancestor and matriarch had already told them about her.
Zhang Fei immediately spoke to them. "A few years ago, Feng Bingying and Feng Shizhu invited us to come to this domain, but we were still busy with our seclusion, so I brought them here today."
"We know." The two young women once again turned into ice phoenixes. "Please follow us; we will take you to our ice town."
"Let’s go."
A while later, the two phoenixes returned to their human forms and landed in front of a village where all the buildings were made of cold ice.
Zhang Fei immediately led the three women to follow the two ice phoenixes, but they saw no one there, as the other ice phoenixes were more focused on cultivating in their respective residences.
The two young women led Zhang Fei and the others to the largest house in the center of the village, which was the residence of Feng Bingying and Feng Shizhu.
"Matriarch."
"Let them in, Ruochen and Muling."
"Yes, Matriarch." Feng Ruochen turned to them. "You guys can come in now, and we will return to our place."

After the two phoenixes left, Zhang Fei immediately led the others inside. They were a little surprised by the interior, as there was almost nothing there except tables and chairs made of ice, with Feng Bingying sitting on an ice throne at the end of the room.
Feng Bingying hurriedly descended from her ice throne and walked before them. She seriously observed Zhang Yue. "She’s finally reached the Five Celestial Realms."
"She broke through a few days ago, so I brought them here today." Feng Bingying nodded in understanding at Zhang Fei, who then asked her, "Do you have a special place for us to cultivate?"

Feng Bingying nodded at him. "Naturally, we have that kind of place, but you should know that only female ice phoenixes live here, and most of them, including Ancestor Shizhu, engage in cultivation there. Thus, you—"

"If Fei’er can’t cultivate here, I won’t cultivate here either, and we will return to our domain now." Feng Bingying turned to Zhang Yue directly. "I understand your thoughts, but I won’t change mine. Moreover, his Yang Qi is much more beneficial to me, and I can cultivate faster by dual cultivating with him."

Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu naturally wanted to cultivate in that domain, but they chose to support Zhang Yue. Although they weren’t yet Zhang Fei’s wives, they had lived with him and the others for over two decades, and they had always cultivated using his Yang Qi.

Tianshi Shengjie shrugged when Feng Bingying looked at her, signaling to her that she didn’t want to interfere in their affairs. Furthermore, the female ice phoenix should already know about the closeness between Zhang Fei and all his wives, so she should be aware that she wouldn’t be able to attract his wives into her race without him.

Feng Bingying inwardly sighed and contacted her ancestor first. To her surprise, her ancestor asked her to bring Zhang Fei and the others to their cultivation place, as Feng Shizhu understood them better than her. "Alright, I will take you there, but you cannot join us, Celestial Dragon Princess. The cold there is far more extreme than any other area in this domain, and your cultivation will not be able to help you survive there, so you must return to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain."
"I know." Tianshi Shengjie nodded to her.

Zhang Fei immediately opened a portal to the training space. "Go in, Shengjie. I won’t be cultivating for too long in this domain because I have business in another domain. I’ll take you there after I master the initial stage of my ice body cultivation technique."
"Okay." Tianshi Shengjie immediately entered the training space.
After that, Feng Bingying led Zhang Fei and the three women to the ice phoenix’s cultivation place. "What kind of ice body cultivation technique do you want to learn?"
"The Frozen Heaven Body Technique." Feng Bingying looked at Zhang Fei curiously. "I just got that technique, but it requires extreme cold to practice, so I brought them here directly."

"Can you tell me the effects of that body technique?" Zhang Fei directly told Feng Bingying about the technique. "I don’t know where you got that technique, but I think the effects of that technique are almost similar to my Winter Celestial Sutra."
Zhang Fei was curious about her technique. "Can you share that technique with me?"
"Sure."

> Heart Tempering: Strengthens the heart and circulatory system, allowing the cultivator to endure extreme cold and suppress internal injuries.
> Vein Expansion: Widens and strengthens the meridians to store and circulate vast amounts of ice qi, boosting ice elemental attacks.
> Frostbone Flexing: Increases skeletal flexibility without weakening strength, allowing the body to move like flowing ice while maintaining durability.
> Chilling Essence Absorption: Trains the body to absorb ambient cold energy from the environment, converting it into internal vitality and cultivation power.
> Winter Soul Physique: Perfects the body’s overall alignment with extreme cold qi, enhancing resilience and the body’s natural frost aura.

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei read the effects of the technique seriously. "The effects of your technique are almost similar to mine, but they are also different, and I think we can combine the effects of both techniques."
Feng Bingying nodded at him. "Please share your technique with me, and I’ll try to learn it before trying to combine it with mine."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei imparted the Frozen Heaven Body Technique to Feng Bingying. "Are all your clan members cultivating there right now?"
"No." Feng Bingying shook her head in response. "Most of them are at their residence, and a small number are cultivating there. Why don’t you bring one of your clones here?"

Zhang Fei released a soft sigh. "One of them must oversee my sect, and the other four are still assisting their respective wives, as they haven’t yet reached the Five Celestial Realms. Once they reach that stage, I will send one of them here to deepen my cultivation of the two ice body techniques."

chapters.title: Chapter 1239: Jia Zizhen’s Threat
paragraphs: The further they advanced, Zhang Fei and the three women could feel the increasingly cold chill. "How can this area be this cold?"
"Have you ever heard of Qi veins in our world?" Feng Bingying asked back.
Zhang Fei nodded at her. "I’ve encountered one in the past, but it was only a low-grade Qi vein. All realms or domains have them, but their quality and grade vary, with the highest being peak grade."

"Yes." Feng Bingying then told him. "There are special Qi veins in this domain, but they are centered in the area in front of us, and we call them the Eternal Icy Qi Veins because they continuously emit an incomparable coldness. Even though his golden flame is one of the best in this universe, Long Wuzhao would have to think twice about setting foot in that area because the coldness there can rival his flames. Although you have several bloodline beasts with a strong affinity for the fire element, I wouldn’t dare to take you to that place if you didn’t possess our ice phoenix bloodline and icy cold flames."
"Can’t his golden crow flame be used in that place, Ancestor?" Feng Xueying asked.
"No." Feng Bingying then spoke to Zhang Fei. "Try using your golden crow flame."

"Alright." Zhang Fei stretched his hand forward and tried to use it, but his golden crow flame immediately disappeared because of the coldness in that area. "Holy shit! I often rely on my golden crow flame to fight my enemies, but my flame immediately disappeared here."

Feng Bingying smiled upon hearing that. "Once we arrive in that area, you guys will feel an even more terrifying cold. In this universe, nothing can match the coldness of our ice phoenix race, and this place greatly amplifies our cold. In the past, the four perils repeatedly attacked other domains, but they never once dared to set foot in this domain. If they dare to invade our domain, we will freeze and imprison them for the rest of their lives."
"Can’t you just kill them?" Feng Jinqiu asked in confusion.

"Jinqiu, all the ice phoenixes here, including Ancestor Shizhu, are mythical beasts. Meanwhile, the four perils have already surpassed us, and all of them are immortal beasts like the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu. Although our cultivation level matches theirs, the disparity in our beast ranks prevents us from killing them." Feng Jinqiu nodded in understanding to Feng Bingying, who then warned Zhang Fei. "All this time, you can suppress other beasts with your beast aura because you are a mythical rank beast, but you will not be able to suppress the four perils, and they will suppress you instead. If you encounter any of them, you must flee immediately. The only ones who can fight them now are Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, and Tianshi Bailong."

Zhang Fei was aware of this, and it was the reason he had to flee when Xereth summoned Taotie’s avatar twice in the past. "How can Feng Shizhu’s beast rank still be at mythical rank? She has lived for a very long time, right?"

"Ancestor Shizu has lived for more than a million years, but upgrading our beast rank to the immortal rank is not as easy as you imagine. According to what I heard, Taotie and the other three spent several million years reaching that rank, and they used many cruel methods to achieve it, such as absorbing many mythical-rank beasts." Feng Bingying’s answer didn’t surprise Zhang Fei because he had heard a lot from Tian Kui and Serpentera, and their race almost became extinct because of it. "The fastest beast to reach the immortal rank is Long Wuzhao, so you can ask him about it."
Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Since I am already in this main domain, I will visit Long Wuzhao in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain after I learn the initial stage of both techniques."
"That’s good."
Before long, they had arrived at the area Feng Bingying had mentioned before, where they saw Feng Shizhu and dozens of young women cultivating seriously.
However, they were not clustered in one place; instead, they were sitting separately in a few groups, surrounding Feng Shizhu, who sat in the center.

Zhang Fei was stunned to see them cultivating naked, and his expression made Feng Bingying sigh in her heart. ’Is he considering eating them? I don’t understand why Ancestor Shizhu let him come here.’

Unlike Feng Bingying, the three women behind Zhang Fei did not think that way, especially Zhang Yue. She could see that he was not aroused by their naked bodies, as his dick did not react to the beautiful sight in front of them.
"Let’s start cultivating here."
"Yes." Zhang Yue, Feng Xueying, and Feng Jinqiu were overjoyed.

Feng Bingying hurriedly reminded them. "For now, the three of you don’t go to the middle area, and you guys must cultivate in this side area. After you get used to the cold, you can move to deeper areas."
"What about Fei’er?"

Feng Bingying immediately explained to Zhang Yue, "Unlike you three, Zhang Fei possesses several bloodline beasts with a high affinity for the fire element, and he also possesses several types of flames within his body. He can use them to withstand the cold there, so it shouldn’t be a problem for him to cultivate in the center together with Ancestor Shizhu."
Zhang Yue nodded in understanding and sat down at her spot, followed by Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu. "Fei’er, I will cultivate here."

"Alright." Zhang Fei floated to the center and sat beside Feng Shizhu, who was still closing her eyes, even though she had long sensed their presence. He closed his eyes and began to absorb the ice qi in that place while learning both body cultivation techniques simultaneously.

Since both techniques required extreme cold to master them, Zhang Fei’s five clones couldn’t learn them from their places. He had to rely on himself to learn both, but it wasn’t a big problem for him because he was already more experienced as a cultivator, and he had also learned some techniques that were much more difficult than the two.

Feng Bingying observed Zhang Fei for some time, and she was relieved that he didn’t have any lewd thoughts about her ancestors and race members. She decided to join them at the center, and she took off her clothes before starting her cultivation.

As Tianshi Shengjie had expected, the Fairy King, Jia Zizhen, detected Zhang Fei’s presence in the Divine Origin Main Domain. He immediately gathered several of his subordinates, including Jia Yuyan’s grandparents, Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun.

Many of them were overjoyed to hear the news because they had been waiting a long time for the successor of the ten-tailed fox to come to their domain, but some others were not happy with the news because they never wanted the return of the ten-tailed fox, just like their emperor.

Both Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun were shocked as soon as Jia Zizhen informed them of Zhang Fei’s presence in the Divine Origin Main Domain, as he came so suddenly. Back then, they warned him not to come before his cultivation reached the Celestial Emperor Realm, but he didn’t listen to them, leaving them wondering about the reason behind his recklessness.

However, Jia Zizhen was still unaware that one of the elders of his fairy race, Jia Fengli, had long been Zhang Fei’s spy. After all, he did not use a slave mark to control the old fairy; instead, he used other methods to keep his actions against him under wraps.
"What are your plans for Zhang Fei, Emperor?" Jia Shengyun asked.
Jia Lingzhu also asked him. "Will you invite him to our domain and take him to the fox statue, Emperor?"

"Do you think I’ll let him go there?" Jia Zizhen then spoke to them. "I did detect Zhang Fei’s presence in the main domain, but he has gone to the Ice Phoenix Domain. No one can enter that place, including me, because the cold there will freeze us the moment we enter. Therefore, we can only wait for him to leave that domain, and I will meet him by myself to invite him to come to our domain."
’Do you think we are stupid? We know for sure you want to kill him.’ Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun inwardly grumbled.

"What about your granddaughter?" Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun looked at Jia Zizhen directly. "Do you think I’m stupid? Zhang Fei has already arrived in this realm, so Jia Yuyan should have already returned. Furthermore, I can sense her faint aura from both of you, so I’m sure she’s in this realm."
Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun were shocked by this, as they had already removed Jia Yuyan’s aura from their bodies, yet Jia Zizhen could still detect it.

Jia Zizhen immediately released his aura and suppressed the two of them, forcing them to kneel on the ground. "Are you two trying to rebel against me? Jia Yuyan is destined to be my wife, and if you two deliberately hide her from me, I will consider your actions treason. You two must hand her over to me now; otherwise, you will suffer the consequences."
"Emperor, we—"
Jia Zhen and the others were stunned when a void suddenly opened in front of them, accompanied by loud laughter. "Hahaha!"
Jia Zizhen frowned as Long Wuzhao and Long Xukong walked out of it, and the golden dragon emperor dispelled his aura. "What do you mean by this, Dragon Emperor?"

He had to rely on himself to learn both, but it wasn’t a big problem for him because he was already more experienced as a cultivator, and he had also learned some techniques that were much more difficult than the two.
Feng Bingying observed Zhang Fei for some time, and she was relieved that he didn’t have any lewd thoughts about her ancestors and race members.
She decided to join them at the center, and she took off her clothes before starting her cultivation.
As Tianshi Shengjie had expected, the Fairy King, Jia Zizhen, detected Zhang Fei’s presence in the Divine Origin Main Domain.
He immediately gathered several of his subordinates, including Jia Yuyan’s grandparents, Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun.

Many of them were overjoyed to hear the news because they had been waiting a long time for the successor of the ten-tailed fox to come to their domain, but some others were not happy with the news because they never wanted the return of the ten-tailed fox, just like their emperor.
Both Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun were shocked as soon as Jia Zizhen informed them of Zhang Fei’s presence in the Divine Origin Main Domain, as he came so suddenly.
Back then, they warned him not to come before his cultivation reached the Celestial Emperor Realm, but he didn’t listen to them, leaving them wondering about the reason behind his recklessness.
However, Jia Zizhen was still unaware that one of the elders of his fairy race, Jia Fengli, had long been Zhang Fei’s spy.
After all, he did not use a slave mark to control the old fairy; instead, he used other methods to keep his actions against him under wraps.
"What are your plans for Zhang Fei, Emperor?" Jia Shengyun asked.
Jia Lingzhu also asked him.
"Will you invite him to our domain and take him to the fox statue, Emperor?"
"Do you think I’ll let him go there?" Jia Zizhen then spoke to them.
"I did detect Zhang Fei’s presence in the main domain, but he has gone to the Ice Phoenix Domain.
No one can enter that place, including me, because the cold there will freeze us the moment we enter.
Therefore, we can only wait for him to leave that domain, and I will meet him by myself to invite him to come to our domain."
’Do you think we are stupid?
We know for sure you want to kill him.’ Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun inwardly grumbled.
"What about your granddaughter?" Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun looked at Jia Zizhen directly.
"Do you think I’m stupid?
Zhang Fei has already arrived in this realm, so Jia Yuyan should have already returned.
Furthermore, I can sense her faint aura from both of you, so I’m sure she’s in this realm."
Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun were shocked by this, as they had already removed Jia Yuyan’s aura from their bodies, yet Jia Zizhen could still detect it.
Jia Zizhen immediately released his aura and suppressed the two of them, forcing them to kneel on the ground.
"Are you two trying to rebel against me?
Jia Yuyan is destined to be my wife, and if you two deliberately hide her from me, I will consider your actions treason.
You two must hand her over to me now; otherwise, you will suffer the consequences."
"Emperor, we—"
Jia Zhen and the others were stunned when a void suddenly opened in front of them, accompanied by loud laughter.
"Hahaha!"
Jia Zizhen frowned as Long Wuzhao and Long Xukong walked out of it, and the golden dragon emperor dispelled his aura.
"What do you mean by this, Dragon Emperor?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1240: Mo Shentian’s Decision
paragraphs: "Fairy King, I never like to interfere in the affairs of other races, but we both know your past deeds, so you don’t need to pretend to be innocent in front of me, right?" Long Wuzhao turned to Long Xukong, who immediately enveloped Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun with his void element and threw them into the void, causing Jia Zizhen to frown. "For now, the two of them are under my protection, and if you cannot accept my decision, you can come to me in my palace, and I will be happy to welcome you."
After saying this, Long Wuzhao returned to the void, followed by Long Xukong, who immediately closed it.
*Boom*
Jia Zizhen’s aura immediately exploded, and his expression was full of anger, making all his subordinates frightened, except for Jia Fengli.

When Jia Zizhen threatened Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun before, Jia Fengli immediately contacted his master, and Zhang Fei contacted Long Wuzhao, asking for his help to save Jia Yuyan’s grandparents from the fairy king.

"That dragon bastard! How dare he interfere in my personal affairs and threaten me!" Jia Zizhen shouted angrily before ordering his subordinates. "Search all domains for me and find Jia Yuyan immediately! If anyone dares to obstruct you, you can kill them!"

"Yes, Emperor." All of them immediately left the scene, but not all of them considered following Jia Zizhen’s orders due to past rumors of his actions. Long Wuzhao’s previous words convinced them that their emperor had indeed done bad things in the past, especially towards his predecessors.
*Bam*

"Damn it! What exactly happened? How did that bastard dragon know the situation here? Could he have planted his spies without my knowledge? Who betrayed me and chose to be his spy? I never detected the presence of other races in my domain, so I’m sure the traitor is among my subordinates." Jia Zizhen’s forehead veins protruded from beneath his skin as he was extremely furious. "Tch! I have to contact Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu to discuss this matter with them, or things will get dire for me if that bastard dragon interferes further in my affairs."
Jia Zizhen stepped down from his throne and left the place, unaware that Long Wuzhao and Long Xukong were still there and eavesdropping on him through the void.
A while later, Long Xukong took Long Wuzhao and the other two out of the void, and they had already arrived at the dragon palace in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain. "Brother Wuzhao."

"Yes." Long Wuzhao nodded to Long Xukong. "Zhang Fei previously suspected that Jia Zizhen was in cahoots with Jiu Mozu, but it turns out he was also in cahoots with Mo Shentian. Back then, I was sure that he killed the previous Fairy King, but he couldn’t have done it by himself due to the disparity in their strengths. However, the story is different if the two demon gods helped him and ganged up on his predecessor, as their combined strength surpassed that of his predecessor."
Long Xukong nodded in agreement. "So, what should we do? Are we going to make a move against Jia Zizhen?"

"No need." Long Wuzhao dismissed his idea. "Even if we already know that Jia Zizhen is in cahoots with them, we still don’t have valid evidence of his conspiracy with the two demon gods. Therefore, we have to look for the evidence regarding their conspiracy first, and we will take him down once we find it, or people will accuse us of acting arbitrarily."
"Jia Zizhen will likely meet Mo Shentian and the Jiu Mozu soon, so I’ll start monitoring him." After Long Wuzhao agreed, Long Xukong immediately entered the void again.
Jia Shengyun immediately asked Long Wuzhao. "How did you know about our situation, Dragon Emperor?"

"Haha." Long Wuzhao laughed in response. "You two are lucky because your granddaughter is Zhang Fei’s wife, and that kid is truly cunning. He didn’t tell me the truth, but I’m sure that he already enslaved one of Jia Zizhen’s subordinates. As soon as your king threatened you two, his slave reported your situation to him, and he asked my help to save you guys."
The two old fairies exchanged glances for a moment, and Jia Lingzhu immediately spoke to her husband. "I think I know that person’s identity."

"I think the same as you." Jia Shengyun nodded at her. "I’m sure Zhang Fei’s spy was Jia Fengli, as he started to change after we returned from the dungeon. Luckily, Jia Zizhen was overconfident in himself, and he didn’t notice his change. I hope he never realizes it so that kid can continue to monitor his movements and plans."
Jia Lingzhu nodded in agreement. "Let’s hope so."

"For the time being, you two can stay in my domain, and that foolish king will not dare to come here. Even if he asks for help from Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozi, they won’t have the guts to infiltrate here, so you guys don’t need to worry too much about it." After he called someone to escort Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun, Long Wuzhao immediately went to see Tianshi Bailong and the others, where he discussed matters regarding Jia Zizhen with them.

Mo Shentian, who was cultivating in his private quarters, suddenly raised his eyebrows at the incoming voice message. He abruptly opened his eyes after listening to the message, and he hurriedly left the place while summoning his children.

A while later, Mo Shentian was already sitting on his throne with his children standing below. "Zixiao, I’ll go look for Dong Xuanyin, but that woman is quite troublesome and difficult to find. Therefore, I’ll be gone for quite some time, so you’ll take my place for the time being, and you must continue to monitor the movements of the other demon gods, especially the Faceless Demon God Wu Mian."
"Yes, Father." Mo Zixiao nodded at him.

Mo Shentian then spoke to his second son. "Taizi, I don’t care how you do it, but I want you to convince Nalan Wangzi as soon as possible, and I want you two to marry after I return. Do you understand?"
"Yes, Father." Mo Taizi actually never wanted to marry Nalan Wangzi, but he did not have the guts to refute his father’s order.
"What about me, Father?" Another male demon asked, and he is Mo Shentian’s third son, Mo Tianqi.

Mo Shentian looked at him with narrowed eyes. "You will go with me to look for Dong Xuanyin, Tianqi. However, I warn you to behave yourself when we meet her, or I won’t be able to save you if you incur her wrath."
"Huh?" Mo Tianqi was surprised to hear that. "Is that female beast really that strong, Father?"

"Dong Xuanyin isn’t as strong as me or the Four Perils, but she has unique abilities that make Taotie and the others fear her. According to what I’ve heard, she once defeated the four of them with her unique abilities, and none of them could move in front of her. Therefore, you should not underestimate her, and you should watch your attitude in front of her. Do you understand?" After Mo Tianqi nodded, Mo Shentian immediately stepped down from his throne and took his third son away, and his two other sons also went to attend to their own affairs.

Jiu Mozu was standing in front of his nine subordinates, listening to Ma Youling’s report. "In that case, you can go meet that man in the Sun-Moon Domain soon and do everything possible to force him to help you."
"Yes, Demon God." Ma Youling immediately disappeared from that place.
Jiu Mozu then asked his other subordinates. "Is the news true, Youming? Did Ye Mingran and Ye Futian really disappear from their domain?"
"Yes." Jiu Yaoming nodded at him. "They disappeared three weeks ago, but I don’t know how they disappeared. I’ve been trying to track them down, but I haven’t been able to find them yet."
"What about Nalan Shizhe?"
"Nalan Shizhe is in her domain, and she doesn’t do any activities other than cultivating."
"Hmm?" Jiu Mozu raised his eyebrows as he felt something was strange. "What about Qi Qingxiu?"
Jiu Youming shook her head before informing him. "Demon god, I don’t dare to check the situation of the Seven-Emotions Demon God, and she will kill me if I do that."
"I see." Jiu Mozu then ordered her to do something else. "For now, I want you to continue monitoring Nalan Shizhe and inform me if she makes any moves."
Jiu Youming suddenly noticed something. "Demon God, Mo Shentian left his domain with his third son, Mo Tianqi. He plans to meet Dong Xuanyin to ask for her help in finding Wu Mian’s real body."

"He’s finally making his move, huh?" Jiu Mozu muttered to himself. "Use your eye abilities to continuously monitor Mo Shentian’s movements, and you must inform me immediately if he arrives at Dong Xuanyin’s location."
"Yes, Demon God."

Jiu Mozu let out a soft sigh before listening to Jia Zizhen’s voice message. "Hmm? That foolish fairy king! How could he be so reckless? If Long Wuzhao truly knows his connection with me, he will definitely be wary of our movements, and that will make it difficult for me to proceed with my plans. Jiu Yan, I want you to meet the fairy king and help him to find the traitor in his fairy race, and you have to find the traitor as soon as possible, or my plans will be messed up again."
"Yes, Demon God."
