chapters.title: Chapter 1241: The Sun-Moon Domain
paragraphs: [Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Sun-Moon Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
A notification appeared as soon as Zhang Fei [5] entered the domain, but he didn’t come alone, and he brought several people with him, including Zhang Chen.

The Sun-Moon Domain is a vast cultivation land where the blazing radiance of the sun and the quiet glow of the moon intertwine. This is a realm of extremes, embodying the eternal cycle of yin and yang, where the two forces compete yet complement each other without ever fully merging.

The Golden Sun and the Silver Moon float in the vast sky. One side of the domain illuminates under eternal daylight, while the other dwells under perpetual night. Vast golden deserts and blazing volcanoes thrive under the radiance of the sun. Silver lakes, silvery forests, and frost-tipped mountains flourish in the moon’s embrace.

Unlike the Twin Flames Domain, which is filled with hundreds of dual cultivation sects, there are only dozens of sects of different grades in the Sun-Moon Domain, with six of them being supreme sects.

"Traveling in this realm is much easier than in the Three Mortal Realms, Fei’er. We only need to go to the border to pass through the gate, and we’ll immediately arrive at another domain." Zhang Chen spoke while looking at the surrounding area. "Isn’t this domain almost similar to the twin Amaris’s sub-realm in the Diyu Realm?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "Although the two look similar, they are also different at the same time. Their sub-realm is divided into light and darkness elements, and this domain is divided into eternal day and eternal night."
"They will be happy if you bring them here, husband." Luo Yunxiao spoke.
"Haha." Zhang Lin laughed softly. "They must be happy, but they will bring trouble for us."
"We still don’t have precise information on the strength of the cultivators in this domain, so we shouldn’t bring them here yet." Hu Yue spoke.
Zhong Yan then asked him. "Where are we going now, husband?"
"The Zenith Sect is in the day area." Luo Yunxiao then pointed to the night area. "The Spring Breeze Pavilion is located over there."
Zhang Fei [5] didn’t decide right away and asked the two men behind them. "When will Ma Youling come to this domain, Old Ma?"
"When do you promise to meet her, Ma Yuchen?" Ma Kuangyu asked his subordinate.
"Ma Youling should be here soon, Lord Ma."
Ma Kuangyu then spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "Kid, let Yunxiao take them to the Spring Breeze Pavilion first, and we’ll catch up with them after we deal with Ma Youling."
"Let’s go, Sisters and Grandma Chen!" Luo Yunxiao led Zhang Chen and the others towards the night area.

After they left, Zhang Fei [5] led the two men to the day area, but they didn’t go directly to The Zenith Sect. Instead, they landed not far from a small town on the outskirts of the domain, waiting for Ma Youling to arrive.

"Old Ma, we might face serious problems soon." Ma Kuangyu turned to Zhang Fei [5] with a questioning look. "Jia Zizhen already knows about my existence in this realm, and he is also targeting Jia Yuyan to become his wife. Currently, he has ordered his subordinates to look for us, but he still doesn’t know about my whereabouts in our sect."

"Jia Zizhen may not know the relationship between you and our sect now, but eventually he will definitely find out. You have exposed yourself to the public, and many cultivators already know about you, so we are just waiting for him to find out everything. Ma Kuangyu then asked him. "Is the Sect Guardian Formation Array that Duanmu Luolan is working on capable of facing a cultivator of his level?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly. "The grade of the Sect Guardian Formation Array is indeed high, but I’m not sure whether it can stop Jia Zizhen or not. If the barrier can’t stop him, Tian Kui and Serpentera will act to stop them. However, I’m worried that the four perils will hear about their presence in our sect, and they will attack us, as they have long been targeting the two of them."

"That’s true." Ma Kuangyu nodded in agreement. "If you ask Xie Heilong and the others to stop Jia Zizhen, the four perils will hear about them, and that would be too risky for us. If they learn their generals are your slaves, they’ll be furious, and we will have direct conflict with them. However, I believe Long Wuzhao will not remain silent if the four of them attack us, and he will lead the others to stop them."

Zhang Fei [5] himself believed that Long Wuzhao would make a move to stop Taotie and the others if that happened, but he didn’t want to rely on him, and he had to think of something to deal with them.

"Lord Ma! Ma Youling has already passed the gate, and she will be here soon." Hearing that, Zhang Fei [5] grabbed Ma Kuanyu’s shoulder and brought him into an invisible state, leaving Ma Yuchen alone.

After they waited for some time, Ma Youling finally arrived at their location, and she came in disguise and covered her demon aura. However, her disguise couldn’t fool the system, and Zhang Fei [5] discovered that she was a corpse demon like Wan Ying.
Ma Kuangyu was in complete shock after Zhang Fei [5] told him about Ma Youling’s demon identity, which meant she had died before and a corpse demon turned her into one.

After telling Ma Yuchen to be on standby, Zhang Fei [5] summoned the demon extermination sword and transformed into his half-fox form. He channeled his light element and elemental law into his sword, preparing to move if Ma Youling noticed their presence and attacked them.
"Where have you been, Youling? You never gave us any news, and we thought you had died during the fall of our main clan." Ma Yuchen asked with a calm expression to prevent Ma Youling’s suspicion.

Ma Youling didn’t answer Ma Yuchen directly and monitored the surrounding area first, but she couldn’t detect the presence of Zhang Fei [5] and Ma Kuangyu near them. After that, she directly spoke to him. "I almost died during the fall of our main clan, and I suffered a heavy injury due to their attacks, which caused my cultivation to decline significantly. Therefore, I hid for a long time to recover my cultivation, and I immediately looked for you in our branch clan, but I couldn’t find you guys there, so I contacted one of you."

’What a liar! The residence you came to a few weeks ago was our new branch clan that we established after the destruction of our main Ma Clan, and you wouldn’t have possibly known about us if you had been hidden for so long.’ Ma Yuchen inwardly spoke before asking her again. "So, what do you want from us? Are you going to live with us again now?"

"I want to come back to you guys, but I can’t do it." Ma Youling suddenly took out an item and threw it towards Ma Yuchen, but Zhang Fei [5] moved faster than her and cut the item in half, which shocked her. "Who!? Come out now!"

Zhang Fei [5] was naturally not so crazy as to come out to face Ma Youling directly; instead, he grabbed Ma Yuchen and flew into the sky in an invisible state before activating his sword domain and enveloping their area with it.

"Shit!" Ma Youling cursed as thousands of swords made of light Qi descended from the sky, but she quickly dodged Zhang Fei [5]’s attacks while wondering about the identity of her attacker. ’Could it be that this person is a member of the winged race? How could that guy have a relationship with that race?’
Ma Youling ultimately managed to dodge all of Zhang Fei [5]’s attacks, but he didn’t stop there and used his exorcismus ability to attack her again.
’Another light element attacks!’ Ma Youling immediately flew out of the range of Zhang Fei [5]’s ability before launching a counterattack at him.
Zhang Fei [5] teleported the two men to avoid Ma Youling’s attack, and he also summoned the War Devil Beast, Chi You.
Chi You quickly flew toward Ma Youling, who shocked her. She had already heard about the appearance of the evil mythical beasts in the dungeon, but one suddenly appeared before her.
While Ma Youling was in shock, Chi Yao had arrived in front of her and attacked her directly.

"Gah!" Chi Yao’s single punch knocked Ma Youling far back, prompting her to hurriedly stabilize her body. However, the beast charged toward her again, and his speed was much faster than a corpse demon like her.
"Gah!" Ma Youling was sent flying backward once again, but Chi You flew after her and grabbed her leg, slamming her to the ground. "Gah!"
Even though she was a corpse demon, Chi You’s attack still had a significant impact on Ma Youling, even though the impact was not as severe as if he had attacked a living creature.

Ma Youling wiped the blood from her mouth and flew away to escape from Chi You, but Zhang Fei [5] swung his sword from the sky, and a huge light sword Qi slashed down right in front of her, forcing her to stop at her spot.
*Boom*

A notification appeared as soon as Zhang Fei [5] entered the domain, but he didn’t come alone, and he brought several people with him, including Zhang Chen.
The Sun-Moon Domain is a vast cultivation land where the blazing radiance of the sun and the quiet glow of the moon intertwine.
This is a realm of extremes, embodying the eternal cycle of yin and yang, where the two forces compete yet complement each other without ever fully merging.
The Golden Sun and the Silver Moon float in the vast sky.
One side of the domain illuminates under eternal daylight, while the other dwells under perpetual night.
Vast golden deserts and blazing volcanoes thrive under the radiance of the sun.
Silver lakes, silvery forests, and frost-tipped mountains flourish in the moon’s embrace.

Unlike the Twin Flames Domain, which is filled with hundreds of dual cultivation sects, there are only dozens of sects of different grades in the Sun-Moon Domain, with six of them being supreme sects.
"Traveling in this realm is much easier than in the Three Mortal Realms, Fei’er.
We only need to go to the border to pass through the gate, and we’ll immediately arrive at another domain." Zhang Chen spoke while looking at the surrounding area.
"Isn’t this domain almost similar to the twin Amaris’s sub-realm in the Diyu Realm?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
"Although the two look similar, they are also different at the same time.
Their sub-realm is divided into light and darkness elements, and this domain is divided into eternal day and eternal night."
"They will be happy if you bring them here, husband." Luo Yunxiao spoke.
"Haha." Zhang Lin laughed softly.
"They must be happy, but they will bring trouble for us."
"We still don’t have precise information on the strength of the cultivators in this domain, so we shouldn’t bring them here yet." Hu Yue spoke.
Zhong Yan then asked him.
"Where are we going now, husband?"
"The Zenith Sect is in the day area." Luo Yunxiao then pointed to the night area.
"The Spring Breeze Pavilion is located over there."
Zhang Fei [5] didn’t decide right away and asked the two men behind them.
"When will Ma Youling come to this domain, Old Ma?"
"When do you promise to meet her, Ma Yuchen?" Ma Kuangyu asked his subordinate.
"Ma Youling should be here soon, Lord Ma."
Ma Kuangyu then spoke to Zhang Fei [5].
"Kid, let Yunxiao take them to the Spring Breeze Pavilion first, and we’ll catch up with them after we deal with Ma Youling."
"Let’s go, Sisters and Grandma Chen!" Luo Yunxiao led Zhang Chen and the others towards the night area.
After they left, Zhang Fei [5] led the two men to the day area, but they didn’t go directly to The Zenith Sect.
Instead, they landed not far from a small town on the outskirts of the domain, waiting for Ma Youling to arrive.
"Old Ma, we might face serious problems soon." Ma Kuangyu turned to Zhang Fei [5] with a questioning look.
"Jia Zizhen already knows about my existence in this realm, and he is also targeting Jia Yuyan to become his wife.
Currently, he has ordered his subordinates to look for us, but he still doesn’t know about my whereabouts in our sect."
"Jia Zizhen may not know the relationship between you and our sect now, but eventually he will definitely find out.
You have exposed yourself to the public, and many cultivators already know about you, so we are just waiting for him to find out everything.
Ma Kuangyu then asked him.
"Is the Sect Guardian Formation Array that Duanmu Luolan is working on capable of facing a cultivator of his level?"
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly.
"The grade of the Sect Guardian Formation Array is indeed high, but I’m not sure whether it can stop Jia Zizhen or not.
If the barrier can’t stop him, Tian Kui and Serpentera will act to stop them.
However, I’m worried that the four perils will hear about their presence in our sect, and they will attack us, as they have long been targeting the two of them."
"That’s true." Ma Kuangyu nodded in agreement.
"If you ask Xie Heilong and the others to stop Jia Zizhen, the four perils will hear about them, and that would be too risky for us.
If they learn their generals are your slaves, they’ll be furious, and we will have direct conflict with them.
However, I believe Long Wuzhao will not remain silent if the four of them attack us, and he will lead the others to stop them."

Zhang Fei [5] himself believed that Long Wuzhao would make a move to stop Taotie and the others if that happened, but he didn’t want to rely on him, and he had to think of something to deal with them.
"Lord Ma!
Ma Youling has already passed the gate, and she will be here soon." Hearing that, Zhang Fei [5] grabbed Ma Kuanyu’s shoulder and brought him into an invisible state, leaving Ma Yuchen alone.
After they waited for some time, Ma Youling finally arrived at their location, and she came in disguise and covered her demon aura.
However, her disguise couldn’t fool the system, and Zhang Fei [5] discovered that she was a corpse demon like Wan Ying.
Ma Kuangyu was in complete shock after Zhang Fei [5] told him about Ma Youling’s demon identity, which meant she had died before and a corpse demon turned her into one.
After telling Ma Yuchen to be on standby, Zhang Fei [5] summoned the demon extermination sword and transformed into his half-fox form.
He channeled his light element and elemental law into his sword, preparing to move if Ma Youling noticed their presence and attacked them.
"Where have you been, Youling?
You never gave us any news, and we thought you had died during the fall of our main clan." Ma Yuchen asked with a calm expression to prevent Ma Youling’s suspicion.
Ma Youling didn’t answer Ma Yuchen directly and monitored the surrounding area first, but she couldn’t detect the presence of Zhang Fei [5] and Ma Kuangyu near them.
After that, she directly spoke to him.
"I almost died during the fall of our main clan, and I suffered a heavy injury due to their attacks, which caused my cultivation to decline significantly.
Therefore, I hid for a long time to recover my cultivation, and I immediately looked for you in our branch clan, but I couldn’t find you guys there, so I contacted one of you."
’What a liar!

The residence you came to a few weeks ago was our new branch clan that we established after the destruction of our main Ma Clan, and you wouldn’t have possibly known about us if you had been hidden for so long.’ Ma Yuchen inwardly spoke before asking her again.
"So, what do you want from us?
Are you going to live with us again now?"

"I want to come back to you guys, but I can’t do it." Ma Youling suddenly took out an item and threw it towards Ma Yuchen, but Zhang Fei [5] moved faster than her and cut the item in half, which shocked her.
"Who!?
Come out now!"

Zhang Fei [5] was naturally not so crazy as to come out to face Ma Youling directly; instead, he grabbed Ma Yuchen and flew into the sky in an invisible state before activating his sword domain and enveloping their area with it.

"Shit!" Ma Youling cursed as thousands of swords made of light Qi descended from the sky, but she quickly dodged Zhang Fei [5]’s attacks while wondering about the identity of her attacker. ’Could it be that this person is a member of the winged race?
How could that guy have a relationship with that race?’
Ma Youling ultimately managed to dodge all of Zhang Fei [5]’s attacks, but he didn’t stop there and used his exorcismus ability to attack her again.
’Another light element attacks!’ Ma Youling immediately flew out of the range of Zhang Fei [5]’s ability before launching a counterattack at him.
Zhang Fei [5] teleported the two men to avoid Ma Youling’s attack, and he also summoned the War Devil Beast, Chi You.
Chi You quickly flew toward Ma Youling, who shocked her.
She had already heard about the appearance of the evil mythical beasts in the dungeon, but one suddenly appeared before her.
While Ma Youling was in shock, Chi Yao had arrived in front of her and attacked her directly.
"Gah!" Chi Yao’s single punch knocked Ma Youling far back, prompting her to hurriedly stabilize her body.
However, the beast charged toward her again, and his speed was much faster than a corpse demon like her.
"Gah!" Ma Youling was sent flying backward once again, but Chi You flew after her and grabbed her leg, slamming her to the ground.
"Gah!"
Even though she was a corpse demon, Chi You’s attack still had a significant impact on Ma Youling, even though the impact was not as severe as if he had attacked a living creature.

Ma Youling wiped the blood from her mouth and flew away to escape from Chi You, but Zhang Fei [5] swung his sword from the sky, and a huge light sword Qi slashed down right in front of her, forcing her to stop at her spot.
*Boom*

chapters.title: Chapter 1242: Visit Two Sects
paragraphs: Ma Youling didn’t have a chance to feel relieved because Chi You was already close to her, and the evil beast once again landed a powerful blow on her abdomen, causing her to bend forward and spurt out blood.

"Cough... Cough..." After Chi Yao defeated Ma Yaoling, Zhang Fei [5] immediately appeared behind her, thrust the demon extermination sword to her back until it penetrated her chest, and nailed her to the ground. "Gah!"
Ma Youling then looked at Ma Kuangyu, who was standing by her side. "Lord Ma... you are still alive."

"I came back to life some time ago, Youling." Ma Kuangyu squatted beside Ma Youling and sealed her cultivation. "Back then, you were one of the best talents in our clan, but you have become like this now."

While enduring the pain, Ma Youling explained her situation. "Shortly after your death, Sheng Yaohun declared our clan to be a heretical clan, and his subordinates led members of the other clans to attack us while we were searching for something. They tortured us to death, and my current master revived me as a corpse demon. My master trained me hard, and I became one of the nine special subordinates of the Nine Nether Demon God."
Ma Kuangyu’s expression was full of anger. "Who is your current master?"

"Jiu Moze." Ma Kuangyu tried searching for the name in his memories, but he had never heard of him, prompting Ma Youling to explain. "He is the right hand of the previous Nine Nether Demon God, and he is also the master of Jiu Mozu."
"Have you heard of Jiu Moze, Old Ma?"

"Just like the current Nine Nether Demon God, the previous one also had nine special subordinates, and he could borrow their power to increase his strength. However, they never appeared in public directly, so no one knew them except the other demon gods." Ma Kuangyu then asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Can you do something to release Youling from his control?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "Just like Wang Yin, she no longer has her soul, and she has become a living corpse now. The only thing I can do for her is to lock her subconscious mind in the dream, so Jiu Moze won’t be able to use her to attack us again, and Jiu Mozu will lose one of his nine special subordinates."
Ma Youling stole a glance at Zhang Fei [5], wondering why Ma Kuangyu seemed to trust him so much.

"This kid freed my soul from the Star Tower, and he also helped me to reshape my body." Ma Youling nodded in understanding to Ma Kuangyu, who then asked her. "Why are you suddenly looking for our clan members? Did Jiu Mozu assign you to do something?"

Ma Youling informed him directly. "Jiu Mozu already knew that Jiu Ming and the others died in the Blazing Union Sect, so he ordered me to use our clan members to infiltrate the sect and the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"As expected, kid."
"Ugh." Ma Youling groaned once Zhang Fei [5] pulled his sword out.

"Tianshi Bailong and the others killed them in that sect, so it is natural that Jiu Mozu would want to investigate their deaths there. Perhaps, he had also heard about me, so he wanted to send people to our sect to investigate." Zhang Fei [5] then used his dream lordship ability on Mo Yaoling. "Even though she is a living corpse without a soul, she still has her subconscious. I will confine her to the dream now, and I will send her body into my space."
After Ma Kuangyu agreed, Zhang Fei [5] sent Ma Youling’s subconscious into a dream, and he imprisoned her body in one of the rooms in the Yin-Yang Space to milk her Yin Qi.
Zhang Fei [5] then opened a gate. "I’m going to the Spring Breeze Pavilion now, so you two can return to our sect."
After they left, Zhang Fei [5] sent Chi You into his beast space again. He deliberately sent several evil mythical beasts there because he planned to go to the Slaughter Blood Domain soon.
Zhang Fei [5] had arrived at the Spring Breeze Pavilion, where he found Zhang Chen and the others enjoying the night view of the place, accompanied by Lu Shaqing.
"Sect Master Lu."

Lu Shaqing turned to Zhang Fei [5] directly. "Luo Yunxiao has already told me about your plan regarding your desire to establish a relationship between our two sects, and I agreed to it. However, we can’t possibly travel back and forth between the two domains every day, so we have to think of something to cover it."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed as he handed two teleportation devices to Lu Shaqing. "One will connect this sect with the Blazing Union Sect, where your male elders and selected male disciples can cultivate in the Celestial Yang Lake. The other will connect this sect with our sect, where your female elders and selected female disciples can cultivate in the Celestial Yin Lake. However, you must install both in the safest place in the sect, or else others will infiltrate our sect."

"I understand." Lu Shaqing accepted them with pleasure. "I will help you improve your sect’s image, but it won’t be possible instantly because the Moonlit Passion Temple has been around for a very long time, and its image as a dual cultivation sect is difficult to change in a short time."

"I understand that, but I hope my sect’s image will change one day, and I will make it one of the strongest sects." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Luo Yunxiao and the others. "Since they are still enjoying themselves, I will leave them here for a while and go to the Zenith Sect to meet Gong Wei."
Lu Shaqing also looked at all the women. "Don’t worry, they will be safe here."
"I’ll go now."

Within moments, Zhang Fei [5] was already standing in front of the Zenith Sect. Unlike the Spring Breeze Pavilion, which was more dominated by women, this sect was more dominated by men. He decided to contact Gong Wei, asking him to pick him up at the entrance.

Soon, Gong Wei arrived in front of him, and he led Zhang Fei [5] on a tour of the Zenith Sect grounds while listening to him. "If your male disciples train at the Blazing Union Sect, they can become stronger more quickly, not only in cultivation but also in their physiques."
"Yes." Gong Wei nodded in understanding. "Alright, I accept your offer, but—"

"Here." Zhang Fei [5] gave Gong Wei a teleportation device, which surprised him. "You only need to install it in the safest place in the sect, and I will install half of it in the Blazing Union Sect. This way, your male disciples can go back and forth between the two sects easily, and people from other sects will not notice their changes."

Gong Wei asked him directly. "Where did you get this device? Creating a device to connect two different domains is definitely not simple, and not every artifact crafter in the Sky Pillar Domain can create one."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed in response. "You met Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji when you visited my sect, right? Although they came from the Three Mortal Realms like me, their skills in artifact forging are not inferior to those in the Sky Pillar Domain, and they created this device for me. However, this device is not completely perfect, and it can only connect places that are in the same realm."
"Are you thinking about asking them to create a device that can connect this Paradise Realm and the Three Mortal Realms?" Gong Wei asked in disbelief.

"That’s right." Zhang Fei [5] confirmed it with a nod. "However, I want them to make it one-way, preventing people from this realm from descending to the Three Mortal Realms. This way, people from that realm can ascend here more easily, and they will have the opportunity to become better cultivators."
Gong Wei nodded his head several times. "Why do you want people from the Three Mortal Realms to ascend here? Do you have a good relationship with the people from that realm?"

"There are quite a lot of people there, okay? Of course, I don’t know all of them, but I have good relationships with some of them. However, I have no intention of bringing them here directly, and I will give them the opportunity to do so through this device." Zhang Fei [5] paused for a moment in thought. "I don’t know how to put it, but I have a feeling that something big will happen in the future. This realm constantly faces a decline in new talents, so I believe that making it easier for people from the Ten Mortal Realms to reach this realm will benefit everyone, including my sect."

"You’re right about the decline in talent in this realm." Gong Wei let out a heavy sigh. "Back then, my sect had a much larger number of disciples, but they all graduated long ago and became independent cultivators. Unfortunately, few new talents emerged, and the sheer number of sects in this realm left each sect short of disciples. Therefore, those people decided to send some towers to the Three Mortal Realms, but the results were disappointing, as few people managed to reach the top of their towers."
Zhang Fei [5] remembered something. "Did your sect accept people from the Three Mortal Realms about five or six years ago?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1243: Talk With Gong Wei
paragraphs: "My sect hasn’t accepted disciples from the Three Mortal Realms for thousands of years," Gong Wei then questioned him. "From which tower did they ascend to this realm?"
"The Moon Tower."

Gong Wei was momentarily taken aback. "If they truly ascended to this realm via the Moon Tower, I believe you should visit the Celestial Moon Domain. However, I can’t confirm whether the people you are looking for are there, as those higher-ups will scramble over if there are new ascenders."
"The Celestial Moon Domain, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] muttered to himself.

"That’s right." Gong Wei nodded at him. "As the name suggests, there is no sun there, and only a moon year-round, making it most suitable for female cultivators because the Yin Qi there is highest among all the domains in this realm. There are several female sects there, but the strongest among them is the Frozen Moon Sect. If you are considering visiting that domain, you should abandon the idea because entry is prohibited for men. Instead, send some of your wives to go there to check whether your female acquaintances are there or not, but your male acquaintances are definitely not there."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "I think I can send Luo Yunxiao and some others to that domain. Although I don’t know those people personally, they are the relatives of some of my close friends, so I thought of looking for them and bringing them to my sect."

"Luo Yunxiao is Luo Fenghan’s daughter, right?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Gong Wei. "With her status as the princess of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, I’m sure the people from the Frozen Moon Sect will not refuse to meet her, so she is your best choice to check whether your acquaintances are in that domain or not. By the way, you should rethink your plan to contact the Paradise Realm and the Three Immortal Realms because the higher-ups who control those towers will not like it, and they might fight you if you do that."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] furrowed his brows. "Why don’t they like it? They need new talents for the future of this realm, right?"
Gong Wei let out a soft sigh. "You’ve been a cultivator for a long time now, so you should understand the reason, right?"
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Greed and authority."

"That’s right." Gong Wei gave him a light nod. "Those people and their clans are the oldest cultivators in this realm, and they have held authority over those towers for a very long time. One of the reasons other sects and clans have difficulty finding new talents is because those people always prioritize their clans, and the number of cultivators ascending from the Three Mortal Realms is simply too few. As they grow older and stronger, rather than achieving peace, they develop fear that others will ruin their dominance. If you carry out your plan to connect the two realms, and the others get many new talents, I’m sure those people won’t just sit idly by."

Zhang Fei [5] could only sigh after hearing that. "Those people are simply foolish! They have lived for so long, but they still care about worldly affairs. As long as they are like that, they will never be able to achieve peace, let alone reach higher levels."
"Higher levels? Do they really exist?" Gong Wei asked with surprise.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly. "To be honest, I still don’t have clear information about the higher levels, but I have found some clues about them."
"Can you tell me about some of those clues?" Gong Wei was really curious about that.

"You’ve met the mysterious merchant in the Forbidden Land, right?" Gong Wei nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. "Puyang Shangren is a member of the ancient Puyang Clan, and there are many other ancient clans in this universe. However, they do not live in this Paradise Realm; instead, they live in their own realm called the Ancient Realm. The Silver Moon Clan, the owner of the Endless Night Dungeon, was once part of the ancient clans. In fact, both that clan and the Golden Sun Clan were among the first ancient clans, but they were both destroyed due to a great disaster in the past. Additionally, there are still some clues that people from all races, except for the beast races and the evil beast races, are unaware of."
"Such as?"

"The existence of the two primordial beasts: the Primordial Nihility Beast and the Primordial Genesis Beast." Gong Wei fell dumbstruck as his eyes widened in shock after Zhang Fei [5] mentioned the two beasts. "Taotie and the other three were subordinates of the former, and he ordered them to do several things without the majority of the inhabitants of this realm realizing it. Currently, people are unaware of their existence because they do not live in this realm, and they live in a realm higher than the ancient realm; thus, I believe that higher levels after the Five Celestial Realms do exist."
Gong Wei took a deep breath after hearing all that. "Do those two primordial beasts really exist? Does the Dragon Emperor know about their existence?"

"I don’t need to lie to you, right?" Zhang Fei [5] responded with a shake of his head. chapters.title: Chapter 1244: Huang Xiaoyi’s Story
paragraphs: "Are you surprised?" Gong Wei nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. "I’ve known Helian Xun’er since I was still in the Three Mortal Realms, and she’s helped me a lot with my affairs there. During my sect’s opening ceremony, she came to me, and she’s lived with me ever since."
Zhang Fei [5]’s confession made Gong Wei smile strangely. "Why don’t you try approaching Beiming Youhuang? She’s prettier and stronger than Helian Xun’er, right?"

"I dislike her attitude." Zhang Fei [5] told Gong Wei some things regarding his first arrival in the Paradise Realm. "Usually, I would do something to someone like her, but I have no interest in her despite her beauty and strength. By the way, I’ll be leaving now, and I want your sect members to cultivate more diligently. Once I activate the device, they can go to the Blazing Union Sect to cultivate."
Gong Wei nodded at him. "After this, I will summon them, and I will inform them about everything."

Since Zhang Chen and the others were still enjoying their time at the Spring Breeze Pavilion, and the sect was dominated by women, Zhang Fei [5] decided to leave them there. He left Chi Yao in the domain specifically to protect them, so he doesn’t need to worry about their safety.

Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary to meet his parents-in-law, and he asked Huang Xiaoyi for help in inviting Beiming Youhuang because he wanted to go to the Falling Star Domain.

Instead of contacting Beiming Youhuang, Huang Xiaoyi decided to accompany Zhang Fei [5] to the Falling Star Domain. However, they didn’t go straight to that domain, and she took him to the Huang Clan first because her family wanted to meet him.
They didn’t spend much time at the Huang Clan, and Huang Xiaoyi took Zhang Fei [5] away after she introduced him to the others, especially her parents, who were also his grandparents-in-law.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Falling Star Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
After they arrived at the domain, Huang Xiaoyi asked Zhang Fei [5] to take her to the Xing Clan because the clan’s location was too far from the gate.

With his speed and movement techniques, it was not difficult for Zhang Fei [5] to bring Huang Xiaoyi to the clan residence. She then led him to the clan because they had to ask the patriarch of the clan for permission to go to the entrance to the Star Tower, which was located far behind their clan.

"What brings you to my clan today, Huang Xiaoyi?" An old man suddenly appeared in front of them before glancing at Zhang Fei [5]. "So, this is the famous young man who caused a commotion in the Moon Illusion Domain with his breakthrough years ago, right?"

Although the old man asked in a calm voice, Zhang Fei [5] could sense that he was trying to suppress him with dominance. He silently activated the soul connect and borrowed the power of several evil beasts in his beast space, reversing the old man’s dominance.
The old man was shocked when Zhang Fei [5] activated the soul connect, especially because it increased his strength significantly.

"Senior, we didn’t come to look for trouble, and we just wanted to go to the Star Tower to see Wan Jiang." Zhang Fei [5] then took out the plaque that Li Tianyu gave him on the day of his sect’s opening ceremony.
The old man was a little surprised to see that. "I’ve heard about you and the Moonlit Passion Sect, but I didn’t expect you to also be part of the Emerald Bamboo Sect, kid."

"Honestly, our relationship hasn’t been established for long, but Senior Tianyu and Senior Yueru gave this plaque to me as a sign of our new relationship." Zhang Fei [5] placed the plaque back into his system storage. "I hope you will be willing to allow us to go to the Star Tower to meet him."
The old man nodded slightly. "Wan Jiang is part of the Emerald Bamboo Sect, so I will take you there, and you can meet him inside the tower."

"Thank you." Despite this, Zhang Fei [5] increased his vigilance toward the old man, especially after he checked his soul and found some rotten things in it. ’I don’t want to have any problems with you, but you seem to have other thoughts toward me. You should forget your bad intentions, or I will destroy your Xing Clan right here and right now.’
The old man first contacted some of his clan members, and he then accompanied Zhang Fei [5] and Huang Xiaoyi to the location of the entrance to the Star Tower.

On the way there, Huang Xiaoyi warned Zhang Fei [5] to be careful of the old man, who was none other than one of the ancestors of the Xing Clan, Xing Haoran. ’He looks kind on the outside, but he is no less cunning than Jia Zizhen, and he will not hesitate to use dirty means to achieve his desires. If you reveal too much of your advantages in front of him, he will inevitably become jealous of you, and he will target you. If that happens, you will get more enemies, and all of them will trouble you.’

’I understand, mother-in-law.’ Zhang Fei [5] could have gone to the Nine Stars Realm and entered the Star Tower through that realm, but he thought it would only be detrimental to him if he returned to the Three Mortal Realms. Furthermore, he had a guess about something related to his quests in the tower, so he decided to go there through the Paradise Realm to prove his guess. ’Does this old man know Yunxiao’s identity?’

Huang Xiaoyi shook her head slightly. ’Your father and I used a disguise on her, so this old man still doesn’t know that she is our daughter. I’m sure he’ll find out someday, but it doesn’t matter as long as he doesn’t know her special physique.’

’That’s true.’ Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement. ’Mother-in-law, who exactly attacked you in the past? You two were forced to flee to the Three Mortal Realms in the past, so I thought they were stronger than the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.’

Huang Xiaoyi sighed softly. "The ones who attacked us back then were heretics from the Stygian Dusk Domain, and they were the mortal enemies of our ancestors. One of them was the Dusk Pavilion, and that sect was the polar opposite of our Immortal Lotus Sanctuary. In fact, the Dark Tower is located in that domain, but they can’t get close to it because Tianshi Bailong used a special barrier to prevent them from entering.’
’So, the people from that domain are darkness cultivators, right? Was there any trouble between the two sects in the past?’

Huang Xiaoyi nodded at him. ’Although they aren’t demons, they are all darkness cultivators, and many cultivators in this realm hate them. In the past, our ancestors killed some of their ancestors, and we’ve been mortal enemies ever since. That day, your father and I were on our way back from another domain, but Linghu Minghua suddenly appeared and surrounded us with several people from other dark sects. They closed our access to return to our domain, and they ganged up on us. Luckily, our location was close to one of the tunnels leading to the Three Mortal Realms, so we escaped there.’
’Were they not chasing you two back then?’

’At first, we thought they would chase us, but we didn’t see any of them.’ Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow slightly in response to Huang Xiaoyi’s answer. ’When we arrived there, we discovered that I was pregnant. Therefore, we chose to hide there, and we searched for the furthest planet until we arrived at Earth. As for the rest of the story, you surely still remember it.’
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. ’Did they not notice your return to this realm?’

’At first, they didn’t realize our return.’ Huang Xiaoyi released a soft sigh before continuing. ’When we decided to return to this realm, we searched for the safest route, and we arrived at the Peach Garden Domain. We met an old friend there, and he helped us return to our sect. Since then, we entered into seclusion to increase our strength, and our ancestors used many things to help us reach our current level. In the end, they realized that we were back, and they tried to attack us several times, but we managed to repel them and kill some of them.’
’I see.’ Zhang Fei [5] wanted to ask again, but Xing Haoran suddenly landed in an area, which was the location of the entrance to the Star Tower.
They followed the old man to land there, and Xing Haoran then spoke to them. "You two can go in by yourselves, and I won’t accompany you."
"Thank you, Senior." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Huang Xiaoyi, who nodded before the two entered the portal.
Shortly, two people appeared behind Xing Haoran, and one of them informed him. "Ancestor, I’ve contacted Linghu Minghua, and he will be here soon."

"That’s good." Xing Haoran nodded in satisfaction. "A few years ago, Huang Xiaoyi came here with Luo Fenghan and several of their ancestors, so I didn’t contact Linghu Minghua. However, she’s alone with that brat now, so we must capture her today, and we’ll force her husband to surrender."

’Hahaha!’ Zhang Fei [5] laughed after the series of notifications appeared. ’Your guess is right, Mei! This way, I don’t have to waste time challenging the remaining six floors.’
[Humph! I’m never wrong!]
’Haha!’ Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to Huang Xiaoyi. "Mother-in-law, I’ll send you to your domain directly later."
Huang Xiaoyi turned to him in confusion. "Why do you want to do that?"

"Mother-in-law, neither Xing Haoran nor his Xing Clan are good people. In fact, they have ties with Linghu Minghua and the people from the Stygian Dusk Domain." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer confused Huang Xiaoyi further, but he then showed his demon eyes. "My demon eyes have many functions, and I can see the dark side in a person’s soul. After I evolved into a transcendent lust demon, the effects of my eyes increased even more, and I knew that they had such a relationship. I’m sure that old man has already contacted them, and they will surround us once we return to the domain."
Since Zhang Fei [5] was her son-in-law, Huang Xiaoyi chose not to doubt his words. "So, you always use your abilities to choose the people who stay by your side?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "My demon eyes ability is always useful for recognizing other people’s characters, and I will get rid of those with rotten souls. Actually, there’s still a woman by my side who’s thinking of taking revenge on me, but she can’t do anything because her soul has already merged with mine, and she’s also become my mother’s contracted beast."
"Who is that woman?"

"Zhu Shanniang, the vermilion bird." Seeing the curiosity in Huang Xiaoyi’s eyes, Zhang Fei [5] explained to her about the situation between them in the past, making her shake her head helplessly. "I have repeatedly told her that I am not part of the Heavenly Fox, but she insisted on attacking me because of her hatred for them. Therefore, I did all that to her, but she still harbored hatred for me."
Huang Xiaoyi sighed again. "Are you still going to continue to increase the number of women by your side?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed awkwardly without denying or confirming her question.
Huang Xiaoyi narrowed her eyes at Zhang Fei [5], but she then shook her head and walked away. "Let’s meet Wan Jiang now."

’Tch! Why did this pervert come here?’ Hua Mei’er grumbled inwardly before walking away and sitting in a corner, as she had always been afraid of Zhang Fei [5] after he used his demon touch on her several years ago, and he raised her vigilance toward him.
Sima Yun could only shake his head at his sect sister’s behavior, but he was also curious about the reason behind their arrival, especially Zhang Fei [5]’s purpose.
"What brought you here, kid?" Wan Jiang directly asked Zhang Fei [5].

"Old man, do you know any special route to infiltrate the Floral Mirage Domain?" Zhang Fei [5]’s question not only shocked Wan Jiang but also his two disciples. "I know that one of the souls of the ten-tailed fox is in that realm, but Jia Zizhen is already aware of my presence in the Paradise Realm, and he is eager to kill me. By the way, I got information about him from Long Wuzhao, and you will definitely be shocked if you know about it."
’Tch! Only this pervert dares to directly call the Golden Dragon Emperor by his name! Hua Mei’er inwardly grumbled in the distance.
Wan Jiang furrowed his brows. "What kind of information did you get about Jia Zizhen?"

"Jia Zizhen is not only in cahoots with the Nine Nether Demon God, but he’s also in cahoots with the Calamity Demon God." Zhang Fei [5]’s revelation shocked the three of them again. "Previously, he threatened my two grandparents-in-law to hand over my wife to him, but he didn’t realize that I had already enslaved one of his subordinates. Therefore, I contacted Long Wuzhao to save them, and he overheard him saying he would contact Mo Shentian and the Jiu Mozu."

Wan Jiang frowned at that. "I didn’t expect that Jia Zizhen would attack Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun, as both of them are his seniors. Since he had such a relationship with Mo Shentian and the Jiu Mozu, then the rumors about him killing the previous fairy king were true."

"Long Wuzhao also thinks so." Zhang Fei [5] said this as he nodded. "Therefore, I came here to see you, and I hope you’re willing to help me infiltrate the Floral Mirage Domain so I can meet one of the ten-tailed fox’s souls."

Wan Jiang shook his head. "Kid, Jia Zizhen is too paranoid, and he’s sealed off other paths to his domain, so I have no solution to help you. In my opinion, you don’t need to rush there, and you should meet the other souls of the ten-tailed fox first. Once you are strong enough to face him, you can go there to meet the soul of the ten-tailed fox who resides there. If you can’t wait, you can ask the Dragon Emperor for help. With your current relationship with him, I’m sure he won’t refuse to help you, and that traitor won’t be able to harm you."

"Phew." Zhang Fei [5] sighed heavily. "I’ve tried asking Long Wuzhao for help, but he wasn’t willing to help me with that, and he asked me to try on my own. That’s why I came to you, but you don’t have a solution for me either."

Wan Jiang wasn’t too surprised by this because he was quite familiar with Long Wuzhao’s character, but he was also confused by the Dragon Emperor’s actions in saving Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun from Jia Zizhen. "Unfortunately, I don’t know any other paths to infiltrate there, so I can’t help you. However, Beiming Youhuang should be able to help you with that, so you should try meeting her."
"Beiming Youhuang, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] muttered to himself, but he was too lazy to meet Luo Yunxiao’s master. "Old Man, what if you leave this tower?"
"Hmm?" Wan Jiang looked at him in confusion, prompting Zhang Fei [5] to explain some of his guesses and plans to him.

Zhang Fei [5]’s explanation shocked Wan Jiang, Hua Mei’er, Sima Yun, and Huang Xiaoyi. "For now, it’s still just my guess, but I’m sure those two primordial beasts will descend here someday in the future. Moreover, I’ve discussed this matter with Feng Yao, and she also has the same thoughts as me. Therefore, I want to gather more allies and build my force as quickly as possible, and we will together prepare for the worst."
"Why does Empress Huo think like that?"

"Old Man, Feng Yao’s identity is much more mysterious than everyone knows, and I understand her better. Empress Huo Yanling was her identity in the past, but she has other identities that are much more ancient." Since Feng Yao didn’t mind if Zhang Fei [5] told other people about her other past identities, he immediately told them. "One of her identities in the past was Guang Zhiyi, and she used to be the guardian of the ancient races."
"Huh? Is that true, son?" Huang Xiaoyi asked in disbelief.
Zhang Fei [5] decided to summon Yin Yue’s soul out of his soul world, which shocked all of them. "She is the leader of the Silver Moon Clan, and her clan is one of the first two ancient clans."
"Is it true that Feng Yao used to be the guardian of the ancient races, Senior?" Huang Xiaoyi asked her.

"Yes." Yin Yue nodded at her. "Her name in the past was Guang Zhiyi, and she was truly the guardian of the ancient races. Even though she was reincarnated several times after that, I will never be able to forget her, and she admitted it herself when she met me in my palace. Back then, I went berserk and nearly harmed the other ancient clans. Therefore, she moved to stop me, and she imprisoned my soul in my palace until this kid freed me some time ago."

Huang Xiaoyi and the others were completely speechless after listening to Yin Yue’s confession. They had always believed that reincarnation existed because they had met several reincarnators, but they had never met one who had been reincarnated multiple times like Feng Yao.

Yin Yue then spoke to them again. "The Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility truly exist, and both of them should still be alive today. The only living being who can face them is Hu Tianlang, but he died long ago, and this kid is his successor. Therefore, you should focus on helping him; otherwise, no one can stop them if they descend into your realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 1246: Yin Yue’s Explanations
paragraphs: "Senior, if the two primordial beasts still exist, where do they live now? Why haven’t we heard of their existence?" Sima Yun asked.
Hua Mei’er, who had previously distanced herself from them, immediately returned to Wan Jiang’s side. She was curious about the Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast.

Yin Yue shook her head slightly. "To tell you the truth, I have never met the two primordial beasts, but there were many stories about them in the ancient realm in the past, and the source was the two dragons that lived during my era."
"Two dragons?"

"The first dragon is the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon." Huang Xiaoyi and the other three were shocked, and they immediately thought of Long Wuzhao. However, Yin Yue’s next words dismissed their thoughts. "I am referring to the golden dragon that existed in my era, not the golden dragon from this era. Back then, he was the reincarnation of the golden dragon that lived in the primordial era, and he regained his past memories after he regained his past strength."
"What is the second dragon, Senior?" Hua Mei’er curiously asked.
Huang Xiaoyi turned to Zhang Fei [5]. "Is that dragon you, son?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his Calamity Demon Dragon form, but he made his body small, or else that place wouldn’t be fit to accommodate his true dragon form.

Sima Yun and Hua Mei’er fell into a daze after they saw Zhang Fei [5]’s Calamity Demon Dragon form. They knew that he was a heavenly fox, but they had never known that he was also a Calamity Demon Dragon because he had never come to the Star Tower after he got his fourth identity.
"What kind of dragon is this?" Wan Jiang observed Zhang Fei [5].
"The Calamity Demon Dragon." Huang Xiaoyi and Yin Yue answered him at the same time.

After Zhang Fei [5] returned to his human form, Yin Yue continued her explanation. "Just like the Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast, the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon and the Calamity Demon Dragon represent Yang and Yin, but the two primordial beasts killed them. The two primordial beasts were superior to the two dragons, but they felt threatened by their existence."
"What about the two dragons that lived in the ancient era, Senior?" Sima Yun asked.

"They died." Yin Yue released a soft sigh. "Just like the ten-tailed fox and the two primordial beasts, the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon and the Calamity Demon Dragon can only exist one at a time in this universe. The two primordial beasts sent their avatars to the Ancient Realm, and they killed both dragons."
"You mean—"

"Yes." Yin Yue nodded at them. "I don’t understand why the two primordial beasts haven’t attacked this realm yet, but the existence of the two dragons from this era is a threat to this realm and all its inhabitants. I don’t know when they will attack here, but I’m sure they will send their avatars to kill the two dragons someday. The two dragons are indeed powerful after they regain their past strength, but they will never be a match for the two primordial beasts."

Yin Yue’s explanation made Huang Xiaoyi and the other three’s expressions turn grim. They knew Long Wuzhao was extremely powerful, and he was the strongest in their realm, but she said that he was not the opponent of the two primordial beasts.

Yin Yue embraced Zhang Fei [5] and continued. "The only one who can fight the two primordials is the ten-tailed fox, but he no longer exists in this universe. This kid is his successor, and he is our only hope of stopping the two beasts. However, he is still too weak now, and he needs the help of many people to strengthen himself. Therefore, you guys should leave trivial matters like controlling this tower behind, and you should focus on yourselves. This way, you guys can fight alongside him to fight against them in the future, or this realm will be destroyed."
"Was the ancient realm destroyed when the two primordial beasts attacked it in the past, Senior?"

"Haha." Yin Yue laughed softly. "The ancient races were much stronger than the people from this realm, okay? Moreover, we had Guang Zhiyi and Hu Tianlang at the time, and their strength far surpassed your imagination. Back then, the two primordial beasts sent their avatars to our realm to kill the two dragons, but they couldn’t create chaos there because of their presence. After they succeeded in killing the two dragons, their avatars immediately disappeared again."
Huang Xiaoyi then asked her. "If Guang Zhiyi and Hu Tianlang were that powerful in the past, why didn’t they stop the avatars of the two primordial beasts from killing the two dragons?"

"This." All of them were shocked again after several chains appeared on Yin Yue’s soul. "At first, I didn’t know anything about these chains, but someone explained them to me and taught me to make them appear. Nobody knew about the origins of these chains, but he said that they were seals, restrictions, or whatever you want to call them. They exist within the souls of all living beings, including the four of you. They limit us with unwritten rules, and no one has ever managed to break free from them."

Huang Xiaoyi and the others seriously observed those chains, and Yin Yue stopped Hua Mei’er when she was about to touch them. "So, what you’re saying is that these chains prevented Guang Zhiyi and Hu Tianlang from saving the two dragons from the two primordial beasts in the past, right?"
"That’s right." Yin Yue made the chains disappear again.

Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to them. "For the past two decades, I’ve learned many more things, but some new things bother me. I still don’t know for sure why the old fox chose to sacrifice himself, as he hasn’t explained the details to me. However, I fully understand Feng Yao’s intention to reincarnate multiple times, which is because she wants to free herself from the chains. As long as these chains are inside her soul, she will never be able to become a free person, and they will restrain her for the rest of her life. Unfortunately, she hasn’t managed to do it, but she says that she has found a solution for it."
"What’s the solution?"

Zhang Fei [5] responded with a shake of the head. "Feng Yao has always been secretive with me, so she wasn’t willing to tell me the truth, and she asked me to wait until my cultivation reached the Celestial God Realm first."
"Does that mean her cultivation has reached that stage now?" Huang Xiaoyi asked with raised eyebrows.

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] confirmed it with a single nod. "I still don’t know much about the Ancient Realm, but no cultivator in the Paradise Realm can match Feng Yao. Currently, she is the strongest cultivator, and the only person who can match her is Huo Ling, especially since she is the embodiment of the Eternal Flame. Their knowledge and experience far surpass the inhabitants of this realm because they have lived for too long, but they cannot reveal too many things to others due to the restrictions of the chains within their souls."
"So, what should we do now?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at them. "There is nothing we can do but focus on our strength, and we must strive hard to reach the Celestial God Realm as soon as possible. Some of you have already reached the Celestial Venerable Realm, so your journey to reach that stage is several steps closer. As for me and the others, our journey is still very long, so I don’t want to deal with those trivial matters. My main focus is to collect all the remaining souls of the old fox and merge them with mine; after I manage to gather them all, I will go to the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain."

"The Illusion Spirit Fox Domain?" Wan Jiang was surprised to hear that. "I’ve heard about the existence of that domain, which is home to the first fox born in this universe: the ten-tailed fox. Back then, he saved all the fox races and brought them to live there, but the domain disappeared along with his death, and no one has ever managed to find it to this day."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] softly laughed. "Old man, that domain still exists today, but several powerful formation arrays seal it, making it invisible to outsiders. Actually, I already have a way to find and enter that domain, but I can’t do it now, and I must find the remaining souls of the old fox first. One is in the Floral Mirage Domain, and the other is in the Slaughter Blood Domain. Since I can’t go to the first one, I will go to the last one first."
"Hmm?" Wan Jiang and Huang Xiaoyi frowned after hearing that.

Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly transformed into an asura demon, surprising them. "I can transform myself into a fairy, but I can’t transform my aura into one of them. The case is different if I transform myself into another demon, and as you can feel for yourself, my aura is no different from that of a member of the asura demon."

"That’s true." Wan Jiang nodded in agreement. "I’ve fought with members of the asura demon in the past, and your aura is exactly the same as theirs, so they shouldn’t be able to see through your disguise."

"The ancient races were much stronger than the people from this realm, okay?
Moreover, we had Guang Zhiyi and Hu Tianlang at the time, and their strength far surpassed your imagination.
Back then, the two primordial beasts sent their avatars to our realm to kill the two dragons, but they couldn’t create chaos there because of their presence.
After they succeeded in killing the two dragons, their avatars immediately disappeared again."
Huang Xiaoyi then asked her.
"If Guang Zhiyi and Hu Tianlang were that powerful in the past, why didn’t they stop the avatars of the two primordial beasts from killing the two dragons?"
"This." All of them were shocked again after several chains appeared on Yin Yue’s soul.
"At first, I didn’t know anything about these chains, but someone explained them to me and taught me to make them appear.
Nobody knew about the origins of these chains, but he said that they were seals, restrictions, or whatever you want to call them.
They exist within the souls of all living beings, including the four of you.
They limit us with unwritten rules, and no one has ever managed to break free from them."
Huang Xiaoyi and the others seriously observed those chains, and Yin Yue stopped Hua Mei’er when she was about to touch them.
"So, what you’re saying is that these chains prevented Guang Zhiyi and Hu Tianlang from saving the two dragons from the two primordial beasts in the past, right?"
"That’s right." Yin Yue made the chains disappear again.
Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to them.
"For the past two decades, I’ve learned many more things, but some new things bother me.
I still don’t know for sure why the old fox chose to sacrifice himself, as he hasn’t explained the details to me.
However, I fully understand Feng Yao’s intention to reincarnate multiple times, which is because she wants to free herself from the chains.
As long as these chains are inside her soul, she will never be able to become a free person, and they will restrain her for the rest of her life.
Unfortunately, she hasn’t managed to do it, but she says that she has found a solution for it."
"What’s the solution?"
Zhang Fei [5] responded with a shake of the head.
"Feng Yao has always been secretive with me, so she wasn’t willing to tell me the truth, and she asked me to wait until my cultivation reached the Celestial God Realm first."
"Does that mean her cultivation has reached that stage now?" Huang Xiaoyi asked with raised eyebrows.
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] confirmed it with a single nod.
"I still don’t know much about the Ancient Realm, but no cultivator in the Paradise Realm can match Feng Yao.
Currently, she is the strongest cultivator, and the only person who can match her is Huo Ling, especially since she is the embodiment of the Eternal Flame.

Their knowledge and experience far surpass the inhabitants of this realm because they have lived for too long, but they cannot reveal too many things to others due to the restrictions of the chains within their souls."
"So, what should we do now?"
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at them.
"There is nothing we can do but focus on our strength, and we must strive hard to reach the Celestial God Realm as soon as possible.
Some of you have already reached the Celestial Venerable Realm, so your journey to reach that stage is several steps closer.
As for me and the others, our journey is still very long, so I don’t want to deal with those trivial matters.
My main focus is to collect all the remaining souls of the old fox and merge them with mine; after I manage to gather them all, I will go to the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain."
"The Illusion Spirit Fox Domain?" Wan Jiang was surprised to hear that.
"I’ve heard about the existence of that domain, which is home to the first fox born in this universe: the ten-tailed fox.
Back then, he saved all the fox races and brought them to live there, but the domain disappeared along with his death, and no one has ever managed to find it to this day."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] softly laughed.
"Old man, that domain still exists today, but several powerful formation arrays seal it, making it invisible to outsiders.
Actually, I already have a way to find and enter that domain, but I can’t do it now, and I must find the remaining souls of the old fox first.
One is in the Floral Mirage Domain, and the other is in the Slaughter Blood Domain.
Since I can’t go to the first one, I will go to the last one first."
"Hmm?" Wan Jiang and Huang Xiaoyi frowned after hearing that.
Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly transformed into an asura demon, surprising them.
"I can transform myself into a fairy, but I can’t transform my aura into one of them.
The case is different if I transform myself into another demon, and as you can feel for yourself, my aura is no different from that of a member of the asura demon."
"That’s true." Wan Jiang nodded in agreement.
"I’ve fought with members of the asura demon in the past, and your aura is exactly the same as theirs, so they shouldn’t be able to see through your disguise."

chapters.title: Chapter 1247: Wan Jiang Join In
paragraphs: "So, what is your decision, Old Man?" Zhang Fei [5] asked Wan Jiang. "I know that you are part of the Emerald Bamboo Sect, but I have discussed this matter with Senior Li Tianyu and Senior Lan Yueru during my sect’s opening ceremony, and we decided to build a good relationship between the two sects."
’Tch! I hope my master won’t agree to join this pervert; otherwise, I’ll see him every day, and he’ll harass me again.’ Hua Mei’er grumbled inwardly, waiting for Wan Jiang’s decision.
Unlike Hua Mei’er, Sima Yun seemed enthusiastic about joining Zhang Fei [5], but he said nothing and waited for his master to consider his offer.

"Before I make a decision on your offer, I would like to know your plans for the cultivators in the Nine Stars Realm." Sima Yun and Hua Mei’er looked at Wan Jiang in confusion because the cultivators from that realm were simply too weak, and both believed that none of them would succeed in reaching the top of the Star Tower, especially after Zhang Fei [5] left the realm.
"Would you believe me if I thought about bringing them to the Paradise Realm?"
"Hmm?" Wan Jiang and his two disciples looked at him in disbelief.

Zhang Fei [5] spoke to them directly. "In fact, I have brought many of these beings to the Paradise Realm, and they are now part of my sect, particularly the beasts and natural races. As for the humans in that realm, I only brought those who are the families of some of my wives. For the others, I am thinking of building a teleportation device that can connect the two realms, and they will be able to ascend through it in the future."
"Have you gone mad?" Hua Mei’er asked in a high voice. "If you do that, the cultivators from the Paradise Realm can descend to the Three Mortal Realms freely, and they will create chaos there."

"Hua’er is right." Sima Yun agreed with her. "I think you should forget about that idea, Zhang Fei. I know your intentions are good, but your actions will only bring trouble to the people of the Three Mortal Realms. Not to mention, your plan will also enrage the senior cultivators in the Paradise Realm, especially those who hold control of all the towers. They will never allow their dominance to be disturbed, and they will work together to destroy you. If that happens, all the realm’s cultivators will consider you as a threat that must be eliminated, and they will also target your sect members."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "Naturally, I have considered those senior cultivators and clans, but you guys are wrong if you think I will do it openly. I am aware of my strength, and I will not be so crazy as to challenge them. Instead, I will do it secretly, and I will install the portal in a domain that they will not dare to enter."
"Where?"

"The Blazing Nirvana Domain." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer stunned both Sima Yun and Hua Mei’er. "Do you think they would dare enter that domain with Feng Yao present? Two months ago, she ordered her subordinates to carry out a mass slaughter, and they killed countless people from various races. Since that incident was not long ago, I believe those people must still remember the horror of their actions, so I can use her realm as the hub between the two realms."

"You’re right." Wan Jiang agreed with Zhang Fei [5]. "Even if Empress Huo didn’t order that, those old fogeys still wouldn’t dare enter her domain after learning of her return. Thus, it’s feasible if you want to install the teleportation portal in her domain, and they would never be aware of its existence. Then, what about the risk that the cultivators of the Paradise Realm would descend into the Three Mortal Realms? If the cultivators from this realm could easily get down there, they would colonize the people there, as their strength won’t be able to match theirs."

Zhang Fei [5] smiled in response. "Old Man, I am naturally aware of the risk, but they wouldn’t dare enter Feng Yao’s domain, so how would they descend there? Furthermore, I don’t plan to build a two-way teleportation device, but I will build a one-way teleportation device. This solution benefits both parties, as it allows the people from the Three Mortal Realms to ascend to this realm more easily while preventing those from the Paradise Realm from using it to go there."
"Yes." Wan Jiang nodded at him. "What exactly is the basis for your desire to make it easier for them to ascend here?"

"Isn’t the birth of new talent in this realm steadily declining every year?" Wan Jiang nodded once again to Zhang Fei [5]. "There are many talents in the Three Mortal Realms, but not all of them have backers or good opportunities to develop themselves. Since I came from there myself, I thought about giving them opportunities to develop themselves, but the final result depends on their hard work."
"Where will you house those people later, son? Will you house them all in your sect?" Huang Xiaoyi questioned him.

"No." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at her. "Previously, I’ve met with Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing, and they didn’t mind taking those people in. Senior Li Tianyu and Senior Lan Yueru also had no objections to my plan, so three sects are ready now. Additionally, I have another sect now, and the Sun Moon Sect has also agreed with me."
"Huh?" Huang Xiaoyi and the others were surprised.
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] softly laughed. "Mother-in-law, I haven’t told you about this, but the Blazing Union Sect is mine now."
"How did that happen? When did you take over the sect?" Huang Xiaoyi asked in disbelief.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately told them about the incident a month ago, when several members of the Winged Race and the Dragon Race helped him clear out the demons in the Blazing Union Sect, which shocked them. "Ming Tianhe and Qiu Meixuan are completely loyal to me now, and they still have control over the sect, but they will only act according to my instructions. As for the sects from the Empyrean Main Domain, I need your and my father-in-law’s help to discuss this matter with them, and I will take care of my other affairs."

"I see." Huang Xiaoyi nodded in understanding. "Those sects are clearly eager to build relationships with you, but previously, you only chose the Hidden Moon Sect. Moreover, their sects will get many benefits if they obtain new talents coming from the Three Mortal Realms, so I think we won’t have any difficulty persuading them."
"I think so." Zhang Fei [5] then asked Wan Jiang. "So, what’s your decision, Old Man?"

"Alright, I’ll join you." Hua Mei’er facepalmed and inwardly grumbled after Wan Jiang made his decision. In contrast, Sima Yun was delighted with their master’s decision. "However, I can’t go to your sect now because I have to meet the higher-ups first, and also I need to visit Li Tianyu and Lan Yueru to inform them of my decision."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding and sent Yin Yue’s soul back to his soul world. "In that case, you can meet them first, and I will wait for you in my sect."
"Wait." Wan Jiang spoke to his two disciples. "You two don’t need to go with me to meet them, and you can go to his sect first."
Hua Mei’er was reluctant to join Zhang Fei [5], but she was left with no other option because Wan Jiang had already made up her mind. "Send us to your sect."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the gate to the Empyrean Main Domain first. "Mother-in-law, you can return to your sect through this gate, and I’ll pick up Yunxiao and the others after I send these two to my sect."
"Alright."
After Huang Xiaoyi left, Zhang Fei [5] closed the gate and opened another one. "Go in now, and the people from my sect will accept you two there."
After Sima Yun and Hua Mei’er left, Zhang Fei [5] immediately spoke to Wan Jiang. "Old Man, Xing Haoran is out there now, and I think people from the Stygian Dusk Domain are with him."
"Hmm?" Wan Jiang frowned at that. "What happened? Were there any issues with them?"

"No." Zhang Fei [5] explained to Wan Jiang the problems involving his parents-in-law, Linghu Minghua, and the people from the Stygian Dusk Domain. "I’ll leave them to you, and I’ll go to the Sun Moon Domain."

After Zhang Fei [5] left, Wan Jiang looked around the room first before letting out a soft sigh. After all, he had spent a long time watching over the Star Tower, but he had decided to relinquish his duties.
As Zhang Fei [5] expected, Wan Jiang saw dozens of people in front of the entrance to the Star Tower, most of whom were Linghu Minghua and the people from the Stygian Dusk Domain.

Xing Haoran and the people from his Xing Clan froze as soon as they saw Wan Jiang. ’Shit! Why did he have to come out now? If we let him go now, the others will attack me because of my connection with these people.’
Linghu Minghua and the people from the Stygian Dusk Domain took several steps back as soon as Wan Jiang looked at them. ’Crap! Why did this old fairy suddenly come out of the tower?’
