chapters.title: Chapter 1248: Wan Jiang/Jia Xianzu True Strength
paragraphs: "Old Wan, we—"
Wan Jiang waved his hand to stop Xing Haoran before returning to his true form, which shocked him, Linghu Minghua, and their subordinates.

"Long ago, I abandoned my true name, but the situation has changed. Starting today, I am no longer Wan Jiang, and I am Jia Xianzu." Jia Xianzu then looked at Linghu Minghua and his subordinates before speaking to Xing Haoran. "Old Xing, I always thought that you and your Xing Clan were righteous cultivators, but I didn’t expect that you would be in cahoots with these heretics from the Stygian Dusk Domain. Therefore, I will use my position as one of the punishing elders in our organization to impose punishment on you and your clan, declaring that from today onward, all of you are heretics."

"Hahahaha!" Linghu Minghua laughed out loud upon hearing that. "Do you think you can fight all of us together, old bastard? You may be strong, but we far outnumber you, and you will die by our hands."

"Is that so?" The calmness in Jia Xianzu’s expression made Xing Haoran and Linghu Minghua tense up. "I guess I’ve been isolating myself for too long, and people dare to look down on me now. Since you’re so confident in your numbers, I’ll show you the true power of numbers."
*Fweeeet!*
As soon as Jia Xianzu whistled, the nature around them rumbled, causing all of them to panic.
Linghu Minghua turned to Xing Haoran, who nodded to him. They moved to attack Jia Xianzu, but two figures intercepted them and knocked them back, causing the two of them to stumble backwards.
Linghu Minghua and Xing Haoran looked at the two figures; one looked like a transparent figure with a body like air, and the other was a green figure with a body like a whirlwind.
*Zap... Zap... Zap...*
A purple lightning bolt suddenly struck from the sky and landed on Jia Xianzu’s right side, transforming into a figure with a body made of lightning.
*Rumble... Rumble...*

A lump of earth emerged from the ground on Jia Xianzu’s left side, transforming into an earth figure. Soon, a giant tree moved from one of their left sides, and it came out of the ground before walking towards them, but it stopped beside the old fairy.
Jia Xianzu’s actions didn’t stop there, as they saw a ball of lava shooting toward them at high speed, landing behind him before transforming into a lava figure.
*Drip... Drip... Drip...*
Not long after, rain poured down from the sky, and a transparent figure with a body of water descended and floated above Jia Xianzu.
*Swoosh... Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Thousands of figures of several colors quickly filled the sky above their area, which shocked Xing Haoran, Linghu Minghua, and their subordinates.
Xing Haoran, Linghu Minghua, and their subordinates took a deep breath after they saw those figures. ’Crap! I forgot that the Fairy Race can summon natural forces to help them!’
Jia Xianzu looked at them with a calm yet sharp gaze. "Now, who’s outnumbering whom? Attack and kill them."
All the figures followed Jia Xianzu’s orders and attacked those people, and attacks from several different elements rushed towards them.
’Shit!’ As he flew to avoid the attacks of those figures, Xing Haoran quickly sent a voice transmission to his clan members who were in their clan residence, ordering them to escape quickly.

"Attack them!" Linghu Minghua ordered his subordinates as he flew away from those attacks. However, none of them followed his orders, and they scattered in several directions to escape their attacks, irritating him. "A bunch of cowards!"
Even though he said that, Linghu Minghua himself didn’t dare face those figures, and he decided to use his return jade to escape the domain, leaving his subordinates there.
Jia Xianzu didn’t bother stopping Linghu Minghua, as he was familiar with the situation in the Stygian Dusk Domain. He ordered those figures to chase his subordinates, and he flew after Xing Haoran.
Green qi enveloped Jia Xianzu’s legs, and six wings appeared behind his back, accelerating his speed.
Sensing that, Xing Haoran looked back, and his expression was shocked that the distance between him and Jia Xianzu had become so close.
’Damn it! I have to escape now!’ Just as Xing Haoran took out a device to escape, Jia Xianzu shot a green arrow toward him and destroyed his device instantly. ’Crap!’

"You can’t escape from me." Xing Haoran shivered in fear, and numerous tree roots suddenly shot out from the ground, surrounding him like a wooden birdcage. The old man tried to destroy them, but Jia Xianzu swiftly enveloped them with his qi, and they absorbed his attacks.
Xing Haoran stopped flying and faced Jia Xianzu. "Wait! Please wait, Old Wan."

"There’s no need to beg me." After Jia Xianzu said that, a void crack suddenly appeared in front of them, and two people walked out of it. One is a middle-aged man, and the other one is a middle-aged woman.
’Shit! This old bastard has contacted them!’ The appearance of the two people frightened Xing Haoran, and his face turned deathly pale as he realized his fate if he fell into their hands.
"Kong Bai and Nu Liexi, I leave him to you two."
Both of them nodded to Jia Xianzu, and Kong Bai immediately locked Xing Haoran using a void prison, preventing him from listening to their conversation.
Nu Liexi then asked him. "What made you change your mind about returning to your true form, Old Jia?"
"Did you discover something interesting, Old Jia?" Nu Liexi also asked him.
Jia Xianzu nodded at them, "For tens of thousands of years, I’ve been waiting for this day, and I decided to return to my true form because I’ve discovered the truth of those rumors."
"Oh?" Kong Bai and Nu Liexi exchanged surprised glances. "Are those rumors true, Old Jia?"

"Yes." Jia Xianzu replied with a nod. "Previously, someone came to me and informed me of the truth. Jia Zizhen was not only in cahoots with the Jiu Demon Clan, but he was also in cahoots with Mo Shentian to assassinate our king in the past."
Jia Xianzu’s revelation shocked Kong Bai and Nu Liexi. "Do you have proof of Jia Zizhen’s involvement with the two demon gods, Old Jia?"

Jia Xianzu shook his head at Nu Liexi. "Actually, that person got this information from Long Wuzhao, and the Dragon Emperor heard it from Jia Zizhen’s own mouth when he rescued Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun from him. Unfortunately, we still don’t have any solid evidence about his involvement with the two demon gods, so we can’t do anything about him yet."
Kong Bai and Nu Liexi frowned at that. "Why did Jia Zizhen suddenly attack Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun? They are his seniors and advisors, so we found it strange."

"You two still remember their granddaughter, right?" Kong Bai and Nu Liexi nodded at Jia Xianzu. "Jia Yuyan was the most special among our fairy race because the Ancient Treant Spirit chose her as his successor, and Jia Zizhen was afraid that her existence would threaten him. He forced Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun to marry her to him, but he didn’t immediately take her as his wife at that time. He wanted to slow down her growth because he was afraid that she would surpass him, so he sent her to the Three Mortal Realms to look for someone."
"Jia Zizhen ordered her to look for the successor of the ten-tailed fox, right?"

"Yes." Jia Xianzu nodded at them. "Jia Yuyan managed to find the successor of the ten-tailed fox, and she has already returned to this realm. Therefore, Jia Zizhen forced Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun to bring her back to marry him, but he didn’t know that she was already the wife of the successor of the ten-tailed fox."
"Huh?" Kong Bai and Nu Liexi were shocked again after hearing that. "Does this mean the successor of the ten-tailed fox is already in this realm now?"

"Jia Yuyan has already brought him into this realm, and he is under Long Wuzhao’s protection now. Apart from the Dragon Emperor, Empress Huo also has a close relationship with him, and she has expressed her intention to protect him." Jia Xianzu deliberately made that statement because he was aware that no one would dare to disturb or attack Zhang Fei [5] if they knew he was under the protection of two powerful cultivators, making the two people smile bitterly after hearing that. "That’s true." Kong Bai nodded in agreement. "Since Long Wuzhao and Long Xukong have overheard Jia Zizhen’s words about his involvement with the two demon gods, I believe they have started monitoring his movements now. So, what are your next plans?"

"Let’s go."

sentences.text: "Old Wan, we—"
Wan Jiang waved his hand to stop Xing Haoran before returning to his true form, which shocked him, Linghu Minghua, and their subordinates.
"Long ago, I abandoned my true name, but the situation has changed.
Starting today, I am no longer Wan Jiang, and I am Jia Xianzu." Jia Xianzu then looked at Linghu Minghua and his subordinates before speaking to Xing Haoran.
"Old Xing, I always thought that you and your Xing Clan were righteous cultivators, but I didn’t expect that you would be in cahoots with these heretics from the Stygian Dusk Domain.
Therefore, I will use my position as one of the punishing elders in our organization to impose punishment on you and your clan, declaring that from today onward, all of you are heretics."
"Hahahaha!" Linghu Minghua laughed out loud upon hearing that.
"Do you think you can fight all of us together, old bastard?
You may be strong, but we far outnumber you, and you will die by our hands."
"Is that so?" The calmness in Jia Xianzu’s expression made Xing Haoran and Linghu Minghua tense up.
"I guess I’ve been isolating myself for too long, and people dare to look down on me now.
Since you’re so confident in your numbers, I’ll show you the true power of numbers."
*Fweeeet!*
As soon as Jia Xianzu whistled, the nature around them rumbled, causing all of them to panic.
Linghu Minghua turned to Xing Haoran, who nodded to him.
They moved to attack Jia Xianzu, but two figures intercepted them and knocked them back, causing the two of them to stumble backwards.
Linghu Minghua and Xing Haoran looked at the two figures; one looked like a transparent figure with a body like air, and the other was a green figure with a body like a whirlwind.
*Zap...
Zap...
Zap...*
A purple lightning bolt suddenly struck from the sky and landed on Jia Xianzu’s right side, transforming into a figure with a body made of lightning.
*Rumble...
Rumble...*
A lump of earth emerged from the ground on Jia Xianzu’s left side, transforming into an earth figure.
Soon, a giant tree moved from one of their left sides, and it came out of the ground before walking towards them, but it stopped beside the old fairy.
Jia Xianzu’s actions didn’t stop there, as they saw a ball of lava shooting toward them at high speed, landing behind him before transforming into a lava figure.
*Drip...
Drip...
Drip...*
Not long after, rain poured down from the sky, and a transparent figure with a body of water descended and floated above Jia Xianzu.
*Swoosh...
Swoosh...
Swoosh...*
Thousands of figures of several colors quickly filled the sky above their area, which shocked Xing Haoran, Linghu Minghua, and their subordinates.
Xing Haoran, Linghu Minghua, and their subordinates took a deep breath after they saw those figures. ’Crap!
I forgot that the Fairy Race can summon natural forces to help them!’
Jia Xianzu looked at them with a calm yet sharp gaze.
"Now, who’s outnumbering whom?
Attack and kill them."
All the figures followed Jia Xianzu’s orders and attacked those people, and attacks from several different elements rushed towards them.
’Shit!’ As he flew to avoid the attacks of those figures, Xing Haoran quickly sent a voice transmission to his clan members who were in their clan residence, ordering them to escape quickly.
"Attack them!" Linghu Minghua ordered his subordinates as he flew away from those attacks.
However, none of them followed his orders, and they scattered in several directions to escape their attacks, irritating him.
"A bunch of cowards!"
Even though he said that, Linghu Minghua himself didn’t dare face those figures, and he decided to use his return jade to escape the domain, leaving his subordinates there.
Jia Xianzu didn’t bother stopping Linghu Minghua, as he was familiar with the situation in the Stygian Dusk Domain.
He ordered those figures to chase his subordinates, and he flew after Xing Haoran.
Green qi enveloped Jia Xianzu’s legs, and six wings appeared behind his back, accelerating his speed.
Sensing that, Xing Haoran looked back, and his expression was shocked that the distance between him and Jia Xianzu had become so close.
’Damn it!
I have to escape now!’ Just as Xing Haoran took out a device to escape, Jia Xianzu shot a green arrow toward him and destroyed his device instantly. ’Crap!’
"You can’t escape from me." Xing Haoran shivered in fear, and numerous tree roots suddenly shot out from the ground, surrounding him like a wooden birdcage.
The old man tried to destroy them, but Jia Xianzu swiftly enveloped them with his qi, and they absorbed his attacks.
Xing Haoran stopped flying and faced Jia Xianzu.
"Wait!
Please wait, Old Wan."
"There’s no need to beg me." After Jia Xianzu said that, a void crack suddenly appeared in front of them, and two people walked out of it.
One is a middle-aged man, and the other one is a middle-aged woman.
’Shit!
This old bastard has contacted them!’ The appearance of the two people frightened Xing Haoran, and his face turned deathly pale as he realized his fate if he fell into their hands.
"Kong Bai and Nu Liexi, I leave him to you two."
Both of them nodded to Jia Xianzu, and Kong Bai immediately locked Xing Haoran using a void prison, preventing him from listening to their conversation.
Nu Liexi then asked him.
"What made you change your mind about returning to your true form, Old Jia?"
"Did you discover something interesting, Old Jia?" Nu Liexi also asked him.
Jia Xianzu nodded at them, "For tens of thousands of years, I’ve been waiting for this day, and I decided to return to my true form because I’ve discovered the truth of those rumors."
"Oh?" Kong Bai and Nu Liexi exchanged surprised glances.
"Are those rumors true, Old Jia?"
"Yes." Jia Xianzu replied with a nod.
"Previously, someone came to me and informed me of the truth.
Jia Zizhen was not only in cahoots with the Jiu Demon Clan, but he was also in cahoots with Mo Shentian to assassinate our king in the past."
Jia Xianzu’s revelation shocked Kong Bai and Nu Liexi.
"Do you have proof of Jia Zizhen’s involvement with the two demon gods, Old Jia?"
Jia Xianzu shook his head at Nu Liexi.
"Actually, that person got this information from Long Wuzhao, and the Dragon Emperor heard it from Jia Zizhen’s own mouth when he rescued Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun from him.
Unfortunately, we still don’t have any solid evidence about his involvement with the two demon gods, so we can’t do anything about him yet."
Kong Bai and Nu Liexi frowned at that.
"Why did Jia Zizhen suddenly attack Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun?
They are his seniors and advisors, so we found it strange."
"You two still remember their granddaughter, right?" Kong Bai and Nu Liexi nodded at Jia Xianzu.
"Jia Yuyan was the most special among our fairy race because the Ancient Treant Spirit chose her as his successor, and Jia Zizhen was afraid that her existence would threaten him.
He forced Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun to marry her to him, but he didn’t immediately take her as his wife at that time.
He wanted to slow down her growth because he was afraid that she would surpass him, so he sent her to the Three Mortal Realms to look for someone."
"Jia Zizhen ordered her to look for the successor of the ten-tailed fox, right?"
"Yes." Jia Xianzu nodded at them.

Therefore, Jia Zizhen forced Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun to bring her back to marry him, but he didn’t know that she was already the wife of the successor of the ten-tailed fox."
"Huh?" Kong Bai and Nu Liexi were shocked again after hearing that.
"Does this mean the successor of the ten-tailed fox is already in this realm now?"
"Jia Yuyan has already brought him into this realm, and he is under Long Wuzhao’s protection now.

Apart from the Dragon Emperor, Empress Huo also has a close relationship with him, and she has expressed her intention to protect him." chapters.title: Chapter 1249: The Higher Ups
paragraphs: Jia Xianzu, Kong Bai, and Nu Liexi stood in the center of a large room with ten thrones surrounding the area, with several people seated. However, the throne in the center was empty, but its dragon shape and golden color indicated that it belonged to the Golden Dragon Emperor, Long Wuzhao.
Nu Liexi forced Xing Haoran, who was shaking violently, to kneel on the floor. ’Shit! I never thought that my fate would end like this.’
Jia Xianzu reported to the nine people sitting on the thrones about Xing Haoran’s mistakes, making them whisper to each other while looking at the old man.

One of the nine people, who was a woman, suddenly raised her hand. She shot something at Xing Haoran, which caused his body to quickly dry up before disappearing into the dust. "Do you still have anything else to discuss with us, Old Jia?"

"Yes." Jia Xianzu nodded at the woman. "Senior Hui Chen, I have decided to relinquish my position as the tower watcher because I have found evidence of Jia Zizhen’s betrayal, and I will prepare myself to purge the traitor."

Hui Chen and the other eight were shocked to hear that, but Long Wuzhao suddenly appeared on his golden throne. "Even though I don’t have solid evidence yet, I heard with my ears that Jia Zizhen was in cahoots with Jiu Mozu and Mo Shentian."
"How did you know that, Dragon Emperor?"

Long Wuzhao turned to the old man with the appearance of an elf. "Jing Ruzhi, I previously went to the Fairy Race to save Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun from Jia Zuzhen’s hands. The fairy king didn’t realize that Long Xukong and I were still in the void, and we overheard him contacting the two demon gods. Still, it couldn’t be used as evidence to get rid of him, so I have asked Long Xukong to collect the evidence first."

"I see." Jing Ruzhi nodded in understanding. "I didn’t expect the rumors to be true, and Jia Zizhen dared to attack Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun, even though they were his seniors and advisors. But what was his reason for attacking them?"

"This matter is related to the Ancient Treant Spirit." Jing Ruzhi and the other eight stared at Long Wuzhao in shock. "Their granddaughter, Jia Yuyan, was Shu Yuangu’s successor. Jia Zizhen forced them to marry her to him, but she is married to another man now."

"Didn’t Jia Zizhen send Jia Yuyan to the Three Mortal Realms to search for the whereabouts of the Ten-Tailed Fox’s successor? Does this mean that she has succeeded in finding his successor?" A human woman asked Long Wuzhao.

"You are right, Shen Jinyue." Long Wuzhao confirmed it with a light nod. "Jia Yuyan has succeeded in finding Hu Tianlang’s successor, and she has brought him to our realm. However, I will not reveal his identity for now, and I have ordered some of my subordinates to protect him. Additionally, you should already know that Empress Huo Yanling has returned, and she is also protecting him now."
Jing Ruzhi and the other eight started whispering again, especially after they remembered Feng Yao’s action in ordering her subordinates to carry out a mass massacre in their realm.

Long Wuzhao then spoke to them again. "For now, all of you must restrain yourselves from seeking information about him because your actions will only provoke Empress Huo’s wrath, and none of you will be able to face her wrath."
"Does that mean Empress Huo has regained her past strength?"

Long Wuzhao nodded to the old man. "Wang Jinyang, I met Empress Huo before, and her cultivation has reached the Three-Sun Celestial God Realm, which means she is the strongest cultivator in this realm right now. Additionally, the Eternal Flame is by her side, and—"
"What?" The nine people shouted as they stood up from their thrones. "Are you serious about that? Has the Eternal Flame really returned? How could it be in Empress Huo’s hands?"

Long Wuzhao shook his head. "Empress Huo’s existence has always been a mystery to us all, and her past strength was simply beyond logic. Since she has regained her past strength, we are not her opponents."

They let out a heavy sigh, and a male beast with a body as large as Long Wuzhao’s immediately spoke. His body was covered in a golden robe and flames that were almost similar to the Golden Dragon King, but both were different at the same time. "Back then, we challenged her to fight us, and she asked us to fight her all at once. Even with our combined strength, we still lost badly to her, and it took me a hundred thousand years to fully recover."

"Haha." Hui Chen softly laughed at that. "Hey, Feng Jinhuang! We asked you to stop at that time, but your arrogance blinded you, and Empress Huo was forced to bring you to your senses by beating you almost to death."

"That’s true." Jing Ruzhi nodded her head. "Even after you used your golden phoenix flame, you were still powerless before Empress Huo. She was even able to control your flame at that time, which was simply beyond logic since she was a human in the past."
Feng Jinhuang’s lips twitched at that remark, but Long Wuzhao immediately spoke to him. "Golden Phoenix Emperor, the current Empress Huo is no longer a human but a Fire Phoenix."
"Huh?" Feng Jinhuang and the others were shocked by that. "Are you sure that Empress Huo is a Fire Phoenix now?"
"She—"
*Scree*

All of them turned to the voice, and they saw a giant fire phoenix flying in. Soon, the giant fire phoenix landed in the center of the room before transforming into Feng Yao, causing Feng Jinhuang and the others to hold their breath and their bodies to tremble, except for Long Wuzhao.
Jia Xianzu, Kong Bai, and Nu Liexi immediately retreated, as they too were terrified of Feng Yao.

Their expressions grew even more terrified as Huo Ling emerged from Feng Yao’s body, making her laugh. "Haha! Don’t you guys miss me? I haven’t seen you all in a long time, but you guys are so afraid of me."
’Tch! Who would miss a barbaric woman like you?’ They grumbled inwardly.

Feng Yao smirked faintly before speaking to them. "I didn’t come here to beat you guys up like in the past, but I wanted to emphasize Long Wuzhao’s previous words. Anyone who investigates the identity of Hu Tianlang’s successor will become my enemy, and I will show you a merciless side of me that I have never shown in the past."
’Fuck! You are the most merciless woman in the past!’ Long Wuzhao and others smiled bitterly.

"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled. "For now, he is still too weak, and I want him to focus on his cultivation because I need his help in the future. Additionally, I am tired of my restricted life, so I don’t want anyone to disturb him. If you ignore my warning, I will wipe out you and all your descendants."
None of them dared to speak up to refute Feng Yao, but then Long Wuzhao asked her. "What do you mean by your restricted life, Empress Huo?"

Feng Yao shook her head at Long Wuzhao. "I can’t say anything for now, but the only one who can free me from my restricted life is Hu Tianlang’s successor. I’m growing tired of this life, and I need him to become stronger faster, so I won’t allow anyone to disturb him. If you anger me, Huo Ling will destroy this Paradise Realm and all its inhabitants, so you must not underestimate my warning."
"Why did you have to go to such lengths, Empress Huo?" Jing Ruzhi asked with a serious expression.

"Do I need to give you an explanation?" Jing Ruzhi shivered in fear when Feng Yao’s eyes glowed crimson. "Just remember my warning today: never disturb the life of Hu Tianglang’s successor, or other people will die because of your foolishness."

Another man wanted to speak to Feng Yao, but Long Wuzhao hurriedly stopped him. "Empress Huo, you don’t need to worry about that; I guarantee that none of us will disturb Hu Tianlang’s successor. However, I can’t do anything about those demons and evil beasts, so he will have to deal with them himself."

"That’s good." Feng Yao then threw a device to Long Wuzhao. "All the evidence of Jia Zizhen’s involvement with the two demon gods is contained within that device, but I forbid you from taking any action against him. I need him to make Hu Tianlang’s successor aware of his limitations, so he will strive harder to become the strongest; only then can he free me."
’This woman! How selfish she is! She’s been threatening us ever since she arrived, and it’s all for her own personal gain!’
Like the others, Long Wuzhao was also confused by Feng Yao’s attitude. "Alright, we won’t do anything to Jia Zizhen, and I’ll let that kid handle him as you wish."
"Since my business here is finished, I’ll leave now." After Huo Ling entered her body, Feng Yao disappeared from their sight.
Jing Ruzhi then asked Long Wuzhao, "Are we going to let Empress Huo continue to behave like this?"
"If you’re tired of living, you can fight Empress Huo yourself." The others nodded in agreement to Wang Jinyang.
Long Wuzhao shook his head slightly. "Forget about Empress Huo, and you can return to your sect, Jia Xianzu."
"Thank you, Dragon Emperor."

chapters.title: Chapter 1250: The Evidence
paragraphs: "Dragon Emperor, try activating the device so we can see evidence of Jia Zizhen’s crimes." Wang Jinyang spoke.
Long Wuzhao injected his qi into the device, causing it to fly to the center of the room and several qi screens appeared before them.

The first screen shows the previous fairy king conversing with several people, who were his potential successors, including Jia Zizhen, Jia You (also known as Beiming Youhuang), and Jia Xianzu (also known as Wan Jiang).

The previous fairy king announced his decision to elect Jia Xianzu as the next fairy king, which was the starting point of the disaster that befell their fairy race. They could see Jia Zizhen’s expression filled with disappointment and hatred, and they also saw a transparent black figure appear behind him, even though he was not a darkness cultivator.

On the second screen, Long Wuzhao and the others saw Jia Zizhen contact and meet with the Jiu Mozu in another domain, and the two decided to cooperate after the former gave something to the latter. Even though they couldn’t recognize the item, they were certain it was a demon item.

The third screen showed Jia Zizhen and Mo Shentian’s past encounter, and they saw a female demon with them at the time. Long Wuzhao and the others immediately recognized the woman, who was none other than the wife of the Calamity Demon God, Mo Zainan.

Long Wuzhao and the others saw Mo Zainan inject something into Jia Zizhen’s body, but unfortunately, they couldn’t see the item clearly, and it caused his power to increase significantly. On the screen, they heard the three talk about their plan to assassinate the previous king, causing them to frown.
On the fourth screen, Long Wuzhao and the others saw Jia Zizhen luring the previous fairy king to a place where Mo Shentian, Mo Zainan, and Jiu Mozu were waiting for them.

The four of them ganged up on the previous fairy king, but they were confused because he didn’t put up a fight against them, making Long Wuzhao and the others feel that he already knew of their plan from the start. In the end, the previous fairy king died at the hands of Jia Zizhen, and he absorbed his predecessor’s power.
On the next screen, Long Wuzhao and the others saw Jia Zizhen devising a plan to eliminate those who were previously candidates for the next fairy king, including Jia You and Jia Xianzu.

Before Jia Zizhen could frame her, Jiao You had already cut ties with the fairy race, and she chose to leave the Floral Mirage Domain. He then framed Jia Xianzu and several other candidates as being involved in the death of the previous fairy king, forcing the elders to strip them of their status and expel them from their race.
The worst situation was experienced by Jia Xianzu as the chosen one to replace the previous fair king, and Jia Zizhen accused him of killing their king by collaborating with the demons.
The elders initially did not believe Jia Zizhen’s accusations against Jia Xianzu, but they found all the evidence that the former had fabricated to frame him.
They decided to sentence Jia Xianzu to death, but Long Wuzhao and the others saw a white-haired man save Jia Xianzu, who was already in a helpless situation.

The white-haired man created great chaos in the Floral Mirage Domain, and he threatened them with destroying the domain if they insisted on sentencing Jia Xianzu to death. In the end, the elders decided to let the latter go and erase his name from the fairy race’s history, so only a small portion of their members still remember his name.

Long Wuzhao and the others wondered about the white-haired man’s identity because they couldn’t recognize him, and his ability to deal with all the fairy race members at once, rendering them helpless, was truly astonishing.
In the last screen, Long Wuzhao and the others saw the process of Jia Zizhen ascending the throne, and they already knew the rest of the story.

Shen Jinyue then asked the others, "Who is that white-haired man? How did Empress Huo get all this evidence? As I recall, she disappeared long before Jia Zizhen’s betrayal, so she shouldn’t have known about it. Furthermore, all these recordings clearly show a first-person perspective, making me feel like she witnessed everything firsthand."
"I think the same." Hui Chen spoke as she nodded. "Empress Huo’s existence has always been a mystery, and all these recordings added to her mystery."
"Dragon emperor, do you think the same as me?" Feng Jinhuang asked.

Long Wuzhao nodded at him. "If my guess is correct, the white-haired man is Hu Tianlang. However, he died several million years before that incident, so he couldn’t have appeared and recorded all of that."
"Doesn’t one of Hu Tianlang’s souls reside in the Floral Mirage Domain?" The old elf, Jing Ruzhi, asked him.
"Yes." Long Wuzhao nodded in response. "In fact, I met Hu Tianlang’s soul in that domain in the past, but that soul is different from his other souls, including that mysterious white-haired man."
"What do you mean that souls are different?"

Long Wuzhao let out a soft sigh. "Hu Tianlang’s soul that resides in the Floral Mirage Domain is his sloth nature, and it doesn’t possess his past strength. Therefore, I believe that sloth soul is not the mysterious white-haired man, and his other soul may have been transformed into him."
"Hu Tianlang’s other soul?" All of them wondered about it.

Wang Jinyang then spoke. "If the white-haired man is truly the incarnation of one of Hu Tianlang’s souls, I think he is the incarnation of his wrath soul, judging by his temperament when threatening all the members of the fairy race."

"I agree with you." Long Wuzhao then dispelled all the qi screens and sucked the device into his hand. "Since Empress Huo asked us not to take action against Jia Zizhen, we don’t need to dwell on this long-standing matter. As for the identity of the mysterious white-haired man, we will definitely find out when Hu Tianlang’s successor appears on the surface, and his appearance will likely be a good omen for all races in this universe."
"Do you really believe that Hu Tianlang’s successor will succeed in reconciling all the races in this universe, Dragon Emperor?"
Long Wuzhao turned to Hui Chen with a smile. "You’ve read the writings of Hu Tianlang left behind in the past, so you shouldn’t doubt that his successor will succeed, right?"

"Those are just writings if their truth has not been proven," Hui Chen denied, shaking her head. "Furthermore, we don’t know Hu Tianlang’s successor, and only you and Empress Huo know him, so we don’t have definitive information about his current strength and abilities. Therefore, it’s natural for me to doubt him, right?"

"Ha ha ha." Long Wuzhao laughed at that. "To tell you the truth, the one who gave me information about Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun’s situation was Hu Tianlang’s successor, and he immediately informed me as soon as he learned about it. Therefore, I managed to save them before Jia Zizhen could take any action against them, and I brought both of them to my domain."
All of them looked at Long Wuzhao with questioning looks. "How could Hu Tianlang’s successor do that? Has he infiltrated the Floral Mirage Domain before?"

"No." Long Wuzhao shook his head slightly. "Hu Tianlang’s successor is currently in my domain, and he has never visited the Floral Mirage Domain before. I don’t know how he managed to do that, but his information proved to be accurate. Alright, you guys don’t need to be too curious about him, and you can witness his abilities for yourself once he decides to show himself to the public. However, I can tell you that he has already begun his plan to reconcile all races, and several of them, including my beast races and the winged races, have now stood by his side."
After he said that, Long Wuzhao immediately disappeared from the scene, leaving Hui Chen and the others wondering about the identity of Hu Tianlang’s true successor.

"Old Kong, I want you to find out the identity of Hu Tianlang’s successor." Kong Bai raised an eyebrow after Wang Jinyang made his statement, especially because Feng Yao had already forbidden them from conducting any investigation. "Among us, only you and Nu Liexi are void cultivators, but your understanding of the void is already near its peak, so I think you should be able to do it without attracting Empress Huo’s attention."

Kong Bai let out a soft sigh, unable to refuse their orders. "I’ll try, but I can’t promise anything because this Paradise Realm is too vast and its inhabitants are too numerous. Moreover, the void is different from what you imagine, and it’s far more expansive than this realm."

"At least you should try it first, and you should give us an update on your investigation." Jing Ruzhi thought for a moment before continuing. "Since the ten-tailed fox is much closer to the natural races and beast races, you can start by checking all their domains."
Kong Bai nodded at him. "Alright, I’ll start my investigation from their domains, but they have quite a few domains, so I’ll bring Nu Liexi to assist me in my investigation."
"Do it."
After the nine people disappeared, Kong Bai and Nu Liexi also left the place, and the two immediately carried out their task of investigating the whereabouts of Hu Tianlang’s successor.
